Come to think of it, you must have cleared your mission.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
仔细想想，你应该已经完成了任务。

scripts.text: Give him the Blessing Star.
scripts.translation: 给他祝福之星

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Terra Gloria, the surface is gone.
Only the star is remaining.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...泰拉格洛丽亚的表面已经不见了。
只剩下这颗星。

scripts.text: Is there any problem?
scripts.translation: 有什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
No, the surface is just a means to cover the star.
What matters is the star.
You have brought the right stuff.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
不，外壳只是用来包住这颗星的。
重要的是这颗星。
你带回了真正重要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Hmm? It's just a gem, isn't it?
Why on earth did they steal this?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
嗯？这不就是颗宝石吗？
他们为什么要偷这个？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Because it is like a fine magic stone.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
因为它就像一块精美的魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
.. Now they steal the materials for experiments?
There are several more facilities that are presumed to have secret laboratories like this.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...他们现在连实验材料都偷？
据说还有好几处设施里藏着类似的秘密实验室。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Are you freaking out about the future?
We have already finished talking about it.
I told you that I would support you if you need it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
你是在担心接下来会怎样吗？
我们已经谈妥了。
我说过，需要的话我会支持你。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... That was in reference to the mutual agreement. So please don't take the credit for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...那是双方协议里说好的。别把功劳都揽到自己身上。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Credit? I was just telling the truth.
Now, I don't have to be here anymore.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
功劳？我只是在说实话。
好了，我也没必要继续待在这里了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You are so cold.
Are you leaving right after obtaining what you want?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你可真冷淡。
拿到想要的东西就马上要走吗？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We will meet again, if necessary.
Tess, if you visit Prontera, you will be more than welcome.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
有需要的话，我们还会再见。
泰丝，欢迎你来普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Besides, I don't have much time.
I have many things to handle when I get back.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
再说，我时间不多。
回去后还有一堆事要处理。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}.
Go back to the palace and wait in your room.
I will make sure that you get enough compensation.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
{0}。
回宫后就在房间等着。
我会给你应得的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Are we going back now?
I have a Scroll of Movement made by Nilem, the palace magician. Shall I use it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
现在回去吗？
我有尼勒姆这个宫廷魔法师制作的移动卷轴。要用吗？

scripts.text: Let me join you!!
scripts.translation: 让我也一起去！！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
No, {0}, please talk to me for a while.
I would like to get some more!
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
不，{0}，请再陪我聊一会儿。
我还想再问你几件事！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Skia, activate it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
斯基亚，发动它。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Yes~
Mr. Philopontess, so long!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
好~
菲洛庞泰丝先生，再见！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Good to see you again.
I am glad you are safe.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
又见面了。
很高兴你平安无事。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
This happened because of me. So I came to resolve the crisis myself.
... It would be shameful of me to keep relying on others.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
这场危机因我而起，所以我亲自来解决。
...一直依赖别人，我会觉得很羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Although I cannot help you physically,
I can take care of the information analysis and diplomatic affairs.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...虽然我无法亲自出力，
但可以负责情报分析和外交事务。

scripts.text: Have you been released from confinement?
scripts.translation: 你被解除禁闭了吗？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hmm~ Unfortunately, no.
I reported to the elders of our royal family about this affair. I was scolded and barely got permission to come here.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯~很遗憾，还没有。
我向王室长老汇报了这件事，挨了一顿训，好不容易才获准来这里。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
In the process, I took advantage of your name.
Officially, you are the key person resolving this crisis and I am the one who takes the responsibility. And Lady Skia is observing me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
这件事上我借用了你的名义。
官方说法是，你是解决危机的关键人物，而我负责承担责任。斯基亚小姐则负责监督我。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Since they all know about you, everyone is expecting you resolve this by any means.
I apologize for having taken advantage of your name without informing you earlier.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
大家都知道你，所以都指望你无论如何也要解决这场危机。
之前没告诉你就借用了你的名义，很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Without it, they would never have approved you.
They would have claimed that you had made things worse.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
不这么说，他们根本不会批准你来。
他们只会说你把事情弄得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Let's talk about the operation ... Is your name Philopontess?
We are cooperating now, so may I tell you my opinion?
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
说说行动安排吧...你叫菲洛庞泰丝？
既然现在是合作关系，我可以谈谈我的看法吗？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Of course.
And please call me Tess.
The Rebellion will be in charge of the military operation. But ...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
当然可以。
叫我泰丝就好。
军事行动由反叛者负责，不过...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
In terms of strategy, we are superior.
And we only have a single chance. So you are welcome to give us a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
战略方面我们占优势。
但我们只有一次机会，所以欢迎你提出好建议。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow, he sure has a big mouth~
If my sister Elena heard it, she might have shot him in the head!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇，他可真会说大话~
要是我姐姐埃琳娜听见，恐怕早就一枪崩了他！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We've picked out the combatants. Since this operation is confidential, we selected those who we can fully trust.
And the investigation of the buildings and geographical features?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
作战人员已经选好了。行动是机密，所以我们只挑了绝对信得过的人。
那么，建筑和地形的调查呢？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Of course, we have provided it.
We have been investigating this place for quite a long time.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
当然已经准备好了。
我们调查这里很久了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I read the document.
The funny thing is here ... I don't know why. But there is
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我看过资料。
奇怪的是...我也说不上来，但这里...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
no retreat path in the area where the facility is located.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
这处设施所在区域没有撤退路线。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm. Then all we have to do is get in there and block the only entrance?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯。那我们只要进去，封锁唯一的入口就行了？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
They might have installed a gate for teleport. We must disable it first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
他们可能设置了传送门，我们得先让它失效。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We must do it quickly, so that the enemy cannot take any countermeasures even if they recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
必须迅速行动，免得敌人察觉后采取对策。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Leave it to us!
The Rebellion hasn't just been napping.
Then the rest here are all surplus manpower?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
交给我们吧！
反叛者可不是一直在睡大觉。
那留在这里的人都是预备队吗？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Did you say 'surplus'!?
Have you already forgotten who provided this information?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
“多余”？你说这种话！？
你忘了这份情报是谁提供的吗？

scripts.text: ... The meeting is getting too long.
scripts.translation: ...这会议开得也太久了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hmm ... It's boring, isn't it?
Things have been decided to some degree.
I won't be able to help you directly.
I'm here to watch Nihil.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
嗯...无聊吧？
事情已经大致谈妥了。
我没法直接帮你们。
我来这里是为了监督尼希尔。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What you have to concentrate on in this facility is the central room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
在这处设施里，你们要重点调查的是中央房间。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
What you are looking for might be in the place called the ^4d4dffcentral room^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你们要找的东西可能就在^4d4dff中央房间^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I stepped in to ensure a safe, successful procedure. But actually, we had already provided you with everything we can.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我介入是为了确保行动安全顺利。不过，我们已经把能提供的都给你们了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}, once the Rebellion occupies the laboratory, you have to rush to the central room faster than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
{0}，反叛者一旦占领实验室，你就要抢在所有人前面冲进中央房间。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
And there ... you will find it.
I have a strong feeling that it is here.
I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
在那里...你会找到它。
我有强烈的预感，它就在那儿。
拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Now let's get going.
It will be dark soon.
It's the end of the week, so security might not be so tight.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
出发吧。
天快黑了。
而且快到周末了，警戒可能没那么严。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
行动地点是^4d4dff艾音布罗克北部原野的一点钟方向^000000。
到了原野后，请配合反叛者行动。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The exact ^4d4dffcoordinates of the operation spot are 280, 332^000000. The person in charge of the operation may be ... ^4d4dffJulian^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
行动地点的精确^4d4dff坐标是280, 332^000000。负责人可能是...^4d4dff朱利安^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Go find Julian!
Of course I'm going too.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
去找朱利安！
当然，我也会去。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Don't forget.
You absolutely must reach the central room and find the ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
I wish you fortune in war.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...别忘了。
一定要抵达中央房间，找到^4d4dff泰拉格洛丽亚^000000。
祝你旗开得胜。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will take a chance and participate.
Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我也冒险进去帮忙。
多保重！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Don't forget.
You absolutely must reach the central room and find the ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
I wish you fortune in war.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
...别忘了。
一定要抵达中央房间，找到^4d4dff泰拉格洛丽亚^000000。
祝你旗开得胜。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
行动地点是^4d4dff艾音布罗克北部原野的一点钟方向^000000。
到了原野后，请配合反叛者行动。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, it seems like everyone is here. Maybe I can step out?
From now on, Rookie, the heron emeritus agent, will handle it!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看来人都到齐了，我是不是可以撤了？
接下来交给新人吧，我这只退役的苍鹭特工就功成身退啦！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I've done my job~
Now I'm counting on Rookie!
I'm on vacation from now on!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我的任务完成啦~
接下来就拜托你了，新人！
我从现在开始休假！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Most of the squadron will be standing by in the operation spot.
They will take a chance to start it, right?
I think they will get in when it gets dark ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
大部分队员会在行动地点待命。
等机会一到，他们就会动手，对吧？
我想他们会趁天黑潜入...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's get there before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
趁还来得及，我们赶紧过去。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will be in the shade.
Oh~ I'm excited to use a sword after such a long time!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我会躲在暗处。
啊~好久没用剑了，真让人兴奋！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
行动地点是^4d4dff艾音布罗克北部原野的一点钟方向^000000。
到了原野后，请配合反叛者行动。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... I really hate training ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...我最讨厌训练了...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
^4d4dffJulian^000000 is the person in charge of the operation here.
Please go and ask him.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^4d4dff朱利安^000000是这里的行动负责人。
去找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
They are like rats in a trap. All we have to do is the cleanup~ I'm going in, too.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他们就像瓮中之鳖，剩下的只是清理工作~我也要进去。

scripts.text: Good. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation: 好，拜托你了

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's natural.
You haven't found that thing you were looking for yet.
I will let you go. Could you just find that thing?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那是当然。
你还没找到要找的东西吧？
我放你进去，先把那东西找出来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As they occupied this place, they are remodeling some of the routes to make a training camp.
... Oh ... I hate it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他们占领这里后，正在改造部分通道，准备当作训练场。
...唉...我已经开始讨厌这里了。

scripts.text: Enter the military base.
scripts.translation: 进入军事基地

scripts.text: Good. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation: 好，拜托你了

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh ... arg ...

[Rookie]
There are still come remnants inside the research facilities.
Actually ... they are more like monsters.
Anyway, take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
研究设施里还有些残党...
其实...更像是魔物。
总之，小心点。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏里东西太多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The ^4d4dffcentral area^000000 seems to be located in this laboratory, ^4d4dffdeep inside the building's basement^000000.
Since we, the Rebellion, have completely occupied this place, please feel free to go there.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^4d4dff中央区域^000000似乎在这座实验室里，^4d4dff位于建筑物地下深处^000000。
反叛者已经完全控制了这里，你尽管进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Teleport?
They cannot use it.
We have blocked it.
Actually, it's something we had never thought of ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
传送？
他们用不了。
我们已经封锁了。
其实这办法我们以前也没想到...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The man with shiny blonde hair told me to block magic related to movement as well.
Well, I know that the magic is more common in Rune Midgarts. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那个金发男人还让我封锁所有移动魔法。
嗯，我听说这类魔法在卢恩·米德加兹很常见，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
After all, I hope you will find what you are looking for as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
总之，希望你尽快找到要找的东西。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow, welcome back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇，欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I heard a loud sound inside the central room. I tried to get in there, but it had already been blocked.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我听见中央房间里传来一声巨响，想进去看看，但入口已经被封住了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Right. I was bounced out by an unknown force and could not defend the entrance until the end.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是啊，我被一股不明力量弹开了，没能守住入口。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
... What on earth was it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
...那到底是什么？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
On my god ... Seyren Windsor?
And you've found it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
天哪...塞伦·温莎？
你找到它了？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Then we must go back quickly.
Our mission is completed.
Let's go back to the hotel first.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
那我们得赶紧回去。
任务完成了。
先回旅馆吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yeah. The rest of it is our task.
There are still plenty of monster experimental subjects inside, but
That's what we have to contend with.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，剩下的交给我们。
里面还有很多魔物实验体，
但那些就由我们来处理。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Damn, go away!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
可恶，滚开！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, I hate it here.
I want to go back to our hidout soon.
Shall we get out of here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，我讨厌这里。
真想赶紧回据点。
要离开这里吗？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm, are you the type of person who looks for trouble?
Well, we appreciate it if you help us clean up the remnants.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，你是喜欢自找麻烦的人吗？
不过你愿意帮忙清理残党，我们很感激。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Follow me, then.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Shall we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
现在要离开吗？

scripts.text: About the monster in the central room
scripts.translation: 关于中央房间里的魔物

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: About YSF01
scripts.translation: 关于YSF01

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Follow me, then.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Since this fuss is likely to continue for a while, we'd be glad if you would stay here and help us~
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这场骚乱恐怕还会持续一阵子。你愿意留下来帮忙的话，我们会很感激~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why did Werner do that?
I don't understand.
... No. Maybe it's weird to understand a lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
维尔纳为什么要这么做？
我不明白。
...不，想弄懂疯子的想法本来就很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyways, We have to observe the central room's core.
As long as there are magic inside, the same thing will happen again.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
总之，我们得监视中央房间的核心。
只要里面还有魔力，同样的事情就会再次发生。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome.
Without any further ado,
We would like to hunt the ^4d4dffpet child^000000 guy. Will you join us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎。
我就直说了，
我们想猎杀那个^4d4dff小可爱^000000，愿意加入吗？

scripts.text: I am the pet child hunter!
scripts.translation: 我是小可爱猎人！

scripts.text: Reject!
scripts.translation: 拒绝！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, why?
It's just a monster!
We just have to kill it!
Then who should we ask to do it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
为什么不行？
它只是一只魔物！
杀掉它就行了！
那我们还能找谁帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's reveal its secret!
Let's find out why it keeps showing up!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
揭开它的秘密吧！
查清它为什么一直出现！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's in the central room. The place full of strange spirits in the middle of the central room.
Let me open the door for you first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
它就在中央房间里，那个满是奇怪精灵的地方。
我先替你开门。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Great! You're so cool!
Was it a replication of the former experimental subject? Self-replication?
They haven't found out the exact mechanism yet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
太棒了！真厉害！
那是先前实验体的复制品吗？会自我复制？
他们还没弄清楚具体机制。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyhow, thank you for your support.
We will count on you again next time.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
总之，多谢你帮忙。
下次还得拜托你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The same monster is regenerated every single day. Isn't it a bit odd?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
每天都会出现同一种魔物，不觉得奇怪吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Maybe this guy is one of the objects that were split by transplanting the hearts of Ymir ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
也许这家伙是移植伊米尔之心后分裂出来的个体之一...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyway, let's see if that guy shows up again.
It's so~ interesting.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
总之，看看那家伙会不会再出现吧。
真是太~有趣了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you call it a pet child?
Seems like they are completely leaving that guy to the adventurer
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你叫它“小可爱”？
看来他们把这家伙全交给冒险者处理了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you want, do not hesitate to tell me any time.
I will give you a mission to kill the pet child.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
想接任务的话随时告诉我。
我会交给你猎杀小可爱的任务。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion squadder]
Do you want me to send you out of the operation zone?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者队员]
要我送你离开行动区域吗？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Rebellion squadder]
Well, good luck.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者队员]
好，祝你顺利。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏里东西太多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... How many more facilities like this are there in Schwaltzvalt?
Haa ...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...施瓦茨瓦尔特还有多少这样的设施？
唉...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Fortunately, the letter seems to have arrived.
There is a reward that we prepared for you but we have not given it to you yet. So I sent this letter to invite you.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
幸好信似乎已经送到了。
我们早就为你准备了奖励，却一直没机会给你，所以才寄信邀请你过来。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
And our president said that his excellency would grant you enough compensation if you continue to help us get rid of the unwanted experimental subjects.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
总统说，如果你愿意继续帮忙清除那些不需要的实验体，他会给你相应的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
As you helped our republic, his excellency is trying to get you some useful stuff for adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你帮了共和国的忙，总统正想给你准备些冒险者用得上的东西。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The ^4d4dffSchwartz Honor Token^000000 that I am about to give you is a sort of reward currency used in the Rebellion as well.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我接下来给你的^4d4dff施瓦茨荣誉徽章^000000，也是反叛者使用的一种奖励货币。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since you are an adventurer, we thought it would be helpful for you.
You can exchange it for an item you need.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你是冒险者，拿着它应该能派上用场。
可以用来兑换你需要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You may have received it already through the Rebellion.
Since this token is a prize for someone who did a job for Schwaltzvalt ...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你可能已经从反叛者那里领过这种徽章了。
这是给帮助施瓦茨瓦尔特完成任务之人的奖励...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If you want, you can receive them by continuing to help us.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
只要继续帮我们，就能再得到一些。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So, we would like to give you simple requests or missions.
This kind of association is likely to continue for a while.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
所以我们想委托你一些简单的差事或任务。
这种合作恐怕还会持续一阵子。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
先谢谢你的协助。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since there are still some researchers hiding inside the laboratory, we plan to investigate it.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
实验室里还有一些研究员躲着，我们打算继续搜查。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Please take charge of the investigation.
If you do this for us, we will give you the Schwartz Honor Token.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
请负责调查。
完成后，我们会给你施瓦茨荣誉徽章。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Not now?
Then get some rest and come back please.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
现在不方便吗？
那就先休息一下，之后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since we don't know where they are hiding, start looking in corners such as cabinets and boxes.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们不知道他们藏在哪里，先找找柜子、箱子之类的角落。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
After finding researchers, please hand them over to a Rebellion squad member near you.
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
找到研究员后，请把他们交给附近的反叛者队员。
先谢谢你的协助。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Inside the laboratory, there are still some researchers hiding somewhere.
Please find them and hand them over to a Rebellion squad member.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
实验室里还有研究员藏着。
请找到他们，交给反叛者队员。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
先谢谢你的协助。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We already heard of your performance from the Rebellion.
Thank you for cooperating with the republic.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
反叛者已经告诉我们你的表现了。
感谢你协助共和国。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We attacked them all of a sudden, and we expect more of them are still hiding. But we will find them sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们突然发动袭击，估计还有不少人藏着。不过迟早会把他们找出来。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We attacked them all of a sudden, and we expect more of them are still hiding.
We will try to find those guys for now.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们突然发动袭击，估计还有不少人藏着。
眼下先把他们找出来。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If possible, I would ask you to investigate again.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
方便的话，想请你再调查一次。

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交给我吧

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Tess]
.......
Then we cannot afford it.
... No, no.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...
那我们可承担不起。
...不，不是那样。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You're so cool, as usual.
Then could you please find the dregs hiding deep inside the laboratory and shaking like leaves?
I mean, the researchers.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你真可靠。
能不能请你找出躲在实验室深处、吓得发抖的那些家伙？
我是说研究员。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
As usual, please find the researchers who are hiding and hand them over to a Rebellion squad member.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
照旧，找到躲起来的研究员后，把他们交给反叛者队员。

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
No ... why did I volunteer for this?
scripts.translation:
[尤德米尔]
不...我当初为什么要主动报名？

scripts.text: What's wrong with the Gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 枪手怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
Gunslinger is a place made by the Rebellion to train the upcoming generation, so they have a close relationship.
scripts.translation:
[尤德米尔]
枪手训练营是反叛者培养新一代成员的地方，双方关系很密切。

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
I heard that there was special training with the Rebellion so I volunteered. And what am I doing now?
I never imagined that I would be sent to this laboratory full of monsters!
scripts.translation:
[尤德米尔]
听说反叛者有特别训练，我就主动报名了。结果我现在在做什么？
我做梦也没想到会被派到这座满是魔物的实验室！

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
Arrrgh, especially Ms. Elena ... She makes us suffer ...
scripts.translation:
[尤德米尔]
啊...尤其是埃琳娜小姐...她把我们折腾惨了...

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Inside the laboratory, there is pandemonium due to the experimental subjects that broke out.
Although we kill them, more of them come out from somewhere. I came out rest for a while.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
实验体逃出来后，实验室里一片混乱。
我们杀掉一批，又有更多从不知哪里冒出来。我出来歇口气。

scripts.text: Help him defeat Chimeras.
scripts.translation: 帮他击败凯美拉

scripts.text: Wish him good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝他好运

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Well ... Yeah. This is a part of training, too. Phew.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
嗯...没错，这也是训练的一部分。呼。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Then, please kill 10 of each
^4d4dffMaterial type Chimeras^000000 and
^4d4dffHuman type Chimeras^000000
wandering around in the laboratory!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
请去击败在实验室里游荡的^4d4dff物质型凯美拉^000000和^4d4dff人型凯美拉^000000，各10只！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Thanks to your support, we can pause for breath!
Cheer up, Adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
多亏你帮忙，我们总算能喘口气了！加油，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Just defeat 10 of each type. That's all I ask.
They are ^4d4dffMaterial type Chimeras and Human type Chimeras.^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
每种击败10只就行了。
分别是^4d4dff物质型凯美拉和人型凯美拉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
... The In Vivo Experiment is really horrible.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
...活体实验真是太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Wow, you did a great job for us!
Thank you.
Thanks to your support, we managed to get a good rest.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
哇，你帮了我们大忙！
谢谢你。
多亏你，我们总算能好好休息了。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Please be with us next time!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
下次也请来帮忙！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Hey, thank you for your great job.
But there are still more monsters inside.
We are trying our best to get rid of them. But honestly, it's tough.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
嘿，干得漂亮，谢谢你。
不过里面还有很多魔物。
我们正在努力清理，但说实话，实在难对付。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Where do all of these experimental subjects come from?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
这些实验体到底是从哪儿冒出来的？

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
They come out continuously. I can't imagine how many experiments they conducted.
I mean, Chimeras.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
它们不停地出现，真不敢想他们做了多少实验。
我是说凯美拉。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
I never imagined that Chimeras would be tougher than Heart Hunters ...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯兰]
我真没想到凯美拉比心之猎手还难对付...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't pick a fight with USU recklessly.
When people start fighting, I'll be the only one who feels annoyed.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
别随便跟USU的人起冲突。
真打起来，最后烦心的只有我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Although I leashed them, they keep thinking about running out ...
Maybe their brains are filled with gunpowder. Silly weirdos.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我明明把他们拴住了，他们还是一直想着溜出去...
脑子里大概全是火药吧，一群怪人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Cookie? I don't like sweets.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
绿饼人？我不爱吃甜食。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Lebedev guys baked it...
Then, I have no choice but to taste it. Give it to me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
列别捷夫那群人烤的啊...
那我只能尝尝了。拿来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Why are you empty-handed? Where is the cookie?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...你怎么空着手？饼干呢？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
It smells good.
Seems like they gave a great effort. Tell them thanks.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
闻起来不错。
看来他们很用心，替我谢谢他们。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Wait, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
等等，你是谁？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I haven't seen you before.
You can't be in this place. Strangers like you are not supposed to be here.
^FF0000>>>Snap<<<^000000
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我以前没见过你。
你不该出现在这里。陌生人不能进来。
^FF0000>>>弓身弹影<<<^000000

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Tell me exactly how you got here and where you came from unless you want to die.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
除非你想送命，否则就老实交代你怎么进来的、从哪里来的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am... You revealed you're an adventurer who came to help Secret Wings and requested cooperation to the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...你发现自己是来协助秘密之翼的冒险者，并请求反叛者合作。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Secret Wings? They are just rookies. All they do is suck up to the president.
You're so brave. Who told you to visit me?
I don't want to dance to chicks flapping their wings. Just go away.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
秘密之翼？不过是一群菜鸟，整天只会讨好总统。
你胆子倒不小。谁让你来见我的？
我可不想被那些乳臭未干的小丫头摆布。滚吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, wait please. In fact, I... no, my companion...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，等等！其实是我...不，是我的同伴...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Your companion saved Gonie?
...... So? You want a reward?
I really hate those who try to use other's lives as they please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你的同伴救了戈尼？
...所以呢，想要报酬？
我最讨厌拿别人的性命当筹码的人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well... I have a better idea.
Unlike the wimp chatting downstairs, you look quite interesting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗯...我倒有个更好的主意。
你可比楼下那个只会瞎聊的软蛋有意思多了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You said you were just an adventurer, didn't you?
Great. If you defeat me in a fight, I will listen to your story.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你说自己只是个冒险者，对吧？
很好，打赢我，我就听你说。

Don't you think you've had enough of it by now? If you want to quit, tell me any time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你还没受够吗？想退出的话随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Hmm. You're not in a top condition?
If you want to do this again, welcome.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...嗯，状态不太好吗？
想再挑战的话，随时欢迎。

scripts.text: Enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 进入候场室

scripts.text: Do not enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不进候场室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ho, you have the guts.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
呵，有胆量。
伊万会带你进去。
想投降就告诉索丽塔。
来吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I like it.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我喜欢。
伊万会带你进去。
想投降就告诉索丽塔。
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're not in a top condition? Go inside and take some rest.
Shall we stop?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
状态不好吗？进去休息一下吧。
还要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're not in a top condition?
Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
状态不太好吗？
照顾好自己。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't make me feel sorry for you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
别让我替你感到难堪。

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放弃战斗

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 继续战斗

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hey, you don't have to do this...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
喂，你没必要非得这样...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great, I will be waiting.
I enjoy fighting you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
好，我等着。
我很喜欢和你交手。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Right. Let's stop the fight.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
好吧，结束战斗。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...We have no choice. Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...看来也只能这样了。以后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I told you that I'd ^0000CDgo easy on you^000000. Although won the fight, you didn't actually win it. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我说过会^0000CD手下留情^000000。你虽然赢了，但那不算真正打赢我。明白吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Being mean is not my character. This is why I don't want to be entangled with clerics...
Hey, pronounce the benediction for me before leaving.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...我可没那么刻薄。这就是我不想和牧师打交道的原因...
喂，走之前给我施个祝福。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hahaha, great fight!
What a pity. I wanted to win today...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈哈，打得真精彩！
可惜，我今天本来想赢的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I'm glad that you are becoming stronger.
I can see the result of steady training.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
看到你越来越强，我很高兴。
看来你一直在认真训练。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Come back. I can fight you everyday.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
再来吧，我随时奉陪。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Not busy? That's good.
Enjoy it while you can.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
不忙吗？那很好。
趁现在好好享受吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Not busy? That's good news.
Apart from fighting... I would like to ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
不忙？那正好。
除了打架...我还想请你帮个忙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I'm not sure if I can say this to an outsider... But you are close to the Rebellion now.
Will you keep the secret?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我不确定该不该告诉外人...不过你现在和反叛者关系不错。
你能替我保密吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我愿意

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 这会很困难

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Then I can't tell you.
Forget what I've said.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...那我就不能告诉你了。
忘了我刚才说的话吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Yes. Make sure you keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
好。记得保守秘密。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. First of all... do you know about USU that I am commanding?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
很好。首先...你知道我指挥的USU是什么吗？

scripts.text: Superior... unit?
scripts.translation: 超级...部队？

scripts.text: Isn't it where you isolated problem children?
scripts.translation: 不是专门收容问题儿童的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... No. It's not true.
It's actually the opposite.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...不是，才不是那样。
其实恰恰相反。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... What?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...什么？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha... Kaka. Right. You know very well about it.
But don't say that in front of the troops. They might shoot you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈哈...咔咔。没错，你还挺了解的。
不过别在队员面前这么说，他们可能会开枪。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
USU stands for ^0000CDUnder Seal Unit^000000. It's a group of weirdos who did some crazy things.
Since they had done great job for the Rebellion, we isolate them with lead on their neck rather than death penalty or discharging.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
USU是^0000CDUnder Seal Unit^000000的缩写，是一群做过疯狂事的怪人。
他们曾为反叛者立下大功，所以我们没有处死或开除他们，而是给他们戴上铅项圈，隔离起来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I told you, it's a unit outside our regulation. So I can't tell you about it in detail. But we do several things that Rebellions don't do.
You can imagine all you want, including murder or violence. It will be worse than that.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
正如我所说，这是个不受常规约束的单位，详情我不能透露。不过，我们会做一些反叛者不会做的事。
你尽管往谋杀、暴力之类的方向想，实际情况还要糟。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But we still have a absolute rule. We don't mess up with other Rebellions.
Although we let them do whatever they want outside, we teach them who's holding their lead.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
不过我们有一条铁规：绝不伤害其他反叛者。
他们在外面爱怎么闹都行，但我们会让他们知道谁掌握着他们的铅项圈。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
And there are new members... ^0000CDJana Levedeva^000000 and ^0000CDIlya Lebedev^000000. They are twins and still young.
Although they are young, their ability is outstanding. The problem is that they are out of control.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
最近又来了两个成员...^0000CD雅娜·列别杰娃^000000和^0000CD伊利亚·列别捷夫^000000。他们是年纪还小的双胞胎。
虽然年幼，能力却很出色，只是管不住自己。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
They skip the training and hurt a squadder by causing an accident during training... Recently, they tried to run away from the unit and got caught. So the duty manager and I had a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
他们逃训练，还在训练时闹出事故，伤了一名队员...最近又试图逃离部队，结果被抓了回来。值班主管和我为这事忙坏了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
According to the regulation, we have to discharge them.
... But they are still under age. According to the commander of their former unit, they don't have parents.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
按规定，我们必须开除他们。
...可他们还未成年。据他们原部队的指挥官说，他们没有父母。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If we kick out these guys, they might become hooligans. At the worst, they will be involved in crime.
It sounds funny that I'm saying this as a commander of USU...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
要是把他们赶出去，他们可能会变成街头混混，甚至走上犯罪的路。
我这个USU指挥官说这种话，听起来倒挺讽刺...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
At least I don't want to see kids disgracing themselves.
But by looking at what they are doing, they will live as animals with lead in USU at best.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
至少我不想看着孩子们自甘堕落。
可照他们现在这样，在USU里戴着铅项圈、像野兽一样活着，或许已经算最好的结果了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Maybe they are already regarding me as an enemy. So they won't listen to me.
I know how to make them listen to me. But it will only make the situation worse.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...他们可能已经把我当成敌人，所以不会听我的。
我知道怎么让他们听话，但那只会让情况更糟。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So I request you to check their problem and solve it, adventurer.
If they don't say anything, ask other fellows around them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
所以想请你调查并解决他们的问题，冒险者。
他们要是不肯说，就问问周围的人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Would you help me?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: I will help.
scripts.translation: 我愿意帮忙

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I don't want to demand you to do this.
It's a problem inside our unit. So we'd better handle ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我不想勉强你。
这是我们部队内部的问题，最好还是自己解决。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Forget what I told you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
把我刚才说的话忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Thanks.
^0000CDYana and Ilya twins^000000 are in the lobby.
They have bright silver hairs and they're always together. You'll find them easily.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
谢谢。
^0000CD雅娜和伊利亚这对双胞胎^000000在大厅里。
他们有一头亮银色的头发，总是形影不离，很容易认出来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In case you don't get any outcome after talking to them, talk to other fellows.
The mess personnel... and another fellow in the outside store seems to want to say something.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
如果和他们谈不出结果，就问问其他人。
比如食堂的工作人员...还有外面商店里的那个人，他似乎也有话想说。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So, you talked to them?
Hmm, not yet...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
谈过了吗？
嗯，还没有啊...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You are the only one I can trust now.
I'll count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
现在我只能相信你了。
拜托你了，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Did you talk to them?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你和他们谈过了吗？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you cannot judge it easily, you can talk to ^0000CDother fellows around them^000000.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
要是拿不准，就去问问^0000CD他们周围的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So, how is it going?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm... Not at all?
I though they might open their mind to a stranger. But I was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
嗯...一点进展也没有吗？
我还以为他们会对陌生人敞开心扉，看来是我想错了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...There's someone you should talk to lastly.
I didn't want to do this.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...最后还有个人你得去谈谈。
我本来不想这么做的。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Go downstairs and find ^0000CDEricsson Adler, commander of a detached force^000000. He must be nearby the fireplace.
He's middle-aged man... and a former boss of the twins.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
去楼下找^0000CD独立分队指挥官埃里克松·阿德勒^000000，他应该在壁炉附近。
他是个中年人...也是那对双胞胎以前的上司。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since the guys have been assigned to my unit, I wanted to take care of them here. But they're not helping us.
If I ask Adler about the guys, it won't look so good. That's why I am requesting you. Please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
他们既然被分到我的部队，我本想在这里照看他们，可他们一直不配合。
我直接去问阿德勒会显得不太好，所以才请你帮忙。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
^0000CDEricsson Adler, commander of a detached force^000000 must be nearby the fireplace.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
^0000CD独立分队指挥官埃里克松·阿德勒^000000应该在壁炉附近。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
He's a former boss of the twins.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
他是那对双胞胎以前的上司。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
How's it going on now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
现在进展如何？

scripts.text: You told Elena Volkova what Lebedev twins told you.
scripts.translation: 你把列别捷夫双胞胎告诉你的事转告给埃琳娜·沃尔科娃。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So... That was the reason.
I had already heard about that accident.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
原来...是这么回事。
那场事故我早就听说了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But I had no idea they were feeling such a burden.
Since they were out of control... there was no way for me to recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
但我没想到他们一直背负着这么大的压力。
他们当时行为失控...我也就没能察觉。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well, they're still kids after all. Since they have great ability, Me and other squadders treated them as adults.
We should not have done it...
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
他们终究还是孩子。能力又那么出众，我和其他队员就把他们当大人看待了。
我们本不该这样...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
And I should have talked to Adler beforehand.
Thanks, {0}. You helped me so much.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
而且我应该早点和阿德勒谈谈。
谢谢你，{0}，你帮了我大忙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I guess I have to tell them something anyway.
Will you help me once again? Tell them that I'm looking for them. And you come with them please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
不管怎样，我都得和他们谈谈。
能再帮我一次吗？告诉他们我在找他们，然后陪他们一起回来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
The twins will be nearby the place where they've always been.
Tell them about me and come back with them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
双胞胎应该还在平时待的地方附近。
告诉他们我找他们，再带他们回来。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So you're all here? I've heard the whole story.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你们都来了啊？事情经过我已经听说了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
是。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......Yes...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...是...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Jana Levedeva and Ilya Lebedev! Attention!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
雅娜·列别杰娃、伊利亚·列别捷夫！立正！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you insane? You ran away from the unit for a private reason. And you hurt your companion!
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你们疯了吗？为了私事擅自离队，还伤了同伴！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This may look like a mercenary group like a piece of garbage. But we deal with people's life. We have disciplines that you must abide by.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我们看起来也许像一群乌合之众，但我们肩负着他人的性命，有必须遵守的纪律。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......
scripts.translation:
[列别捷夫双胞胎]
...

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......We're sorry...
scripts.translation:
[列别捷夫双胞胎]
...对不起...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But before I scold you about it...
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
不过在责备你们之前...
我得先向你们道歉。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I didn't know that you had been forced so much and could not consider it. And I wasn't there for counseling even though I was your boss.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
我不知道你们承受了这么大的压力，也没考虑到你们的处境。身为上级，我却没能及时开导你们。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This is totally my fault and my mistake.
I apologize. You had a rough time of it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
这完全是我的责任，是我做错了。
对不起，让你们受苦了。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......No, no... We have to apologize.
scripts.translation:
[列别捷夫双胞胎]
...不，不...该道歉的是我们。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
From now on, I will pay more attention to you.
Would you please try to make sure this never happens again?
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
以后我会多关心你们。
你们也要努力别再让这种事发生，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...No... We are the ones who should apologize.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...不...该道歉的是我们。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
It will never happen again...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
以后绝不会再发生了...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since this is a military group, you have regulations to abide by.
But since you are minors, I would like to give you an opportunity to grow as much as possible.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
这里是军事组织，你们必须遵守规章。
不过你们还未成年，我想给你们机会好好成长。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Jana Levedeva and Ilya Lebedev. I will exclude you from the real fight for some time.
Instead, feel free to do the works that you can do inside the unit.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
雅娜·列别杰娃、伊利亚·列别捷夫，我会暂时不让你们参加实战。
这段时间就在部队里做些力所能及的事吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You can make new friends, start a hobby or enhance your shooting ability. You can even do things that I cannot expect.
Do what you want to do. Make sure you abide by the regulations.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你们可以交朋友、培养兴趣，或练习射击。想做些别的也行。
做自己想做的事，但别违反规定。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
So we're... not being kicked out?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
所以...我们不会被开除？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't make me say it twice. I told you I was responsible for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
别让我重复。我说过，这件事由我负责。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Oh... Thank you so much!
And... Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
哦...真的太感谢了！
还有...对不起。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Thank you, commander...!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
谢谢您，指挥官...！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
That's all about it. You can go back now. There's something I'd like to discuss with the adventurer.
And if you need anything, talk to me any time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
事情就是这样。你们可以回去了，我还有事要和冒险者谈。
需要帮忙的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[列别捷夫双胞胎]
是！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Phew...
Great job, {0}.
Thanks to your support and concern, we managed to do this.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
呼...
干得好，{0}。
多亏你支持并关心他们，我们才顺利解决了这件事。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ha... I told them to do what they want. And they will wonder what to do for a while.
For those guys to do what they want, they'll need your help again.
Please help them at that time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈...我让他们做自己想做的事，他们可能一时还不知道该做什么。
那两个孩子还需要你的帮助。
到时候请多照应他们。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
......Thanks.
I will count on you in the future.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
...谢谢。
今后也拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you taking care of them well?
Wow, I am relieved that they have a babysitter now.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
你把他们照顾得不错嘛？
哇，现在有人看着他们，我就放心了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha! Just kidding. Thank you for your support. You're so reliable.
Take care of the guys please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指挥官 埃琳娜]
哈哈，开玩笑的。谢谢你帮忙，你真可靠。
那群孩子就拜托你照看了。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
What is it now?
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索丽塔]
又怎么了？

scripts.text: I want to go out.
scripts.translation: 我想出去

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
Do not talk to me when you have nothing to say.
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索丽塔]
没事就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
What are you talking about? So you're telling me you would like to run away without fighting? Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索丽塔]
你说什么？你想不战而逃？

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
You must be kidding. What kind of nonsense is this! Why did you come here in the first place and annoy me?
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索丽塔]
开什么玩笑？这是什么蠢话！你一开始来这里就是为了找我麻烦吗？

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
Dang, I have been quite upset after the commander gave me this useless work. And you make me even more upset. Get the hell out of here!
scripts.translation:
[硬汉 索丽塔]
可恶，指挥官派给我这种无聊差事，我已经够烦了。你还来火上浇油。给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你是什么人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you are lost, go downstairs and talk to others.
They will let you know how to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
迷路的话就下楼问问其他人。
他们会告诉你怎么出去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你是什么人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you are lost, go downstairs and talk to the others.
They will let you know how to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
迷路的话就下楼问问其他人。
他们会告诉你怎么出去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Hey, you two there!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
喂，你们两个！

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Yes!!! Yep!!!
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
是！！！到！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Escort this adventurer safely downstairs.
Seems like he has lost his way.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
安全地把这位冒险者带到楼下。
看来他迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Yes! I will!!!!
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
是！遵命！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
And if by any chance...... Well, I guess you already know that part. I will hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
要是出了什么事...算了，后面的事你应该清楚。交给你了。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Oh.. Yes Sir!
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
哦...遵命，长官！

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
请跟我来，这边走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait!

[Rebellion leader]
Is there anything else?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
还有什么事？

scripts.text: Tell the leader about having saved Gonie.
scripts.translation: 告诉首领你救了戈尼

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Oh!
I see!
Thank you so much for helping our youngster.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
哦！
原来如此！
非常感谢你救了我们的年轻成员。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Hmm.. As I expected......
Gonie......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
嗯...果然如此...
戈尼...

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
The one who went to Einbroch not long ago......
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
就是不久前去艾音布罗克的那个人...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Ah!
That guy?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
啊！
是那家伙？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Haha!
This fellow is full of chivalry! It's difficult to find people like this nowadays.
Normally they just pass by......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
哈哈！
这家伙真有侠义心肠！如今这样的人可不多了。
一般人都会直接走掉...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Especially after finding that he was wearing a Rebellion suit.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
尤其是知道他穿着反叛者制服之后，更没人愿意帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
By looking at your eyes, I see you haven't come to hear gratitude from us.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
看你的眼神就知道，你不是来听我们道谢的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
The man called Lazy who came with you...
He's been wandering around here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
和你一起来的那个懒散...
他一直在这一带打转。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You helped Gonie by chance. But you didn't come here by chance. Did you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你救戈尼或许是偶然，但你来这里绝不是偶然，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You'd better think twice before you answer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
回答前最好想清楚。

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 谈谈合作

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Be careful on your way home.
The public order is not so good in this area.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
回去时小心。
这一带治安不太好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Help?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Ha...
I think you are misunderstanding something.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
哈...
我看你是误会了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Surely, I want to express my gratitude for what you did for Gonie.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你救了戈尼，我当然想向你道谢。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
But!
What you are saying now is a totally different issue.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
但是！
你现在说的是另一回事。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Secret Wings?
Ha! Don't make me laugh!
The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
秘密之翼？
哈，别逗我笑了！
你既然提起他们，就说明你知道我们和他们的关系，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
如果你什么都不知道，那就只是被人利用了。识相的话，赶紧回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
This is all I can tell you.
Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我能说的就这些。
请回吧。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
请跟我来，这边走。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Leave the adventurer alone.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
别管那个冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
He must know his position better than anyone else.
The man called Lazy, too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
他应该比谁都清楚自己的处境。
那个叫懒散的也是。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Secret Wings?
Ha! Don't make me laugh!
The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
秘密之翼？
哈，别逗我笑了！
你既然提起他们，就说明你知道我们和他们的关系，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
如果你什么都不知道，那就只是被人利用了。识相的话，赶紧回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
This is all I can tell you.
Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我能说的就这些。
请回吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What is it?
Are you still here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
什么事？
你还没走？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
If I didn't see a ghost, you are living a pretty long life. Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
要是我没看错，你还真是命大。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
长官！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ah!
Guard leader!
Good that you're here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊！
卫队长！
你来得正好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Take this fellow out, now.
I thought you would leave on your own, if you cared for your life. But you are still hanging around here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
现在就把这家伙赶出去。
我还以为惜命的话你早就走了，没想到还赖在这里。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's so annoying to see this rat wandering around in my space.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
看这只老鼠在我的地盘上乱窜，真让人心烦。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
There's something more important now. Here's a letter from Dien.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
现在有更重要的事。这是迪恩寄来的信。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
A letter from Dien?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
迪恩的信？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yes. Here it is...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
是，给您...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's quite unusual to receive a letter from her.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
她居然会写信来，真少见。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me see... I agree. Do you agree, too?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我看看...我同意。你也同意吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm?
Agree with what?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
嗯？
同意什么？

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 谈谈合作

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm..........
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader...
I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长...
我好像看见了幽灵。你要读读这封信吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yeah?
Yes! Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
啊？
遵命！长官！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm.........
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader...
I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长...
我好像看见了幽灵。你要读读这封信吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yeah?
Yes! Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
啊？
遵命！长官！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What?
The commander?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
什么？
指挥官？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What the hell... Is that jerk still alive after sending this letter to the commander?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
搞什么...那个混蛋给指挥官寄了这封信，居然还活着？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What did the commander say?
He is not the type of a man who would just sit down after listening to it. Is he?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
指挥官怎么说？
他可不是听完就会袖手旁观的人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Erst agrees with it, too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
厄斯特也同意了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ha!
This is nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
哈！
胡说八道。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I cannot accept this.
I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我不能接受。
我不知道你对他们说了什么，但我还要再和他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
Where is Dien?
In the room?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长！
迪恩在哪儿？
在房间里吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
鲁伯特，不用进来了。
外面太吵，我就出来看看。原来是你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I cannot accept this.
I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我不能接受。
我不知道你对他们说了什么，但我还要再和他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
Where is Dien?
In the room?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长！
迪恩在哪儿？
在房间里吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
鲁伯特，不用进来了。
外面太吵，我就出来看看。原来是你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
What are you doing!
Escort Dien to the room.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
卫队长！
你在做什么！
送迪恩回房间。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You and I just do not appear to communicate.
I didn't know you were so stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
看来我们就是没法好好沟通。
没想到你这么固执...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's all because of you, Dien.
I still remember you telling me a story about them. You were so angry with them. Now you make this choice.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
这都是你害的，迪恩。
我还记得你以前提起他们时有多愤怒。现在你却做出这种决定。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
As you put on years, your memory and judgment are not as good as they used to be.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
年纪大了，记忆和判断力都不如从前了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What!
What have you just said!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
什么！
你刚才说什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
At that time, you were just an infant in diapers. How do you happen to know so much about them?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
那时候你还只是个穿尿布的婴儿，怎么会知道那么多？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Did you experience that incident yourself?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
那场事故是你亲身经历的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I'm the one who saved your life during the ravage of war.
And just look at your big mouth now!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
当年战乱时，是我救了你一命。
你看看你现在这张嘴！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Is it the way I taught you?
Come on, say that again!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
这是我教你的吗？
来，再说一遍！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrggh!!!
What the hell are you doing!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊啊！！
你在干什么！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Just release your hold.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
快放手。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Dien! Please calm down!
You shouldn't do this here!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
迪恩！冷静点！
别在这里动手！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You just shut up!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你给我闭嘴！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Ha...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
哈...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Whatever you say, I'm against it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
不管你说什么，我都反对！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You are still chattering with the big mouth!
Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你这张嘴还真是停不下来啊！
不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrggh!!!
Come on, it hurts!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊啊！！
喂，痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What are you doing! They are all looking at you!!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
你在干什么！大家都看着呢！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Well, I don't care who's looking at me.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
哼，我才不在乎谁看着。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What have you done so far with that vengeance alone?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你光想着复仇，这些年到底做成什么了？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Are you going to hate them forever, doing nothing until I die?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你打算一直恨他们，什么都不做，直到我死吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
How many years do you think I have ahead!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
你觉得我还能活多少年！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
By looking at you now, I'm sure you can live for 100 more years!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
看你现在这精神头，我敢说你还能活一百年！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Great!
Let me live for 100 more years and pull out your beard!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
好啊！
那我就再活一百年，把你的胡子拔光！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrgh!!!!
Stop it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊！！
住手！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ah!
Okay! I got it!
Do as you wish!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
啊！
好好好，我知道了！
随你便！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Here you go.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
给你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
But you will to have to face the consequences. Be prepared!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
不过你得承担后果。等着瞧！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
That's exactly what I was hoping for.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
这正合我意。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
No...
Guard leader!
Tell each senior and commander to gather now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
不...
卫队长！
通知所有前辈和指挥官，立刻集合。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me make this clear.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我把话说清楚。
我们会帮你，但别指望我们出太多力。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我们没有理由为你们牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Hey! You are saying this again!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
喂！你又来了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Since you got the approval from Rupert, {0} why don't you go back for report?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
既然鲁伯特已经同意了，{0}，你回去汇报吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
It seems like the youngsters will be busy for a while. Please help the old people, whenever you have time.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
年轻人们接下来会忙一阵子。有空的话，也请帮帮我们这些老人家。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Ah!! Rupert!
Talk to me before the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
啊！鲁伯特！
开会前先跟我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me make this clear.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我把话说清楚。
我们会帮你，但别指望我们出太多力。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我们没有理由为你们牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
I read it, too. What you have said just now was written there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
我也看过了。你刚才说的内容，信里都写了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
The same thing was written in the letter that I handed to Erst.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
我交给厄斯特的那封信里，写的也是同样的内容。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Dien!
It's dangerous outside. There are outsiders there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
迪恩！
外面有危险，还有外人。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's alright. Larcis.
They are not so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
没事，拉西斯。
他们没什么威胁。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Dien!
I was about to visit you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
迪恩！
我正要去找你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Your letter... What does it mean?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
你那封信...是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
As written in the letter.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
信里写的就是我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Are you saying that you agreed to help the Secret Wings?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
你是说你同意帮助秘密之翼？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Yes.
As I wrote in the letter.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
是的。
信里已经写得很清楚了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Ridsh, Cotnes and I will agree to help the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
里德什、科特内斯和我，都同意帮助秘密之翼。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Even Ridsh and Cotnes...? No. I can't believe that you agree to it, even after I have heard it from you personally.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
连里德什和科特内斯都...？不，我亲耳听你说了，还是不敢相信你们会同意。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I heard Erst agrees as well.
Since there are so many people who agree to it, you should not resist it alone.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我听说厄斯特也同意了。
既然这么多人都赞成，你也别一个人硬扛。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I can't laugh it off this time.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
这次我可笑不出来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
You are the one who knows how silly this is more than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
没人比你更清楚这件事有多荒唐。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Of course I do.
That's why I accepted it.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我当然清楚。
所以我才答应。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Why!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
为什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
The time is passing. Rupert.
We cannot stick on the same spot forever.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
时间不等人，鲁伯特。
我们不能永远停在原地。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Although the time passes, it doesn't mean that the past goes away!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
时间会流逝，但过去不会因此消失！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
We sacrificed too much to forget it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我们已经付出太多，怎么可能忘掉！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Regarding this issue, I, as the person in charge here, will decide on it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
这件事由我负责，我会做决定。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Trying to respect you as a senior, I have overlooked your behavior so far. However, this time, you crossed the line.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
我一直尊重你是前辈，才容忍你到现在。但这次你越界了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Now! Please go back to your room and enjoy your tea party.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领 鲁伯特]
现在，回房间去喝茶吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Wait!
I can't ignore what you've just said.
Are you trying to neglect my opinion, and myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
等等！
你刚才那番话我不能当没听见。
你是想无视我的意见，连我这个人也一起无视吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Wait!
I can't ignore what you've just said.
Are you trying to neglect my opinion, and myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
等等！
我不能当没听见你刚才那番话。
你是想无视我的意见，连我这个人也一起无视吗？

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
I joined the Rebellion, because their shooting looked so cool to me. But now I am so busy handling the documents that I have no time to get my hands on a gun.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
我加入反叛者，是因为他们开枪的样子很帅。可现在整天忙着整理文件，连摸枪的时间都没有。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
The problem is that I feel like this work suits me.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
问题是，我觉得这工作还挺适合我。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
When I'm lucky, I can get some snacks from seniors.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
运气好的时候，前辈们还会给我些零食。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
It's amazing that the taste is different when I purchase the snacks myself.
scripts.translation:
[年轻的反叛者]
真奇怪，自己买来的零食吃起来就是不一样。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why do you have so many things here? Your bag has to be light to carry a lot of new stuff.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你怎么带这么多东西？把背包腾空些，才好装新战利品。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why do you have so many things here? Your bag has to be light to carry a lot of new stuff.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你怎么带这么多东西？把背包腾空些，才好装新战利品。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh~ It's wonderful here. It's so cozy. ^0000cdWhat is this place for^000000? I want to stay here for a day.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦~这里真棒，好舒服。^0000cd这是什么地方^000000？我想在这儿待一天。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I never imagined there would be a place like this behind the store... What's this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我真没想到商店后面还有这种地方...这里是做什么的？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
A sanatorium that looks after novices and senior citizens. There is nothing to see here. And it's too cold in here and your mouth might be twisted if you sleep here. That's why you'd better leave after drinking the tea.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
这是照顾新手和老人的疗养院，没什么好看的。这里还很冷，睡在这儿嘴巴可能会冻歪，喝完茶就赶紧走吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are too stingy. How can you do this to me after I saved his life?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你也太小气了。我好歹救了他的命，你怎么能这样？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I gave you a cup of tea and I promised you to compensate. What else do you need?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我给你倒了茶，也答应补偿你了。你还想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
There are things you cannot buy.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
有些东西是钱买不到的。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Well, then, you're leaving me with my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
好吧，那我就只好心怀感激了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No. According to my experience so far, everything that I cannot buy is useless.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不。照我的经验，买不到的东西都没用。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I can't figure out what you want. Have a sit there anyway. I will give you a cup of tea that you desired.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我真搞不懂你要什么。先坐下吧，我给你泡杯你想喝的茶。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Lucky~~~ Where have you been!! I've been waiting for a while! I'm going out for a mission and wish me a good luck.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
拉基~~~你去哪儿了！！我等了好一会儿！我要出任务了，祝我好运吧。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Rookie!!!! Help me arrange the warehouse quickly. There are bunch of them and I can't do it alone. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
新人！！快来帮我整理仓库！东西太多了，我一个人忙不过来。快点！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Hey, I came before you. Didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
喂，我比你先来的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I'm in a hurry!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
可我赶时间！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I have a customer. I will get to you after giving them cups of tea. Both of you, please wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我还有客人，等给他们上完茶就来。你们两个先等一下。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm in a hurry...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我赶时间...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I can wait! I cannot put pressure on Lucky.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我可以等！我不能催拉基。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I can wait too!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我也可以等！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
They are looking for you everywhere. You are so popular. Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
大家到处找你呢，你还真受欢迎啊。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Rookie, where have you been? Everyone's looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
新人，你跑哪儿去了？大家都在找你。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
He has healthy legs, so he can go around.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
他腿脚好着呢，能自己到处跑。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Lucky, bring a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
拉基，泡杯茶。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Lucky, they are strangers. Who are they?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
拉基，这两个人是谁？看着面生。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
They saved Gonie's life. They came to this quiet Einbech. They found injured Gonie ^0000cdaccidentally^000000 and healed him. Then they brought him ^0000cdright^000000 here.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
他们救了戈尼的命，还专程来到这偏僻的艾音贝赫。他们^0000cd偶然^000000发现受伤的戈尼，治好他后，又^0000cd正好^000000把他送来了这里。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes. I did it. I did it!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没错，是我干的！是我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You take too much credit to yourself after helping someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你帮了人就这么爱居功吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You have to exaggerate your performance. That's the way to be appreciated by others.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
得把功劳说得夸张点，别人才会赏识你嘛。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
So, why did you come here? By the way, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
那么，你们来这里做什么？对了，你们是谁？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Me? Lazy. Although it's not my real name, call me Lazy now.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我？叫我懒散就行，虽然这不是真名。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I am an, ^0000cdagent of Secret Wings^000000, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我是^0000cd秘密之翼^000000的特工，该机构直接向施瓦茨瓦尔特总统负责。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey! Why did you tell them who you are all of a sudden? You kept telling me not even to mention it. And you revealed it officially!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂！你怎么突然把身份说出来了？你之前还一直叫我别提这件事，结果自己倒是公开说了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's all right. This is our destination. ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000, the stronghold of Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没关系，这里就是我们的目的地——^0000cd克拉纳·内米埃里^000000，反叛者的据点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then the store outside the door was a ^0000cdtrickery^000000. The collapsed man is a member of ^0000cdRebellion^000000... That's why...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以门外那家店只是个^0000cd幌子^000000，那个倒下的人是^0000cd反叛者^000000成员...我明白了...

scripts.text: Clank.
scripts.translation: 咔哒。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔哒。
咔哒。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔哒。
咔哒。
咔哒。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔哒。
咔哒。
咔哒。
咔哒。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Get out of here now!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
立刻给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
We get rid of them!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
把他们赶出去！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Hey, calm down please! Put your guns in! No wonder you are hot headed elders!!
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
喂，冷静点！把枪收起来！难怪你们这些老前辈脾气这么火爆！！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Although they have come here with a fishy purpose, it's true that they carried injured Gonie all the way here. Behave yourself, old men.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
他们的目的虽然可疑，但确实一路把受伤的戈尼背了过来。你们这些老家伙，冷静点。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are not surprised? So you knew it.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你一点也不惊讶？看来你早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I didn't know who you were. But I knew you had a certain purpose. I had not told you my name but you were shouting 'Come out Rookie'. So I had a clue.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我不知道你们是谁，但知道你们另有目的。我还没告诉你名字，你就在喊“新人出来”，这让我起了疑心。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I heard that the brain of a Rebellion is filled with bullets, but maybe not every Rebellion! So, is your name Lucky, or Rookie?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我听说反叛者个个脑子里都装着子弹，不过看来也不是所有人都这样嘛！所以你到底叫拉基还是新人？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
^0000cdRookie^000000. Lucky is my nickname.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^0000cd我叫新人^000000，拉基是绰号。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Rookie! You already knew who he was, and you..!!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
新人！你早就知道他们是谁了吧？你这家伙...！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I told you! Old men, are you deaf now? I didn't know who they were! This is unfair!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我说了，我不知道他们是谁！老家伙们，你们聋了吗？这不公平！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If they had an intention to attack us, they would have done it already, rather than asking for tea. And what can these two do against many of us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他们要是想袭击我们，早就动手了，何必坐下来喝茶？而且就他们两个，能拿我们这么多人怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Whatever they do, you are going to handle them. Aren't you? You are legends of the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不管他们打什么主意，你们这些反叛者传奇人物肯定能应付吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know where they come from. But by the time they came all the way here, perhaps they need to talk to the seniors. I will bring the tea and enjoy the talk.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道他们来自哪里，但他们大老远赶来，肯定有事要和前辈们谈。我去泡茶，顺便听听。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hahaha! Nice to meet you. Did I surprise you by coming in all of a sudden in leisure hours?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哈哈哈！很高兴见到各位。我突然在休息时间来访，没打扰你们吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But I am not a dangerous person, so please relax. And this adventurer is much less dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不过我不是什么危险人物，放轻松。至于这位冒险者，就更没什么威胁了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This person is an adventurer who settled various problems of the continent, including Schwaltzvalt. The adventurer is currently under the protection of Rune Midgarts Kingdom.{0}
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这位冒险者解决过大陆各地的问题，包括施瓦茨瓦尔特的麻烦，目前受到卢恩·米德加兹王国的保护。{0}

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And I am a member of Secret Wings, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt Republic. Since the President guarantees my identification, you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我是秘密之翼的成员，直接向施瓦茨瓦尔特共和国总统负责。总统能证明我的身份，你们不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
How can I trust you?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
凭什么信你？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
You are the most dangerous guy here!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你才是这里最危险的人！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
President? Since I heard that unpleasant word, let me wash my ears!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
总统？光听到这个讨厌的词，我就想洗洗耳朵！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What is a spoiled crow of the President doing here?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
总统的宠儿跑到这里来干什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's what I am about to tell you now. Haha. So please put your guns down... Let's sit down first.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这正是我要解释的事。哈哈，先把枪放下...我们坐下来谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Hey, you are standing up too!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
喂，你自己不也站着吗！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ahaha. I've got a disease that I can't sit down. By the way... As a guest, I couldn't come here with empty hands. This is a specialty good of Yuno... Please have some.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
啊哈哈，我有病，坐不下来。对了...既然是客人，总不能空手来。这是尤诺特产...请尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Guest? You're just a jerk.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
客人？你只是个混蛋。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What do you mean by guest? We never invited you.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你算什么客人？我们可没邀请你。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
We never know what you put on this food! There is nothing we would like to hear from you. So get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
谁知道你在食物里下了什么！我们没什么要听的，滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Drink tea, please.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
请喝茶。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
As soon as you drink the tea, leave at once~ We won't see you off!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
喝完就赶紧走~我们可不送你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Where are you going? I brought the tea in reference to the number of people here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你去哪儿？我可是照人数把茶都拿来了。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I don't drink tea in uncomfortable place. I don't want to have an upset stomach while drinking tea.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我才不在这种不自在的地方喝茶，免得喝得胃不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on, what's wrong with you~ You can drink it so quickly. It's not good after it gets cold. Your stomach must have got cold by now. You're not so healthy either.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，你这是怎么了~茶得趁热喝，凉了就不好了。你的胃八成已经着凉了，身体也不太好嘛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can't you just drink the tea before leaving? I struggled to get this tea... You also liked it...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喝完茶再走不行吗？我费了好大劲才弄到这些茶...你明明也喜欢喝...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
And if we feel uncomfortable, they also feel uncomfortable. So it's not such a bad condition. Come on. Drinking a cup of tea is not a hard thing to do.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
而且我们不舒服，他们也会不舒服，这不正好吗？来吧，喝杯茶又不难。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I mean, the spoiled crow of the President-
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我只是说，总统的宠儿——

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please. The tea is innocent. have a peaceful tea time. Never fight in front of food. You taught me all these words. Didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜托，茶是无辜的。大家好好喝茶，别在食物面前争吵。这些话不都是你教我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Ahem, ahem.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wow~ This tea is great. It matches well with this specialty good. Try it. The President prepared it for you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哇~这茶真好喝，配这道特色点心正合适。尝尝吧，这是总裁特意为你准备的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please listen to me. I'm here to ask you a very difficult request.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
请听我说。我这次来，是想拜托你们一件非常棘手的事。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Why should we accept a difficult request?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们为什么要接受一个困难的请求？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why I came here. This mission cannot be accomplished by anyone except Rebellion. So the President sent me here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以我才来这里。这项任务只有反叛者才能完成，总裁才派我前来。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I think it will be such a confidential and cautious story. Please take this...
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这件事需要高度保密，也得谨慎处理。请先收下这个...

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Just tell us your point.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
直接说重点。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes! Although you pretend not to know, it's the story you all know.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
是的！虽然你们装作不知道，但这其实是你们都知道的故事。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The President certainly regrets what happened in the past. His excellency has always been thinking about you and wanted to start a talk.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总裁确实对过去发生的事感到后悔。他一直挂念着你们，也想找机会谈一谈。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Upon your approval, his excellency wants to meet you in person, apologize, and wants to have an opportunity to harmonize with you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
只要你们同意，总裁就想亲自与你们见面道歉，希望有机会修复彼此的关系。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I was also extremely sad to hear what happened to you. And I was looking for a chance to meet you and talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听说你们遭遇了那些事，我也非常难过。我一直想找机会和你们见面聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Tell us your point!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
说重点！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are so cool. I like it. Then I will get down to the business.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你们真酷。我喜欢这样。那么我就直入正题了。

scripts.text: [Lazy began to talk about what happened recently and the request of the President.]
scripts.translation: [懒散开始讲起最近发生的事，以及总裁的请求。]

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I see. But it's your business and I don't get why we should help you. Do I?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我明白了。但这是你们的事，我不懂我们为什么要帮忙。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
You ignored us when we were in trouble. And you are asking for help now? How can you do that?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们遇到困难时，你们对我们不闻不问。现在却来求我们帮忙？哪有这样的道理？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Sounds like a bunch of nonsense. I don't want to listen any more.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
简直是一派胡言。我不想再听了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That won't harm you under any circumstances!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
