无论如何，这都不会伤害到你们！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The adventurer approved by the royal family of Rune Midgarts is together with us in this mission.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这次任务还有一位得到卢恩·米德加兹王室认可的冒险者与我们同行。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
With the cooperation of Schwaltzvalt President and Rune Midgarts Kingdom, you can now use the power of the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
施瓦茨瓦尔特总统与卢恩·米德加兹王国携手合作，如今你们也能借助这位冒险者的力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Why would we need the power of the adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们为什么需要冒险者的力量？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
How can we trust a stranger? Are you going to stab us in the back again?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们怎么能信任一个陌生人？难道你又要背后捅我们一刀吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This is your opportunity. Along with this cooperation, you can eliminate the dishonor!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这是你们的机会。通过这次合作，你们可以洗刷耻辱！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you cannot trust the President, please trust the adventurer and the royal family of Rune Midgarts. They have already promised a full support.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你们无法信任总裁，请相信这位冒险者和卢恩·米德加兹王室。他们已经承诺全力支持。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Come on, say somthing.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
拜托，说句话吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right! If you need my help, I will support you actively.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错！如果你需要我的帮助，我会积极支持你。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
This is not a matter of benefits. It's about our feeling!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
这不是利益问题，而是我们的感受！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Lucky, thanks for the tea. Send them now. Let the crow go back to its nest.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
拉基，谢谢你的茶。现在送他们走吧，让乌鸦回巢。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
We will never see them again. So send them gently. Rookie.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
我们再也不会见他们了。新人，客气地送他们离开吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please, you can't leave like this...!!!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
拜托，你们不能就这样离开...!!!

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hmm... I knew it would be difficult. But I'm surprised that they are not even listening to me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嗯...我知道这会很困难。但没想到他们连我的话都不肯听。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew. These old men will never change.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼。这些老头子永远不会变。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Your name is Rookie. Right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你的名字是新人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You know it already. Why do you ask?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你早就知道了。为什么还要问？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Sorry. I guess I made a wrong judgment. I should have collected more accurate information.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
抱歉，我判断错了。我本该先收集更准确的情报。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's wrong with you? You make me nervous.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你到底怎么了？你让我感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Before I came here, I knew people who were sitting here had the authority, but I now realize that it is a little different.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
来之前，我知道坐在这里的人有话语权，但现在看来，实际情况并非如此。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Unless you live here, it's hard to find out who has the authority.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果不是住在这里的人，很难弄清楚究竟谁说了算。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know what you are talking about. If you finished drinking the tea, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道你在说什么。如果你茶喝完了，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Rookie, please help us. If you think about it, you can tell that it's a win-win proposition. You don't want to hide yourself in this corner of the woods forever, do you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
新人，请帮帮我们。仔细想想，这对双方都有好处。你不想永远躲在这片森林的角落里吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You know that this is the opportunity to take advantage of the government's support and compassion for you. It will provide better fundamentals for Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这是借助政府支持、改善你们处境的机会。这也能为反叛者打下更好的基础。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If this works well. you'll be free to work in Schwaltzvalt and Rune Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果一切顺利，你们就能自由往来于施瓦茨瓦尔特和卢恩·米德加兹王国。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Look at this place. It's just a tiny shop. Can you call it headquarters? Don't you want to reclaim your glory?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看看这里，不过是间小店，哪像总部？你们不想重振昔日荣光吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
And when we are in trouble, you'll abandon us again. There are still many people who haven't washed the wound from what happened in the past. Do you really think they'll help you?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
可我们一遇到麻烦，你们就会再次抛弃我们。过去发生的事留下的创伤，许多人至今还没愈合。你真觉得他们会帮你们吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why I am asking for your help. I guess you can change their mind by persuading them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以我才请求你的帮助。我想你可以说服他们改变主意。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who? Me?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
谁？我？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
In every place, there is a hidden key person who moves the whole group even though you cannot that person easily. Here, it's you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
每个团体里都有一位隐藏的关键人物，平时不容易被人发现，却能推动整个团体。在这里，那个人就是你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, I guess you are overrating me. They regard me as an unimportant guy here. I dont't take any important mission. All I do is errands and clean-ups. Do you honestly think I'm a key person?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，我想你太高看我了。这里的人觉得我无足轻重。我从没接过重要任务，只负责跑腿和打扫。你真觉得我是关键人物吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No, no. That's not what I am talking about. Normally they call it a mood maker.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不，不是那个意思。通常大家会把这种人称作“气氛担当”。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
A while ago, you convinced the old men to listen to me. That's what I am talking about. You have such abilities.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
刚才你说服了那些老前辈听我把话说完。我指的就是这个，你有这种本事。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know what you mean by 'such abilities'. But I guess you have nothing to talk about by now. The seniors are gone.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道你说的“这种本事”是什么。不过现在你也没什么可说的了，前辈们都走了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why I'm trying to help you. Please convince others.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以我才试图帮助你。请说服其他人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have nowhere else to go. Neither does everyone else here. We cannot just help you trusting your promise.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我无处可去，这里其他人也一样。我们不能只凭你的一句承诺就帮你们。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It may be a matter of cooperation for you. But for us, it's a matter of survival.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
对你来说，这可能只是合作的问题。但对我们来说，这是生死攸关的问题。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please. We are also desperate. The fates of the royal family of a country and another country are in danger.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
求求你们。我们也已经走投无路。两个国家的王室都危在旦夕。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But if you help us, we can sort it out. That's something only you can do. We really need your help.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
但如果你帮了我们，一切都能解决。这是只有你能做到的事。我们真的需要你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you really need help, go to someone else.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你真的需要帮助，去找别人吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are as cold as ice. How merciless. Please show some mercy and help us.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你冷得像冰一样。真是无情。请发发慈悲，帮帮我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The people who were sitting here are seniors. They are anchors and symbols of Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
刚才坐在这里的都是前辈。他们是反叛者的支柱，也是反叛者的象征。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
But as they got old, they retired from the front line. Now they drink tea and watch the junior Rebellions grow up.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
但他们年纪大了，已经从前线退下来。如今他们喝茶，看着年轻一代的反叛者成长。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So other people are responsible for all the inside jobs. They are the ones ^0000cdwho move the Rebellion practically^000000. They are decision makers.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以内部事务都由其他人负责。他们才是^0000cd实际推动反叛者运作的人^000000，也是做决定的人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you convince them, the public opinion change. Once the public opinion changes, what can seniors do about it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你说服了他们，舆论就会改变。舆论一旦转向，前辈们还能怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Thank you. I prefer those who are wise and smart like you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
谢谢你。我更喜欢像你这样明智聪明的人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
In my opinion, I think it's better for us to be accepted in a wide world rather than living here like this.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我觉得，与其像现在这样困在这里，不如让外面的广阔世界接纳我们。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer, it's time for you to take an action. Please persuade them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，是时候采取行动了。请说服他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我该这么做吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you seen the response from the seniors? Once I introduce myself, they might shoot at me make dozens of holes in my body.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你没看到前辈们的反应吗？我要是自报家门，他们说不定会朝我开枪，把我打成筛子。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Since those seniors were relatively rational, we are alive and talking like this. If only there was one person with a short-temper... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
幸好那些前辈还算理智，我们才能像现在这样活着聊天。要是其中有个暴脾气的...呼...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer. You are a symbol of faith. Please go and show them your faith. That will take care of everything. Did you see what I did a moment ago? Do as I did.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，你是大家信赖的象征。去向他们证明这一点吧，这样一切都会迎刃而解。刚才我做的你看到了吧？照着做就行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, maybe...

[Rookie]
They are in the ^0000cdroom in the 2nd floor2^000000. You can go up and meet them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他们在^0000cd二楼的房间^000000。你可以上去见他们。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do you see the rooms on the 2nd floor? I don't know how many of them are there. But you only have to meet the most important people.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你看到二楼的房间了吗？我不知道那里有多少个房间。但你只需要见最重要的人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's see... You meet ^0000cdRupert^000000, the strict gentleman and ^0000cdElena^000000, the hunting dog first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
让我想想...你先去见^0000cd鲁伯特^000000，那位严厉的绅士；再见^0000cd埃琳娜^000000，那条猎犬。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
By the way, never call Elena 'hunting dog' in front of her. She's going to disintegrate you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
顺便说一句，千万别在埃琳娜面前叫她“猎犬”。她会把你撕碎的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyone else...? Oh, the next one is the good-hearted ^0000cdold women, I mean ladies^000000. Then you meet the Special Force commander ^0000cdErst^000000...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
还有谁...？哦，接下来是心地善良的^0000cd老太太——我是说女士们^000000。然后是特种部队指挥官^0000cd厄斯特^000000...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You can meet these ^0000cdfour teams^000000 and talk to them. As I told you earlier, be careful when you talk. Some of them are short-tempered.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你可以去见这^0000cd四支队伍^000000，并和他们交谈。正如我之前所说，说话时要小心。其中有些人脾气很暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer, good luck! I will be talking to Rookie. Cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，祝你好运！我去和新人聊聊。加油。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer! How was it? You met all of them and persuaded them? Not yet? I guess not. If you go to the 2nd floor, you can meet all of them.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者！怎么样？大家都见到了，也说服他们了吗？还没有？我猜也是。上二楼就能见到他们。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I will be cheering for you. Go, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我会为你加油的。去吧，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You're back! So, have you met them? Are they going to help us?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你回来了！那么，你见到他们了吗？他们会帮助我们吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes... Several things happened, but they were not bad.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的...中间虽然出了些状况，但结果还不错。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No wonder you are a symbol of faith!! Now, we can wait for seniors and staffs. Right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
难怪你是大家信赖的象征！现在只要等前辈和其他成员回来就行了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Come on. Sit here and listen to Rookie's story. It's so interesting.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
来吧。坐在这里听听新人的故事。非常有趣。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So, why did you leave your home?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
那么，你为什么离开家？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's quite obvious. My family had a secondhand store. As you know, the amount iron consumption is so great in this area. Some people joke that they steal your spoon while your eyes are closed.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这还用问吗？我家开了家二手店。你知道，这一带的铁消耗量很大。有人还开玩笑说，趁你闭眼的时候，连勺子都会被偷走。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Normally they use the iron dug from mines. But since it cannot meet the demands, a lot of used iron is also consumed. Our family bought the iron and resold it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
平时大家用的是矿里挖出来的铁，但产量满足不了需求，所以也会大量使用废铁。我们家就是收购废铁再转卖。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And you were not able to help them?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
而你无法帮助他们？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
My brothers helped my parents. As you see, I'm so small and used to be sick when I was a kid.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我哥哥们都能帮父母做事。你看我这么瘦小，小时候还经常生病。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, so they regarded you as a useless kid?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，所以他们把你看作一个无用的小孩？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I had no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I don't agree with you. Everyone has different ability and you must be good at something. You just didn't find it earlier. Anyway, what happened next?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我不同意你的看法。每个人都有不同的能力，你肯定擅长某些事情。你只是之前没发现而已。总之，后来发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As my family ignored me, I decided to leave the house to find something I am capable of.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
既然家人忽视我，我决定离开家，去寻找我擅长的事情。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well done. If you stayed there, you would have become such a useless person.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
做得好。如果你留在那里，就会变成一个那样无用的人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then I met Gonie and came here. But I found that there's nothing I could do here as well.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
然后我遇到了戈尼，并来到了这里。但我发现这里也没有我能做的事情。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Everyone is a monster here. Look at Gonie. He was bleeding and almost dead. But He was still alive. The truth is that other guys are extraordinary and you are normal.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这里人人都是怪物。看看戈尼，他浑身是血，几乎快死了，却还是活了下来。说到底，别人都身怀绝技，只有你是个普通人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
But I'm not at the level they require here. Whenever I get a gun in my hand, my eyes are sore and my hands are shaking. I can't aim a target properly...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
可我达不到这里的要求。每次拿起枪，眼睛就酸痛，手也会发抖，根本瞄不准目标...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So you are in charge of the housekeeping here?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
所以你是负责这里的家务？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Not a housekeeping. A sort of cleaning-up?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不是家务。算是打扫清理吧？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Hey Rookie. Why did you bring those jerks in here? They are wandering around and humiliating us! Rookie, are you a spy from the government?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
嘿，新人。你为什么要带那些混蛋进来？他们到处乱逛，简直是在羞辱我们！新人，你是政府的间谍吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
The government ignored us when we were dying! We can never help them!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
政府在我们垂死挣扎时对我们视而不见！我们绝不能帮他们！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Have you forgotten why we are hiding here?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你忘了我们为什么躲在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
The government caused this tragedy!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
这场悲剧是政府造成的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Fine. You live forever in this isolated place! But what about the children who don't know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好吧。你就在这与世隔绝的地方永远生活下去吧！但那些对此一无所知的孩子怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Hey kid! Do you know how much pain we had on that day?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
嘿，小孩！你知道那天我们遭受了多少痛苦吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know! However, no one else will know it unless we talk about it. Go out there and ask anyone.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道！但如果我们不谈论它，其他人也不会知道。走出去问问任何人吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ask them if they know that happened on that day. I bet nobody does. Unless we talk about it, how can anyone ever find it out?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
问问他们是否知道那天发生了什么。我敢打赌没人知道。除非我们说出来，否则没人能发现真相。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You hate to help the government that once abandoned us? It shows that we used to be nothing for them, but now they our help. Does that mean some compensation for us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你讨厌帮助那个曾经抛弃我们的政府？这说明我们过去对他们一文不值，如今他们却需要我们的帮助。这不正好可以作为对我们的补偿吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If they need our help, we can just use them. We are not as weak as we used to.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果他们需要我们帮忙，我们可以利用他们。我们不再像以前那样弱小了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you want a revenge, maybe this is the opportunity! A revenge doesn't always mean an armed revenge.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你想复仇，也许这就是机会！复仇未必非得动武。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
You are young and not wise enough. No matter what happens, we are never helping the government. Never!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你还年轻，不够明智。无论发生什么，我们绝不会帮助政府。绝不！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Gonie?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
戈尼？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What the hell is he saying after showing up all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
他突然出现，到底在说什么鬼话？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Are you still doing the silent meditation?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你还在进行无声冥想吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
For the favor...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
为了那个恩情...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you hear that? He is in the middle of a silent meditation. How spiteful!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听到了吗？他正在进行无声冥想。真够恶毒的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Be quiet. I hear it all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
安静点。我都听到了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Gonie says we have to pay for the favor they did to him.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...戈尼说，我们必须报答他们对他的恩情。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Well. They did the favor for you, not for us.
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
哼。那是他帮了你，不是帮了我们。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
If you want to help them so badly, you two go and help them. But make sure you take the clothes off!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
你们俩要是这么想帮他们，就自己去吧。不过记得把衣服脱了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you hear that? They are so cool.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
听到了吗？他们真酷。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I hear it all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我都听到了。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What did that guy say?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
那家伙说什么？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He says everyone on the 2nd floor decided to help them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他说二楼的人都决定要帮他们。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What? The ladies and Rupert as well?
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
什么？连女士们和鲁伯特也一起？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you are curious, go upstairs and check it. They might slap you on the back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好奇的话就上楼看看吧。他们说不定还会拍拍你的肩膀呢。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Seems like most of us agree. I don't think anything good will happen if you're still against it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
看来大家都同意了。如果你还反对，恐怕不会有什么好事发生。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Phew... Sir, what would you do now? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
呼...前辈，您接下来打算怎么办？呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Oops... We have no other choice if the ladies and Rupert agreed with them...
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
哎呀...既然女士们和鲁伯特都答应了...我们也只能照办了...

scripts.text:
[Senior]
But I will never trust you guys! I will keep my eyes on you!!!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
但我永远不会信任你们！我会一直盯着你们的！！！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, what a passionate propose. I've never had anything like this in my life. I feel a little shy.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哎呀，多么热情的提议！我这辈子还没遇到过这种事，真让人有点不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I'm not leaving until I close his big mouth! I'm not leaving!
scripts.translation:
[前辈]
在他闭上那张大嘴之前，我不会离开！我不走！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yes. Let me handle this place. You go inside and get ready.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是的，这里交给我处理。你们进去准备吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I've never imagined that this would be done so perfectly. I owe you for this. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我从未想过事情会如此完美地解决。我欠你一个人情。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please go and send them a message. Tell them 'The Heron spread its wings' and they will understand.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
请去给他们送个信。告诉他们“鹭鸟展翅”，他们就会明白的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I go alone? Don't you have to send the message directly?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要一个人去吗？难道你不应该亲自送信吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I am staying here. Hahaha. I really like this fellow and we can work together.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我要留在这里。哈哈哈。我挺喜欢这小伙子的，我们可以一起做事。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Work with me? I don't think I can do anything useful for you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
跟我合作？我觉得我帮不上什么忙。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Exactly. That's something you should change. Self-confidence. In your case, the lack of confidence caused the lack of self-confidence.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没错。这正是你需要改掉的——缺乏自信。你只是不够自信而已。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Confidence can be obtained by yourself, through an achievement or by being approved by someone else a person. It's impossible here. This place is like a suit that does not fit for you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
自信可以靠自己取得成就，也可以来自他人的认可。在这里你很难做到。这个地方就像一套不合身的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
As long as there is just one person who trusts you, you can grow to infinity.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
只要有一个人信任你，你就能无限成长。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You may not have realized it. But you are already doing it to everyone here. They all counting on you. Just trust yourself a little more.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你可能还没意识到，但你已经让这里每个人都有了信心。他们都指望着你，多相信自己一点吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you don't get it, trust me. Because I trust you.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你不明白，那就相信我。因为我信任你。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now the generation has shifted. Today is the last day for the old generation and the first day for the new generation. And you are the link.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在世代交替了。今天是旧时代的最后一天，也是新时代的第一天。而你就是连接两者的纽带。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You're too good to waste your talent here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你太优秀了，不该在这里浪费才华。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
First, you had the ability to find out that I had a certain purpose. You were also able to find out what's helpful for Rebellions. Then you had the guts to implement it. You also have the humanity...
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
首先，你能看出我另有目的，也发现了什么对反叛者有帮助；之后还敢付诸行动。而且你很有人情味...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Just a little polishing will help you spread your wings. You're supposed to use your brain. Why do you suffer by working physically?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
只要稍加磨练，你就能展翅高飞。你明明该发挥头脑，为什么要靠体力活受苦呢？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you want, I can help you. What do you think? I need a partner and I'm sure we can make a great duo.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你愿意，我可以帮你。你觉得怎么样？我需要搭档，我相信我们能组成很棒的双人组。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, could you be explain it to me in detail?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哦，你能详细解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Sure. I have plenty of time. By the way, is it okay for me to stay here continuously?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
当然。我有的是时间。顺便问一下，我可以一直留在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We are now cooperating, aren't we?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们现在不是正在合作吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you think you're scouting him too plainly in someone else's house?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在别人家里这么明目张胆地挖人，不觉得太过分吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Is there anything wrong with it? You have this talented guy but you are not utilizing his ability. Are you? He's so talented!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这有什么不对？你身边明明有这么有才华的人，却不让他发挥本领吗？他可是很有才能的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Gonie?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
戈尼？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他怎么说？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He says we have prepared someone to proceed the cooperation. If you go to the passage to the store, you can meet that person.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他说我们已经安排了人来负责合作事宜。你去商店那边的通道，就能见到那个人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I will meet that person and listen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。我会去见那个人并听他怎么说。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer, I need to have a long talk from now on. So I'm counting on you. When you go there, don't forget to use that place. I mean 'that place'.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，接下来我得和他们长谈一番，就拜托你了。你到了那边，别忘了用那个地方。我是说“那个地方”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pardon? I see.. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？知道了...回头见。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yikes! Wait a minute! I almost forgot. This is the reward specially prepared for this mission. I am giving all of them to you. You can exchange this with something useful.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哎呀！等一下！我差点忘了。这是专门为这次任务准备的奖励。我把它们都给你。你可以用它们交换有用的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Token of honor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
荣誉代币？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Seems like the dull middle-aged person standing beside the stairs receives the tokens. His name is Strasse. If you are interested, go.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
楼梯旁站着个沉闷的中年人，负责兑换代币。他叫斯特拉瑟。感兴趣的话就去找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I gave you everything. Bye now. Say hello to the President!!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我都给你了。再见。替我向会长问好！！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yo! Welcome! Do you want a cup of tea? Did you send the message properly?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哟！欢迎！你想喝杯茶吗？你好好把消息送出去了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
I'm sorry.
You cannot enter here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
抱歉。
你不能进入这里。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
I'm sorry.
You cannot enter here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
抱歉。
你不能进入这里。

scripts.text: Tell the guard that Rookie sent you.
scripts.translation: 告诉卫兵是新人派你来的

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
Rookie?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
新人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
What's wrong with that guy?
Although he sent you here, you cannot enter.
Please go back.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
那家伙怎么了？
虽然是他派你来的，但你不能进入。
请回去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
Why is it so noisy here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
这里为什么这么吵？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
I'm sorry!!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
对不起！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
Shut up!
How many times do you think I told you to be quiet!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
闭嘴！
我告诉过你多少次要保持安静！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion guard]
I am sorry..
This person wants to go inside, claiming that Rookie sent him/her.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫兵]
对不起...
这个人说是新人派他来的，想进去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
Rookie?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
新人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
Arrrgh... That kid?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
啊...那个小鬼？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
The kid sent you. So, what about it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
是那个小孩派你来的。所以，那又怎样？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
You...... You're the one who made a fuss downstairs a moment ago.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
你...你就是刚才在楼下闹事的人。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
I have no idea what brought you here. But I can't let you in.
Do not make a fuss. Go back!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
我不知道你来这里做什么，但不能放你进去。
别再闹了，回去！

scripts.text: Ask him again.
scripts.translation: 再问他一次

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
You cannot change anything by asking me for a favor.
No.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
你求我也没用。
不行。

scripts.text: Ask him again.
scripts.translation: 再问他一次

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
I said no!
You're so annoying!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
我说不行！
你真烦人！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader]
If it hadn't been for the order of our leader, I could just knock you out right here......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长]
要不是首领有令，我刚才就把你打晕在这里了...

scripts.text:
[???]
...... It's noisy outside.
What's going on? Larcis.
scripts.translation:
[???]
...外面真吵。
怎么回事，拉西斯？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Nothing.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
没什么。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Hey, leave now.
You will be in trouble, if you keep making a fuss.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
喂，快离开。
再闹下去，你会有麻烦的。

scripts.text: Shout at him.
scripts.translation: 对他大喊

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
A good idea.
The exit is downstairs. Go there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
好主意。
出口在楼下。去那里。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
What the hell was that!
You're so rude!
Do you want to die right now?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
你搞什么鬼！
真没礼貌！
想现在就送命吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
Oops!
This is the voice I've never heard before. Is it the adventurer who helped that kid?
scripts.translation:
[???]
哎呀！
这声音我从没听过。是帮助过那个孩子的冒险者吗？

scripts.text: Say yes.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[???]
Larcis.
We cannot leave our savior outside. Let the adventurer come in.
Let me give him/her a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[???]
拉西斯。
不能让我们的救命恩人一直待在门外。让冒险者进来吧。
我给他/她倒杯茶。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
But.. Dien!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
可是...迪恩！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
...... I see.
Follow me.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
... 我明白了。
跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you behave rudely, you won't go back alive.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
你要是敢无礼，就别想活着回去。

scripts.text: - The door seems to be locked -
scripts.translation: - 门好像锁上了 -

scripts.text: - You hear the conversation from inside the room. -
scripts.translation: - 你听见房间里有人在交谈。 -

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
... So I was thinking that you were having dementia.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
...我还以为你得了老年痴呆呢。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I'm not that old yet.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我还没那么老呢。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Come to think of it, you should make yourself up!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
说起来，你也该打扮打扮了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
This is why you look older!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
这就是你看起来显老的原因！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Sometimes you look older than Cotnes!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
有时候你看起来比科特内斯还老！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Oops, really?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
哎呀，真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Cotnes]
Phew!
Not so old!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 科特内斯]
呼！
还不算太老！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Cotnes]
It seems like you have more wrinkles these days.
Why don't you put on some anti-wrinkle cream?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 科特内斯]
你最近皱纹好像变多了。
要不要擦点抗皱霜？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
This all is because of the air here!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
这都是这里的空气造成的！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
You're right!
This type of air is critical to the dry skin like yours!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
你说得对！
这种空气最伤你这种干性皮肤了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Come to think of it, remember that kid who came here before?
Tell him to buy some cosmetics from Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
说起来，还记得之前来过的那个孩子吗？
让他去卢恩·米德加兹买些化妆品回来！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
I have heard there's a fascinating cosmetic shop there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
我听说那边有家很棒的化妆品店。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
It's difficult for our kids to go all the way there to buy cosmetics.
There is a problem with the position as well...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
让孩子们跑那么远去买化妆品也不容易。
而且地点也不太方便...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
That kid? Who are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
那个小孩？你说的是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
The kid from the Secret Wings~
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
就是那个秘密之翼来的孩子~

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Oh!
I remember I asked him for an errand. Will he be back here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
哦！
我记得我让他帮我办过一件事。他会回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
It's like you solved the whole problem. And they won't get past you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
这就像是你一下子解决了所有问题，他们也别想从你这里溜过去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Of course, we have some important thoughts~
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
当然，我们也有重要的想法~

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
You're so great. How can you think of such an idea in that short moment?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
你真厉害。怎么能在那么短的时间内想到这种主意？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Not to mention the president, Heart Hunters are irritating to us as well.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
不只是总裁，心之猎手也让我们很头疼。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Although they are all novices, they can be an obstacle for us in defeating the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
虽然他们都是些新手，但我们要是去对付秘密之翼，他们也可能趁机坏事。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
That's true.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Let's say we attack the Secret Wings recklessly and Heart Hunters takes the chance to attack us. We'll collapse in a minute.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
假如我们贸然攻击秘密之翼，心之猎手又趁机反咬一口，我们很快就会全盘崩溃。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
So we will pretend to cooperate with the Secret Wings and get rid of the annoying ones first.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
所以我们先假装和秘密之翼合作，优先除掉那些碍事的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Let's finish them before they realize we have a plan to attack them.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
趁他们还没察觉我们的计划，先把他们解决掉。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
We're Rebellions. And we are at the end of guns.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
我们可是反叛者，早已身处枪口之下。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Let me finish my karma in my generation.
I don't want to leave it to youngsters.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
就让我在这一代了结这段恩怨吧。
我不想把它留给年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
This is good to have this opportunity before I die.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
能在死前得到这样的机会，真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Come on, sister!
Don't talk about dying!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
好了，姐姐！
别老把死挂在嘴边！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
I saw Rupert crying after you said that.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
我刚才看到鲁伯特听到你这么说后哭了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
He's not cute anymore, he is just a middle-aged man. But to him, you're like mother.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
他已经不可爱了，只是个中年大叔。但在他眼里，你就像母亲一样。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
And to me...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
至于我...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Yes, I see.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What we have now is a pleasant party. I'm looking forward to it.
Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我们现在终于能办一场热闹的聚会了，我很期待。
哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
I'm expecting it so much!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
我也等不及了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Cotnes]
Then I'll fix the party accessories in advance.
Hohohoho.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 科特内斯]
那我就提前准备好聚会的装饰品吧。
呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Nice to meet you.
Take a seat and have some cookies.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
很高兴见到你。
坐下吃点饼干吧。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Phew.. It sounds so serious.
It's dangerous to be excited at our age...
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
呼...听起来事态很严重。
我们这个年纪，太激动可不太好...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Cotnes]
Oops! Welcome.
We have been talking about the party that will be held soon.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 科特内斯]
哎呀！欢迎。
我们刚才正在讨论即将举行的聚会。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
It's been a long time since an outsider came in here for the last time.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
上次有外人进来，已经是很久以前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
If you do not want me to make a nice hole in your head, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
你要是不想让我在你脑袋上开个漂亮的洞，就赶紧离开。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Ridsh]
Don't be so panic.
I talked it out with my sister.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 里德什]
别慌。
我已经和姐姐谈过了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Don't just be standing there. Sit down here.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
别光站着，坐这边来。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
很好。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Let me persuade the people who are against this.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
让我去说服那些反对的人。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
What!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Sister!
Are you crazy?
What the hell are you saying!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
什么！！！！
姐姐！
你疯了吗？
你到底在说什么？！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
That's the request from the president!
The guy who destroyed us!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
那是总裁的要求！
就是那个毁了我们的人！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Calm down, Ridsh.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
冷静点，里德什。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I will never accept it!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我绝不会接受！

scripts.text:
[???]
Well... If Dien agrees, I will agree, too.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嗯...如果迪恩同意，我也同意。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
What's wrong with you, Cotnes!
This is the request from those guys!
Those guys who destroyed us!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
科特内斯，你怎么回事！
这是那帮人的要求！
那帮毁了我们的人！

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Dien must have some thoughts about it.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
迪恩一定有自己的想法。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Although you are my sister, I will never accept this!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
虽然你是我的姐姐，但我绝不会接受这件事！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
... You'd better go out now.
If you stay here longer, you might get an air hole in your head.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
...你最好现在就出去。
再待下去，我可能会在你脑袋上开个洞。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I know you've met Rupert. Have you met ^ff0000Erst^000000?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我知道你见过鲁伯特。你见过^ff0000厄斯特^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Larcis. Go with this adventurer and hand them this letter.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
拉西斯。带着这位冒险者，把这封信交给他。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
And tell the kids in front of the door not to enter here until Ridsh calms down.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
还有，告诉门口的小孩，在里德什冷静下来之前不要进来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
是的，我会的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Follow me. We are going to commander Erst first.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
跟我来。我们要先去见指挥官厄斯特。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
... You'd better go out now.
If you stay here longer, you might get an air hole in your head.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
...你最好现在出去。
如果你再待在这里，我可能会在你头上打个空气洞。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I know you've met Rupert. Have you met Erst?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我知道你见过鲁伯特。你见过厄斯特吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Larcis. Go with this adventurer and hand them this letter.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
拉西斯。带着这位冒险者，把这封信交给他。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
And tell the kids in front of the door not to enter here until Ridsh calms down.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
还有，告诉门口的小孩，在里德什冷静下来之前不要进来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
是的，我会的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Follow me. We are going to commander Erst first.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
跟我来。我们要先去见指挥官厄斯特。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I'm surprised that Erst accepted it so easily.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
没想到厄斯特这么爽快地就答应了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Without further delay, meet Rupert again.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
事不宜迟，再去见见鲁伯特吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Welcome.
Since most of the kids are busy these days, I feel somewhat bored.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
欢迎。
最近孩子们都很忙，我觉得有点无聊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
By the way, what brought you here? I thought you finished your business.
I guess I answered your question...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
话说回来，你这次来有什么事吗？我还以为你的事情都办完了呢。
看来我已经回答你的问题了...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Oops!
You haven't forgotten about the errand?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
哎呀！
你还没忘记那件事吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I didn't really mean to ask you for a favor. It's so kind of you to remember it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我其实没真想麻烦你。你还记得，真是太好了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
We were talking about the party we are planning soon.
It was nearly over. But several ingredients are missing.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
我们刚才在商量近期要办的聚会。
本来差不多谈妥了，可还缺几样食材。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Since Larcis is in charge of our business, please ask him. He will tell you what we need.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前辈 迪恩]
拉西斯负责处理这些事，去问问他吧。他会告诉你需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Well...... I heard what they said about you.
Did you help the kid when he fell on the ground?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
嗯...我听说了你的事。
那个孩子摔倒时，是你帮了他吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
Sister, he is Gonie.
scripts.translation:
[???]
姐姐，他是戈尼。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oops.
Is his name Gonie?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哎呀。
他的名字是戈尼吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
You know, that tall guy who doesn't talk much.
scripts.translation:
[???]
就是那个很高、不太爱说话的人。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！

scripts.text:
[???]
He bought some expensive cookies for us on his way to Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[???]
他去里希塔乐镇的路上，给我们买了一些很贵的饼干。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh! Right!
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！对了！
是的！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It was so delicious.
Have we finished it all?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
那饼干真好吃。
我们都吃完了吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
It was so delicious and we finished it that day. Didn't we?
The quantity was so small.
scripts.translation:
[???]
那饼干太好吃了，我们当天就吃完了，对吧？
本来就没多少。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Did we finish it?
It would have been better if we saved it for visitors.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我们吃完了吗？
要是留一点给客人就好了。

scripts.text:
[???]
If you save it, there will be mold on it.
scripts.translation:
[???]
如果留着，就会发霉的。

scripts.text:
[???]
By the way, what happened to Gonie that time?
scripts.translation:
[???]
话说回来，那次戈尼后来怎么样了？

scripts.text: Explain the situation.
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh, my goodness! Really?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
天哪！真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
I was lucky to find him early.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
幸好我早点发现了他。

scripts.text:
[???]
I heard what they were saying.
It sounds like he has been cured and is all right now.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我听到他们在说什么了。
听起来他已经被治愈了，现在没事了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Is that so?
What a relief.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
是吗？
真是让人放心。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Ah~
The kids are struggling......
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
啊~
孩子们都在拼命努力呢...

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I hope they don't get hurt.
Every time they leave the base, I'm afraid they might get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
希望他们平安无事。
每次他们离开基地，我都担心会出意外。

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, sister!
You worry too much!
They are adults, not babies. They can take care of themselves.
scripts.translation:
[???]
姐姐！
你太操心了！
他们都已经是大人了，不是小宝宝，会照顾好自己的。

scripts.text:
[???]
By the way, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[???]
顺便问一下，你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[???]
I don't think you came here for tea and chatting with us.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我觉得你来这里不是为了喝茶和聊天的。

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 谈谈合作

scripts.text:
[???]
Hey!
Get out of here!

[???]
Where do you think you are? That's sheer nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你以为你在哪里？这简直是胡说八道！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Calm down, Ridsh!
Do not make a fuss.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
冷静点，里德什！
不要大惊小怪。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
How can I calm down on hearing that?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
听到那种话我怎么能冷静？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
No wonder they started talking about Gonie. It seemed like they were hiding something from the beginning!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
难怪他们开始谈论戈尼。看起来他们从一开始就在隐瞒什么！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
If you do not want me to make a nice hole in your head, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
如果你不想让我在你头上打个漂亮的洞，现在就离开。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
And tell them!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
告诉他们！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Before we kill you all, there's no chance in hell we can ever cooperate with you!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
除非我们把你们全杀光，否则绝不可能和你们合作！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
How dare you....
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
你们竟敢...

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You expected this before you came here, right?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你来之前就预料到会是这种局面了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
But we like your courage. So we will listen to you first.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
不过我们欣赏你的勇气，所以愿意先听你说。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You must have been ready to die by the time you came here. So I will say this is the price of your life.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你来这里时，想必已经做好赴死的准备了。那就把这当作你求得活命的代价吧。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Sister!
Don't even listen!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
姐姐！
别听他的！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Ridsh!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
里德什！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
...
Explain the situation.
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Wow... Heart Hunters...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哇...心之猎手...

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
What!
Whatever it is, it is none of our business!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
什么！
不管是什么，都与我们无关！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Why do we have to help you?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我们为什么要帮你？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
You are the ones who abandoned us in suffering!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
是你们抛弃了我们在苦难中挣扎！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Rune-Midgarts?
I don't care what happens to their royal family!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
卢恩·米德加兹？
我才不在乎他们的皇室发生什么事！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
For Schwartz?
The biggest wish of my life is the collapse of Schwartz!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
为了施瓦茨瓦尔特？我这辈子最大的心愿，就是看着施瓦茨瓦尔特垮台！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
You can't handle Heart Hunter kids and ask us for help!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
你们连心之猎手那群新人都对付不了，还来求我们帮忙！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Where is the arrogance you showed us when you abandoned us?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
当初抛弃我们时的傲慢劲儿呢？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
It serves you right!
Fools!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
活该！
一群蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
... That's enough!
Can you give us some time to think about it?
It's not an easy decision.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
...够了！
能给我们一些时间考虑吗？
这不是个轻易能做出的决定。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in your inventory.
Please arrange your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 您的物品栏已满。
请整理物品栏后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Quiet inside!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
里面安静点！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
What's going on here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
这里发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Preparation for the party?
She has never told me anything about party!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
是在准备派对吗？
她从没跟我提过派对的事！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Oh! I remember she told me to bring something suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
哦！我想起来了，她让我带点可疑的东西过来。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
High Class Tea for Dien, Old Letter for Ridsh and Very Shining Ring for Cotnes.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
给迪恩的上等茶叶、给里德什的旧信，还有给科特内斯的闪亮戒指。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
At first sight, they don't look strange. But their locations are quite suspicious... They are in the northeastern corner of Einbroch. I have no idea how we can get them in such a place...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
乍一看没什么特别，可它们的位置实在可疑...都在艾音布罗克东北角。我真想不通，怎么会跑到那种地方去...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
But... they told us to bring them. So we have to go and get them.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
不过...既然她们让我们去拿，就只能照办。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you're willing to go, tell me!
Of course, we will compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
如果你愿意去的话，告诉我！
当然，我们会给你报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
You're here!
Then would you please have a look at the tasks given by Dien, Ridsh and Cotnes?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
你来了！
那么请看一下迪恩、里德什和科特内斯交给你的任务吧？

scripts.text: Don't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Well.. I do not force you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
好吧... 我不勉强你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
This is {0} {1} asked you for.
If you meet Julian in the northeastern corner of the northern field in Einbroch, he will let you in.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
这是{0} {1}托你找的东西。
去艾音布罗克北部原野的东北角找朱利安，他会放你进去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Right there, defeat {0}.
I don't know what's going on. But since it's order of {1}, we have to do it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
就在那边击败{0}。
我也不清楚缘由，不过既然是{1}下的命令，我们就得照办。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Look at other requests.
scripts.translation: 查看其他请求

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
保重！

scripts.text: A request you are currently doing.
scripts.translation: 你正在进行的请求。

scripts.text: A request you have already completed.
scripts.translation: 你已完成的请求。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
This is the High Class Tea Dien told me about... But why was it located in such a place?
... Anyway, you did a great job.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
这就是迪恩说的上等茶叶...不过为什么会放在那种地方？
...算了，你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you bring this token to Strasse at the stairs at 10 o'clock in the corridor of the 2nd floor, you will receive something useful in return.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
把这个代币交给二楼走廊十点钟方向楼梯旁的斯特拉瑟，他会给你有用的东西。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Well done.
This is the Old Letter Ridsh talked about... By the way, why does she need this letter...?
There must be a reason, as Ridsh told us to bring it...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
这就是里德什说的旧信...话说，她为什么要这封信...？
既然她特意让我们带回来，一定有她的理由...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you bring this token to Strasse at the stairs at 10 o'clock in the corridor of the 2nd floor, you will receive something useful in return.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
如果你把这个令牌交给位于2楼走廊10点钟方向楼梯处的斯特拉瑟，你会得到一些有用的东西作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Well done.
This is the Very Shining Ring Cotnes talked about... As an accessory, it looks tremendous, doesn't it?
Cotnes said it's a ring. Then it's a ring...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
这就是科特内斯说的闪亮戒指...当饰品倒是挺气派的，对吧？
既然科特内斯说它是戒指，那它就是戒指...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
If you bring this token to Strasse at the stairs at 10 o'clock in the corridor of the 2nd floor, you will receive something useful in return.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
干得好。
如果你把这个令牌交给位于2楼走廊10点钟方向楼梯处的斯特拉瑟，你会得到一些有用的东西作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Special Force commander]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者特种部队指挥官]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Special Force commander]
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者特种部队指挥官]
滚开。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
什么事？

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
And who's the guy beside you?
I haven't seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
那你旁边那个人是谁？
我从来没见过你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Ah.. that is....
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
啊...那位是...

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Ssssh!
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
嘘！

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Stop stalling...
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
别磨蹭了...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
I am sorry!
Dien sent you a letter!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
对不起！
迪恩给你寄了一封信！

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
What?
What did that grandma send?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
什么？
那个老太婆寄了什么？

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Show it to me.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
给我看看。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Here..
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
给你..

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Let's see..
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
I agree. Do you agree, too?
What the hell is this nonsense?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
我同意。你也同意吗？
这到底是怎么回事？

scripts.text: Explain him.
scripts.translation: 向他解释

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
What?
Are you kidding me?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
什么？
你在开玩笑吗？

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Finally, that old woman is out of her mind.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
那个老太婆终于疯了。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Hey!
Larcis.
Are you sure she wrote this?
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
嘿！
拉西斯。
你确定是她写的吗？

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Regardless of the old women, the vixen will not be quiet.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
那几个老太婆我不管，那只狐狸精可不会安分。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
It's clear that Dien wrote this!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者卫队长 拉西斯]
很明显是迪恩写的！

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Well, that's why she sent you here.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
嗯，所以她派你来了。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
......
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
...

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Alright.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
This could be the last wish of the old lady.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
这可能是那位老奶奶最后的愿望了。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Let's agree with it.
For now.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
那就答应她吧。
至少暂时是这样。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Alright.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
This could be the last wish of the old lady.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
这可能是那位老奶奶最后的愿望了。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
Let's agree with it.
For now.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
那就答应她吧。
至少暂时是这样。

scripts.text:
[Special Force commander Erst]
What is it?
Stop wandering around and get lost now.
scripts.translation:
[特种部队指挥官 厄斯特]
怎么了？
别在这里晃悠了，赶紧滚。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Our commander is a great person!
There are no words to describe... how great he is!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我们的指挥官真了不起！
简直...伟大得无法用言语形容！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Make sure you properly maintain your weapons.
Although there is dust on your shoes, your gun must always be shiny... That's what they call 'hard-boiled'!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
一定要好好保养你的武器。
虽然你的长靴上沾了灰尘，但你的枪必须时刻闪闪发光...这就是所谓的“硬汉”！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Do you know the meaning of this position?
Huhuhuhuhu
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你知道这个职位的意义吗？
呼呼呼呼

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
To become strong, you need an opportunity.
If your determination is not strong enough, you will always be in the same place.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
想要变强，就需要机会。
如果决心不够坚定，你将会永远停留在原地。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress, because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续前进。 -

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正翻找着书籍和文件，偷偷瞥了我一眼，随后又继续翻找起来。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正翻找着书籍和文件，偷偷瞥了我一眼，随后又继续翻找起来。

scripts.text:
[Strange man]
Are you the adventurer who is making a fuss in Clana Nemieri?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
你就是那个在克拉纳·内米埃里闹事的冒险者吗？

scripts.text: You heard a voice of the man who showed up all of a sudden. Where on earth did he appear from?
scripts.translation: 你听见那个突然出现的男人说话。他到底是从哪里冒出来的？

scripts.text: The man named Vero has not shown up. It seems like they are not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 名叫维罗的男人还没有出现。看来他们还没准备好。

scripts.text: It is time. Let me talk to them now.
scripts.translation: 时间到了。让我现在去和他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oops?! Here are you. Have you arrived already?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哎呀？是你啊。你已经到了吗？

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正翻找着书籍和文件，偷偷瞥了我一眼，随后又继续翻找起来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You have to talk to me. Not to the elder sister.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你该跟我说话，别去找我姐姐。

scripts.text: You are to meet Vero in Einbech. Let's go to Einbech.
scripts.translation: 你要在艾音贝赫见维罗。我们去艾音贝赫吧。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正翻找着书籍和文件，偷偷瞥了我一眼，随后又继续翻找起来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Kahaha. Welcome, pal.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈哈。欢迎，伙计。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正翻找着书籍和文件，偷偷瞥了我一眼，随后又继续翻找起来。

scripts.text: I promised to meet Vero at Lighthalzen. Let's go to Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation: 我答应在里希塔乐镇见维罗。我们去里希塔乐镇吧。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正翻找着书籍和文件，偷偷瞥了我一眼，随后又继续翻找起来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Have you brought the Star Crumb?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你带星星的角了吗？

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正翻找着书籍和文件，偷偷瞥了我一眼，随后又继续翻找起来。

scripts.text:
It seems like Vero has already departed.
Let's go to Yuno quickly.
scripts.translation:
维罗似乎已经出发了。
我们快去尤诺吧。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl is looking at books and documents, as usual.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩仍像往常一样，在翻看书籍和文件。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
I have seen you talking to that kid lately. Do you care about her?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我最近看你经常和那个小孩说话。你在意她吗？

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl is looking at books and documents, as usual. Shall I say hello?
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩仍像往常一样，在翻看书籍和文件。要去跟她打个招呼吗？

scripts.text: Say hello.
scripts.translation: 打个招呼

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: The Gunslinger girl is not interested in what's happening here and goes on with her business.
scripts.translation: 那位神枪手女孩对这里发生的事毫不关心，继续忙自己的事。

scripts.text: What shall I say to the Gunslinger girl?
scripts.translation: 我该跟那位神枪手女孩说什么？

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl stole a glance at me and resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩偷偷瞥了我一眼，又继续翻找书籍和文件。

scripts.text: The poker-faced Gunslinger girl who was fishing around books and documents stole a glance at me. Then she resumed fishing around books and documents again.
scripts.translation: 那位面无表情的神枪手女孩正翻找着书籍和文件，偷偷瞥了我一眼，随后又继续翻找起来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahaha, I'm here, sister.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈，姐姐，我来了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
So it was you.
The hottest fellow in Clana Nemieri, right? I hate to admit that you're hotter than me. Being hot has always been my part here.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
原来是你啊。
克拉纳·内米埃里最酷的家伙，对吧？真不想承认你比我还酷。耍酷一直是我在这里的看家本领。

scripts.text:
[Strange man]
Oh~! Now I have to introduce myself.
I am Arivero Yurhik.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
哦~！那我得自我介绍一下。
我是阿里维罗·尤尔希克。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
We have met today for the first time, but I guess we will be friends from now on. So you can just call me Vero.
Only my close friends call me Vero. Hahaha. So you are honored.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们今天才第一次见面，不过我想以后会成为朋友。叫我维罗就行。
只有亲近的朋友才这么叫我。哈哈，你可真有面子。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
And the lady here who is passionately interested in you is my elder sister, Arinoa Yurhik. You can see it from the name. We are siblings!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
这位对你特别感兴趣的女士是我姐姐阿里诺亚·尤尔希克。从名字就看得出来，我们是姐弟！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Interested in me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对我感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
It's strange. The lady has been looking at the documents, without showing any interest in me.
The man who has been speaking loudly became serious all of a sudden. He started talking to himself.
scripts.translation:
真奇怪。那位女士一直在看文件，完全没注意我。
那个刚才还大声说话的男人突然严肃起来，开始自言自语。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You are showing such a great interest in him..? Sister, perhaps you are trying to give the mission to this fellow?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
姐姐，你对他这么感兴趣...难道想把任务交给这家伙？

scripts.text: Since I was looking at her continuously, I knew that the lady did not speak or act. But the man named Vero seemed to understand what she was thinking and continued speaking.
scripts.translation: 我一直注视着那位女士，知道她没说过话，也没做过任何表示。可那个叫维罗的男人似乎读懂了她的想法，继续说了下去。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Yeah.. Really? Hahaha. I knew we'd become friends.
Hey friend. We have a task to work on together.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
是吗...真的吗？哈哈哈，我就知道我们能成为朋友。
嘿，朋友，我们有个任务要一起完成。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It's not a hard job. All we need is to go to about four places and destroy several things.
You'll do it. Right?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不是什么难事。我们只要去四个左右的地方，摧毁几样东西。
你会帮忙的，对吧？

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 去做

scripts.text: Do it without hesitation.
scripts.translation: 毫不犹豫地去做

scripts.text: Do it at all events.
scripts.translation: 无论如何都去做

scripts.text: Since you are being forced, do it.
scripts.translation: 既然被逼无奈，那就去做

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
When I saw you for the first time, I knew you were faithful. Oh! Right.
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
第一次见到你，我就知道你很可靠。哦，对了，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
{1} is my name.

[Arivero Yurhik]
{0}?
Hmm, what an arrogant name. But it's the name that deserves to be hot. Now I have to acknowledge you..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
{0}？
嗯，名字真够傲气。不过配得上一个酷人。好吧，我承认你了...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I have several things to prepare. I believe you also need some time to get ready before departing, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我还有几样东西要准备。你出发前也得花点时间准备吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I will be fully ready after 4:00 am tomorrow. Once you are ready after that time, tell my elder sister. Then I will get here quickly.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
明天凌晨4点后我就准备好了。到时你准备妥当后告诉我姐姐，我很快就会过来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You are not only faithful, but diligent as well!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你不仅可靠，还很勤奋！

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! The preparation is finished and you have arrived here. So let me give you a briefing on what we are going to do.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！准备都完成了，你也来了。我来说明一下接下来的行动。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Teleporting is not available in the Schwaltzvalt area. I'm sure you know that.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
施瓦茨瓦尔特地区不能使用瞬间移动，这点你应该知道吧？

scripts.text: I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道

scripts.text: I didn't know.
scripts.translation: 我不知道

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Good. Actually, you don't need to know that.
It's not that important.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
很好。其实知不知道都无所谓，也不是什么重要的事。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I like your honesty. You don't actually need to know that.
It's not that important.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我喜欢你的坦率。其实你不知道也没关系，这并不重要。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
According to the government of Schwaltzvalt, the use of teleport in the village is prohibited to prevent the overuse of magic. But it's just nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
施瓦茨瓦尔特政府声称，为了避免过度使用魔法，禁止在村庄里使用瞬间移动。不过这都是胡扯。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
There was an incident called 'Magic overuse'. Due to this incident, they passed the law to prohibit teleporting. In my opinion, 'Magic overuse' was manipulated by the government of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
曾经发生过一起所谓的“魔法滥用事件”，之后他们就通过法律禁止瞬间移动。在我看来，这起事件是施瓦茨瓦尔特政府一手操纵的。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
We think the Schwaltzvalt government installed the equipment to limit teleporting to protect the secret research of the Rekenber enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们认为，施瓦茨瓦尔特政府安装了限制瞬间移动的设备，是为了掩护雷根贝勒企业的秘密研究。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Looking at the series of incidents that happened after the equipment was installed, our conviction has become stronger.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
设备安装后发生的一连串事件，更加坚定了我们的判断。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Series of incidents?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一连串事件？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Haven't you heard of the mysterious disappearance in the slum?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你没听说过贫民窟的神秘失踪案吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Since it's an incident that has already happened and it is not important now, I will skip the explanation. If you are curious about it, you can search it later on.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
那件事已经过去了，现在也不重要，我就不细说了。你要是好奇，以后可以自己调查。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
In any case, we will destroy all the 'Teleport prohibition equipment' installed in Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
总之，我们要摧毁施瓦茨瓦尔特设置的所有“瞬间移动禁止设备”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know its location?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道设备在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Wow~ That's so sharp..
What a sharp question.
You deserve to be a hot person.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哇~问得真敏锐...真是个厉害的人。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
That's the problem we face now. This equipment is being hidden and protected by various technologies, including magic.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
这正是眼下的难题。设备被魔法等各种技术隐藏并保护着。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahahaha. But you don't have to worry.
At least, I know the location of one part of the equipment.
Do you know 'Einbech, the mining village'?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈，不过不用担心。至少我知道其中一处设备的位置。
你知道采矿村庄艾音贝赫吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahaha. Of course you do, this area, Clana Nemieri, is also in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
当然知道，这里的克拉纳·内米埃里也在艾音贝赫。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Anyway, our agent in Einbech reported that a suspicious device showed up at the end of a freight train and disappeared quickly. The problem is..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
总之，艾音贝赫的线人报告说，货运列车尾部曾出现一个可疑装置，很快又消失了。问题是...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
There is no way to reveal the hidden and protected device for us to destroy..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们没办法让那个被隐藏和保护的装置现形，也就无法摧毁它...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
In this case, we can revise the incident step by step from the beginning, right?
Maybe we can find something we missed.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
既然如此，我们可以从头开始，一步步还原当时的情况。
说不定能找到遗漏的线索。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你同意吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It's been a long time since I used my head for the last time. Let's take a break to clear our minds.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我好久没动脑筋了。先休息一下，理理思路吧。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! It's high time to use my head, after a long while.
I will tell you the situation step by step from the moment when the agent found an unusual device. Once you find anything abnormal, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！好久没动脑筋，是时候活动一下了。
我从线人发现异常装置时开始讲起。发现任何不对劲的地方就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
One day, our agent H in Einbech came out of the guardroom for the usual night patrol with a torch and club in each hand. H was wearing guard clothes.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
有一天，我们在艾音贝赫的线人H像往常一样夜巡，左右手分别拿着火把和棍棒，从警卫室走了出来。H穿着卫兵制服。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
H finished the patrol following the usual order. Finally, H went to the end of the freight train where he found an abnormal device.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
H按惯常路线完成巡逻。最后，他来到货运列车尾部，在那里发现了异常装置。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Normally, there is a strong wind every now and then. But, on that day, the wind was strong enough to turn off the light. Then..
H said that a suspicious device appeared for a moment and disappeared quickly.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
平时这里偶尔会刮大风。那天风大到把火把吹灭了。就在那时...
H说他看到一个可疑装置突然出现，随即又消失了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
That's it..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
就是这样...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The only information we have is the statement by the agent.. After listening to this story, did you find anything unusual?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们只有线人的这份证词...听完后，你发现哪里不对劲了吗？

scripts.text: Guard clothes
scripts.translation: 卫兵制服

scripts.text: Club
scripts.translation: 棍棒

scripts.text: The way H patrolled
scripts.translation: H巡逻的路线

scripts.text: Freight train
scripts.translation: 货运列车

scripts.text: A strong wind
scripts.translation: 强风

scripts.text: The turned-off torch
scripts.translation: 被吹灭的火把

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
He was wearing neat guard clothes cleaned and ironed by his daughter. But it's not unusual to wear neat guard clothes
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
他说制服是女儿洗好熨好的，很整洁。不过穿着整洁的卫兵制服本身没什么奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
H says he carries a club every time he patrols, to prepare for some unexpected situations. This is not unusual either.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
H说他每次巡逻都会带棍棒，以防突发状况。这也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
H patrols through the same course every day. He says it's written in the guard manual. I find nothing strange about it. Do you?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
H每天都走同一条巡逻路线，说是卫兵手册规定的。我觉得没什么奇怪。你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It was a train that carried coal from the mine. Since it was night, the train stopped. Well, they say the train is not operated a lot these days due to a great deal of monsters in the mine.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
那是从矿坑运煤的列车。因为当时是夜里，列车停着没动。听说矿坑里魔物很多，最近列车也很少运行。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Since it is a mountainous area, there is occasionally a strong wind, even in normal times.. It happens every day, so I don't find it strange.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
这里是山区，平时偶尔就会刮大风。这种事每天都会发生，我不觉得奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
A strong wind.. The turned-off torch..
Oh?! I think I have found it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
强风...被吹灭的火把...
哦？！我想我找到线索了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahahahaha. You are a genius. Thanks to your support, the puzzle is solved. Now we have a reliable theory and let's test it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈哈哈，你真是天才！多亏你的提示，谜题解开了。现在我们有了可靠的推测，来验证一下吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What kind of theory is it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么推测？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hmm? You haven't noticed yet? I thought you noticed it already and then gave me a hint.
It's not that important.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嗯？你还没发现吗？我以为你已经看出来了，才给我提示的。
不过这也不重要。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The Turned-off torch.. Fire!! Yes, it's the fire. Since Einbech is a mountainous area, there is occasionally a strong wind there, even in normal times. What was different from usual was that the torch was turned off.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
熄灭的火把...火！没错，关键就是火。艾音贝赫地处山区，平时偶尔也会刮大风。真正反常的是火把熄灭了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Normally they say the fire is the strongest right before being turned off. So my theory focused on the fact that the device appeared for a while and disappeared quickly right before the torch was gone.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
据说火焰在熄灭前会变得最旺。所以我的推论是：装置出现了一瞬间，随即在火把熄灭前消失了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The very moment when the fire is strong and disappears!! That is the condition for the device to appear.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
火焰最旺、即将熄灭的那一刻！装置只有在这种情况下才会出现。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
What do you think about my theory? Isn't it worth trying?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你觉得我的理论怎么样？值得一试吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem so excited and I really don't get what you are saying. But if you are so positive about it, let's try. Trying won't hurt. Would it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起来兴奋极了，我完全没听懂你在说什么。不过既然你这么有把握，那就试试看吧，反正试试也没坏处，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Since you are a hot person, your answer is also hot. Great! Let's go and try it. It's in this village anyway.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你果然够热血，回答也这么爽快。太好了！我们去试试吧，反正就在村子里。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You come to the very end of the freight train with the items with full of fire attributes.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
带上火属性物品，去货运列车的尽头找我。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
See you at the end of the freight train.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们在货运列车的尽头见。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You were awesome. You deserve to be the hottest fellow in Clana Nemieri these days.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
干得漂亮！你不愧是如今克拉纳·内米埃里最酷的人。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hey look! My elder sister is so glad to hear that the equipment was destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嘿，你看！我姐姐听到装备被销毁的消息，高兴坏了。

scripts.text: His elder sister was just fishing around books and documents that she was looking at. But Arivero didn't seem to care about it and continued to speak in excitement.
scripts.translation: 他的姐姐仍在翻阅书籍和文件。阿里维罗似乎没注意到，依旧兴奋地说个不停。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh! I almost forgot.
Since we revealed the secret of teleport prohibition equipment, our agent in Lighthalzen was able to spot the location and attributes of the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦！我差点忘了。
既然我们揭露了禁止瞬间移动装备的秘密，我们在里希塔乐镇的特工已经锁定了装备的位置和属性。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hmm..
The location is inside the mansion. The attribute is water. This information is too simple. Can we find it with this?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嗯...
装置在宅邸里，属性是水。这些情报也太笼统了，光凭这些能找到吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Water on four sides.. Water attribute..
What kind of relationship is there between its installed location and the attribute of teleport prohibition device?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
四面是水...水属性...
它的安装位置和禁止瞬间移动装置的属性之间有什么关系呢？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It gives me a headache. Let me think about it later.
What do we need here? We need one Mystic Frozen to reveal the device.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
真让人头疼，之后再想吧。
我们现在需要什么？需要一块水灵原石来显现装置。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Is Wind strong against Water? Hey pal. What is the attribute stone for wind attribute? Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
风属性克制水属性吗？嘿，朋友，风属性原石叫什么来着？你知道吗？

scripts.text: Flame Heart
scripts.translation: 火灵原石

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen
scripts.translation: 水灵原石

scripts.text: Rough Wind
scripts.translation: 风灵原石

scripts.text: Great Nature
scripts.translation: 土灵原石

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Not Flame Heart. It's a fire attribute stone that revealed the device in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不是火灵原石。那是火属性原石，用来显现艾音贝赫的装置。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
And Mystic Frozen is a water attribute stone required to reveal the device in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
而水灵原石是水属性原石，用来显现里希塔乐镇的装置。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Yes, it is! Rough Wind! This is the attribute stone of Wind attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
没错！风灵原石！这就是风属性原石。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great Nature? Isn't it for the Ground attribute? I don't think we need it right now.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
土灵原石？那是地属性的吧，现在应该用不上。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! Bring me one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds.
See you in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！带一块水灵原石和三块风灵原石来。
我们在里希塔乐镇见。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's strange. Why are you in such a hurry?
Is there anything urgent?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真奇怪。你为什么这么着急？
有什么紧急的事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh, did I look like that? We already have the information and I was trying to destroy the equipment quickly before they become aware of it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦，我看起来那么着急吗？我们已经掌握了情报，我想赶在他们察觉前尽快摧毁设备。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah! I see.
It is a great idea.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！我明白了。
这是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
As I told you, I used to be the hottest person in Clana Nemieri before you showed up!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
正如我告诉你的，在你出现之前，我可是夜巡者转职考试地点最火热的人物！

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh!
Hey, let's get down to the business. Bring the materials and see you in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦！
说正事吧。带上材料，我们在里希塔乐镇碰面。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You were marvelous in Lighthalzen. No wonder you're such a hot person.
Look at her! My elder sister is even more pleased than before.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你在里希塔乐镇干得真漂亮！难怪你这么酷。
快看，我姐姐听说设备被毁，比刚才更高兴了！

scripts.text: Upon any consideration, I think Vero is misunderstanding something. The poker-faced lady he calls his sister is still fishing around books and documents. And why is he saying that she is pleased? Why does he say that?
scripts.translation: 不管怎么看，我都觉得维罗误会了什么。他那位面无表情的姐姐还在翻阅文件。他怎么会觉得她很高兴？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I wanted to ask you about this. Is she really pleased?
Look at her. She's not even looking here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想问问你这件事。她真的很高兴吗？
看看她。她甚至都没看这边。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
What?! Can't you see her being pleased? Look at her now. She is pretending to ignore us, because she is shy. But the glow around her cheeks shows that she is pleased. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
什么？你看不出她有多高兴吗？她现在只是假装不理我们，因为害羞了。你看她脸颊泛红，这不就说明她很开心吗？懂了吧？

scripts.text: Well, I don't get it. But I will just accept it, as her younger brother says so.
scripts.translation: 我还是不太明白。不过既然她弟弟这么说，我就姑且相信吧。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hey! Friend!! There's something more important than it.
We have a problem. According to our schedule, we were planning to destroy the equipment in Yuno right after destroying the equipment in Lighthalzen..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嘿，朋友！还有更要紧的事。
我们遇到麻烦了。原定在里希塔乐镇摧毁设备后，马上就去破坏尤诺的设备...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Remember the device that prevented the prohibition equipment from disappearance?
You know that stuff? That is out of order now.
So we have to fix it before leaving.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还记得那个用来防止禁制装置消失的设备吗？
就是那个东西，现在坏了。
所以我们得先修好再走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are dragging on.. You have something to ask me for, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你别绕弯子了...有事要我帮忙，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hahaha. You figured it out? We are lucky to have all the materials to repair it, except for one core material. As usual, core materials are always a problem.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈哈。你猜到了？我们运气不错，除了一个核心材料外，修复所需的材料都齐了。老样子，核心材料总是个问题。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
So please bring one Star Crumb, the core material. Once you bring it to me, we can repair it and leave right away. I will be ready for it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
所以请带一颗星星的角来，那是修理所需的核心材料。拿来之后我们就能马上修好设备出发。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
All we have to do is to insert the Star Crumb. So once you bring it, we can leave right away.
Regarding the location and required attribute stone, I will inform you then. I haven't finished collecting the information yet. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
只要把星星的角装进去就行。你一带来，我们就能马上出发。
地点和所需属性原石，我到时候再告诉你。我还没收集完情报，就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The basic repair is all over.
Now let me insert a Star Crumb, the core material..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
基本修理已经完成。
现在让我把星星的角这个核心材料装进去...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The basic repairing is all over. But you haven't brought the Star Crumb yet. Please bring it soon.
Let's complete this operation quickly.
I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
基本修理已经完成，但你还没带星星的角来。请尽快带来。
我们得尽早完成这次行动。
拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The repairing is nearly over. Oh! You've brought it.
Now let me insert a Star Crumb on the device. It's the end of repairing!!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
修理快完成了。哦，你把材料带来了！
现在我来把星星的角装进设备。修理终于要完成了！！

scripts.text: It's quite suspicious that Vero is not looking straight into my eyes. Maybe all he needed was the Star Crumb from the beginning. Shall I ask him about this?
scripts.translation: 维罗一直不敢直视我的眼睛，实在可疑。也许他从一开始就只想要星星的角。要不要问问他？

scripts.text: Just laugh it off.
scripts.translation: 一笑置之

scripts.text: Ask him.
scripts.translation: 问他

scripts.text: Phew.. Let's just laugh it off. Fair is fair after all.
scripts.translation: 呼...算了，就当没看出来吧。说到底，公平交易嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is suspicious. Tell me honestly.
I won't be mad. All you needed was the Star Crumb from the beginning, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很可疑。老实告诉我。
我不会生气的。你从一开始就只需要星星的角，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
No! What kind of jerk do you take me for? Just look into my eyes!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不！你以为我是那种人吗？看着我的眼睛！

scripts.text: It's very suspicious of him to be mad like it. But I decided to laugh it off.
scripts.translation: 他气成这样，反而更可疑了。不过我决定装作没发现。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Although there has been a minor incident, now we have two more prohibition equipment devices to destroy.
But since we found the location and attribute of the prohibition equipment installed in Yuno, we can leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
虽然出了点小状况，但还有两台禁制设备等着我们去破坏。
不过，尤诺那台设备的位置和属性都查清楚了，现在就能出发。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The coordinates of Yuno's prohibition equipments are 206 224
It has a Wind attribute. Our agent will give us a Rough Wind, so we will be able to destroy it once we get there.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
尤诺那台禁制设备的坐标是206, 224。
它是风属性的。我们的特工会给我们一块风灵原石，到了那里就能摧毁设备。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Please get four Great Natures and come to Yuno. They have opposite attributes to the Wind attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
请准备四块地灵原石，然后到尤诺来。地属性正好克制风属性。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
See you in Yuno.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我们在尤诺见。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah! Sir, that's not what I am talking about.. You briefly reported to the Rebellion leader regarding what you did with Vero.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！先生，我不是那个意思...我刚才简短地向反叛者首领汇报了和维罗一起执行的任务。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Have you been doing such a great mission?
But it's strange. I've never been reported that there's been such a mission lately.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你竟然执行了这么重要的任务？
不过很奇怪，我最近没听说有这样的任务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No mission? Then what happened to the mission I did?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有任务？那我执行的任务是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
I'm curious about it, too. I know you are exhausted after coming back from your mission. But please tell me about your mission in detail.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我也很好奇。知道你刚出任务回来很疲惫，不过还是请详细说说任务经过。

scripts.text: You told the Rebellion leader about what happened during your mission to eliminate Teleport prohibition equipment of Schwaltzvalt with Vero.
scripts.translation: 你向反叛者首领讲述了与维罗一起执行的任务，内容是摧毁施瓦茨瓦尔特（Schwaltzvalt）的禁止瞬间移动设备。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Arivero Yurhik.. As you said, that Gunslinger's surname seems to be same with that of Noa here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
阿里维罗·尤尔希克...正如你所说，那位神枪手的姓氏似乎和诺亚一样。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
