But as far as I can remember, there is no Gunslinger named Arivero Yurhik in Clana Nemieri..
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
但据我所知，克拉纳·内米埃里并没有叫阿里维罗·尤尔希克的神枪手...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oops?! I don't get it.. Although he disappeared in Einbroch all of a sudden, he was certainly doing the mission with me..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？！我不明白...虽然他突然在艾音布罗克消失了，但他确实一直和我一起执行任务...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Wait! Calm down and listen to me.
The young man named Arivero told you he's a younger brother of Noa. Right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
等等，冷静下来听我说。
那个叫阿里维罗的年轻人告诉你，他是诺亚的弟弟，对吧？

scripts.text: I nodded.
scripts.translation: 我点了点头。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
I have a strong feeling that Arivero guy you met is Noa's brother, even if Noa's younger brother died in an accident when he was young.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
我强烈觉得你遇到的阿里维罗就是诺亚的弟弟，尽管诺亚的弟弟小时候就因意外去世了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really?! Did you say he died..?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的吗？！你说他已经去世了...？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
In this world, there are so many things that we cannot identify.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
这个世界上有很多事情，我们至今都无法解释。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Well! That's all about it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
好了！事情就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
I can't tell you any further, because it is Noa's personal information. Let's not talk about this anymore. By the way..
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
那是诺亚的私事，我不能再多说。我们别再谈这个了。对了...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You did a great job. Maybe, two of you?
You two destroyed all Teleport prohibition equipment of Schwaltzvalt.
Although the mission started unusually, it is surely a remarkable achievement.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
你们做得很好。也许该说是你们两位？
你们摧毁了施瓦茨瓦尔特所有的禁制装置。
任务虽然开始得很离奇，但成果确实了不起。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Since it was not an official mission, I cannot give you a huge reward. But it's still a remarkable achievement.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
由于这不是官方任务，我无法给你们丰厚的奖励。但这仍然是一项了不起的成就。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Let's say this is a small compensation for your great work.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首领]
就把这个当作对你们出色表现的一点谢礼吧。

scripts.text:
The Rebellion leader disappeared like that.
What the hell happened to me?
I will remember this as a mission with various questions remaining.
scripts.translation:
反叛者首领就这样消失了。
我到底经历了什么？
这趟任务留下了许多未解之谜，我会一直记得。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of fire attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
欢迎，伙计。带来我让你找的火属性物品了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Not yet? Please bring an item full of Fire attributes.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还没吗？请带来火属性强的物品。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of fire attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
欢迎，伙计。你带来我让你找的那个充满火属性力量的物品了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Flame Heart?
Oh, Flame Heart? I heard it's an item with a strong fire attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
火灵原石？
哦，火灵原石啊。我听说它蕴含很强的火属性。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Shall I try? Let's see. This seems to be the place the agent told us about. Now we have to break the Flame Heart you brought into pieces..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我试试看...这里应该就是特工说的地点。现在把你带来的火灵原石敲碎...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Yeah~ Great. It's a success.
The equipment showed up. Yikes! Turn on the device you brought before the equipment disappears..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
耶~太好了，成功了！
设备出现了。哎呀！趁它消失前，赶快启动你带来的固定装置...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
It was a vague theory, but it succeeded.
Shall we destroy it, pal?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
虽然这只是个粗略的推测，但真的成功了。
伙计，我们要把它摧毁吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
What? Why is it unscathed?
I thought the attack was strong enough..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
什么？它怎么毫发无损？
我还以为刚才那下足够有力...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
. . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh! Perhaps..? Hey, pal. This equipment has a Fire attribute. What is the attribute opposite to Fire?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦！难道...？嘿，伙计，这台设备是火属性的。火属性相克的是什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Water.

[Arivero Yurhik]
That's it!! Water!! A water attribute.
If we attack it using a Water attribute, the equipment will be destroyed. Hey, pal. Bring an item with a strong Water attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
没错！！水属性！！
只要用水属性攻击，设备就会被摧毁。伙计，去找水属性强的物品来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Obviously we will need more than one. Please bring me several of those. I will be guarding here to prevent the equipment from disappearing.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
显然一个不够。请多带几个来，我会留在这里看守，免得设备消失。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of Water attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
欢迎，伙计。你带来我让你找的那个充满水属性力量的物品了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Not yet?
We need an item that has a strong Water attribute.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还没吗？
我们需要一个水属性很强的物品。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Mystic Frozen? Certainly it's an item that has a strong Water attribute. Right. Mystic Frozen will be the equipment strong enough for our purpose. But one or two will not be enough.
I think we need at least three of them.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
水灵原石？它确实蕴含很强的水属性。没错，应该足以对付这台设备。不过一两块不够。
我想至少要三块。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Mystic Frozen? Certainly it's an item that has a strong Water attribute. Right. Mystic Frozen will be the equipment strong enough for our purpose. Let's try it.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
水灵原石？它确实蕴含很强的水属性，足够对付这台设备。我们试试看吧。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! We destroyed the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！我们摧毁了设备。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Good job, pal.
Although we destroyed the equipment, there is some magic power remaining. Therefore, teleporting will not be possible in this area for a while.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
干得好，伙计。
虽然设备摧毁了，但仍残留一些魔力，所以这片区域暂时无法使用瞬间移动。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
But, eventually, teleporting will become possible.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不过，等魔力消散后，就能恢复瞬间移动了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
We destroyed the prohibition equipment. Now let's go back to Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
禁制装置已经摧毁。现在回克拉纳·内米埃里吧。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Sorry! Sorry! As a matter of fact, I arrived here early. But I had to talk to the agent to get the right location. I should have arrived and called you in advance. Sorry to make you come here alone.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
抱歉！真的抱歉！其实我早就到了，但得先找特工确认准确位置。我应该早点通知你，让你别一个人跑来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You're so great!
Coming all the way here only with that information! I could not find this, so I had to meet the agent.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你太厉害了！
光凭那点情报就找到这里了！我自己找不到，只好去见特工。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The important thing is that we both arrived here safely. Remember I asked you to bring one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds. Right?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
最重要的是我们都平安到了。记得我让你带一块水灵原石和三块风灵原石吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Where are the items I asked you for?
We must destroy this before they realize that the equipment items are being destroyed one by one. Bring them quickly.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我让你带的材料呢？
趁他们还没发现设备一台台被毁，我们得赶紧摧毁这里这台。快拿来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oops! There's someone passing by.
I might look suspicious, so I will hide myself.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
糟了！有人经过。
我在这里太显眼了，先躲起来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Sorry! Sorry! As a matter of fact, I arrived here early. But I had to talk to the agent to get the right location. I should have arrived and called you in advance. Sorry to make you come here alone.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
抱歉！抱歉！其实我早就到了。但我必须找特工确认准确的位置。我应该早点到并通知你的。抱歉让你一个人跑来这里。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You're so great!
Coming all the way here only with that information! I could not find this, so I had to meet the agent.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你太厉害了！
只凭那些信息就一路找来了！我找不到这里，所以不得不去见特工。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
The important thing is that we both arrived here safely. Remember I asked you to bring one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds. Right?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
重要的是我们都安全地到了这里。记得我让你带一个水灵原石和三个风灵原石吧？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Mystic Frozen. The location is clear, because I checked it with our agent. If we break the Mystic Frozen you brought into pieces..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
水灵原石。位置很明确，因为我通过特工确认过了。如果我们把你带来的水灵原石打碎...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Good! The equipment has showed up..
And we installed the device we brought..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
很好！设备出现了...
我们带来的固定装置也安好了...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great. Now we can destroy it. Prepare the Rough Wind.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了。现在我们可以摧毁它了。准备好风灵原石。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Nevertheless, the first one is always tough and it is easier from the second one. Now let us disappear with teleporting..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
不过，第一台总是最难的，之后就容易多了。现在用瞬间移动撤离吧...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
. . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Yikes! I almost forgot.
We cannot teleport immediately after destroying it. I told you about it and I forgot it myself! What a shame.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哎呀！我差点忘了。
摧毁后不能立刻使用瞬间移动。我告诉过你的，结果我自己都忘了！真丢人。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Ha! In the past, due to the magic power of this prohibition equipment.. Oh! It's nothing.
We cannot help walking.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哈！之前都是因为这台禁制装置的魔力...哦，没什么。
总之，我们只能走着离开了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
To avoid getting caught, let's scatter.
See you in Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
为了不被发现，我们分头行动吧。
克拉纳·内米埃里见。

scripts.text: Is this it? The mansion surrounded by water? According to the condition, it seems like it.
scripts.translation: 这是那座宅邸吗？四面都被水环绕...看来符合条件。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oops?! My hot friend has already arrived.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哎呀？！我最酷的朋友已经到了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Welcome, pal! I have just arrived now. I summoned the equipment and mounted it to prevent from disappearing.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
欢迎，伙计！我刚到这里，已经把固定装置架好了，免得设备消失。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Have you brought Great Nature?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你带土灵原石了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Not yet. I will be guarding this here. Please bring it quickly.
According to our agent, Rekenber and the government are serious now.
I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
还没带来吗？我会在这里看守，请尽快拿来。
特工说雷肯贝尔和政府都认真起来了。
就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
You are a reliable friend of mine.
Since we don't have enough time, let's destroy the equipment quickly and go to Einbroch. According to our agent, Rekenber and the government are serious now.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你可是我信得过的朋友。
时间不多了，我们赶紧摧毁设备，再去艾音布罗克。特工说雷肯贝尔和政府已经开始认真应对了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I will destroy the equipment right now.
Prepare Great Nature.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我现在就摧毁装备。
准备好土灵原石。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
We destroyed the prohibition equipment and there appear to be.. no eyewitnesses. Just in case, let's scatter and move to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
禁制装置已经摧毁，而且似乎没有目击者。保险起见，我们分头前往艾音布罗克吧。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh! I haven't told you the location.
It is the place where Einbroch Wind turbine is located. You bring three Flame Hearts and one remaining Great Nature. We will use them to destroy the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦！我还没告诉你地点。
就在艾音布罗克的风车那里。你带三块火灵原石和一块剩下的土灵原石过来。我们要用它们来摧毁设备。

scripts.text: Vero disappeared in a hurry, as if he was being chased by something. Take three Flame Hearts and one Great Nature and go to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 维罗匆忙消失了，好像被什么东西追赶着。带上三块火灵原石和一块土灵原石，去艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
have you brought three Flame Hearts and one Great Nature?
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
你带三块火灵原石和一块土灵原石了吗？

scripts.text: Vero is pressing me, as if he does not have much time left. Something is fish. But I'm not asking him, as I know he won't tell me.
scripts.translation: 维罗催得很急，好像剩下的时间不多了。总觉得哪里不对劲。不过我没问他，因为知道他不会说。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Please. And the last one is...
No! Nothing. Please bring it here as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
拜托了。还有最后一件...
不，没什么。请尽快带来。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Great! Destroy the Great Nature now, so that the equipment will show up!!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
太好了！现在把土灵原石弄碎，让设备显现出来！！

scripts.text: His voice betrays his panic. And he also asked me to do the job that he had been doing by himself. Is there something wrong? I was curious. I broke the Great Nature into pieces as he asked.
scripts.translation: 他的声音里透着慌乱。他还让我来做原本一直由他亲自做的事。到底出了什么问题？我心里犯嘀咕，但还是照他的要求把土灵原石砸碎了。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Now! Time to use the Flame Heart!
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
现在！是时候用火灵原石了！

scripts.text: As Vero asked me, I smashed the Teleport Prohibition equipment with the Flame Heart.
scripts.translation: 我照维罗说的，用火灵原石砸毁了瞬间移动禁制装置。

scripts.text: The equipment was destroyed quickly. Then I realized that Vero looked a bit abnormal. Is he sick or something?
scripts.translation: 设备很快就被摧毁了。我这才注意到维罗有些不对劲。他是不是病了？

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Hey, pal! I know I have been naughty. But, thanks to your support, I managed to eliminate every Teleport Prohibition equipment in Schwaltzvalt.
Thank you for helping me. This was my wish.
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
嘿，伙计！我知道自己一直有点胡闹。不过多亏你帮忙，我才成功摧毁了施瓦茨瓦尔特所有的瞬间移动禁制装置。
谢谢你帮我实现了这个心愿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What.. Why are you saying that?
As if you were going far away?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么...你为什么突然这么说？
听起来像是要远行一样。

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
What's that look? Hahaha. I would like to take a photo of you. Well..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
干吗这副表情？哈哈哈。我想给你拍张照。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
I must be showing my gratitude now. But I have to ask you for one more favor. Please talk to my elder sister once in a while. She is lonely quite often..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
我该好好向你道谢。不过还想请你再帮个忙：偶尔去陪我姐姐聊聊天吧，她常常很孤单...

scripts.text:
[Arivero Yurhik]
Oh.. It's time.. Bye.. Thanks..
scripts.translation:
[阿里维罗·尤尔希克]
哦...时间到了...再见...谢谢...

scripts.text:
Vero disappeared all of a sudden after saying goodbye. What's going on here? Has he been summoned for an urgent mission?
Vero's gone. Shall I go back to Clana Nemieri?
scripts.translation:
维罗道别后便突然消失了。到底怎么回事？他是被紧急召去执行任务了吗？
维罗走了。要不要回克拉纳·内米埃里？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You...?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你...？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You... You're the adventurer who showed up with the Secret Wings.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你...你就是那个和秘密之翼一起来的冒险者。
有什么事吗？

scripts.text: You told him what you heard from Elena Volkova and asked him for a consultation.
scripts.translation: 你告诉他从埃琳娜·沃尔科娃那里听来的消息，并向他请教。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
If it was about the Secret Wings, I would not have mentioned anything. But for that issue, I will help you.
As commander Volkova said, I brought those kids.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
如果是秘密之翼的事，我本来不会多说。不过这件事我愿意帮忙。
正如沃尔科娃指挥官所说，我把那些孩子带来了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
...I heard what happened to them lately. But I didn't know they were suffering like that.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
...我最近听说了他们的遭遇，却不知道他们一直过得那么辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I want to talk to Lebedev twins myself. But it is an arrogation and it will be bad for Commander Volkova.
Commander Volkova knows that too. That's why she sent you.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
我想亲自和列别捷夫双胞胎谈谈，但那样会越权，也会给沃尔科娃指挥官带来麻烦。
她也明白这一点，所以才派你来。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
There are some people who do not like commander Volkova.
Her unit is USU. The commander didn't manage to take care of her squadders so the squadders talked to their former commander? It's a bad scenario.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
有些人不喜欢沃尔科娃指挥官。
她的部队叫USU。要是她没照顾好自己的队员，队员转而求助前任指挥官，那局面可就难看了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Let me give you this. Eat them together with the twins. And tell them to trust me and tell their problems to you.
Forget advices or recommendations and just listen to them for a while. They are good kids and they will definitely understand you. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
把这个拿去和双胞胎一起吃。告诉他们信任我，把烦恼都告诉你。
别急着给建议，先听他们说一会儿。他们都是好孩子，一定会理解你的。明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You're back! Don't be so nervous. They are good kids. Go speak to them.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你回来了！别紧张，他们都是好孩子。去跟他们聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Don't preach at them too much. If they have problems, listen to them. Make sure you give them cookies.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
别对他们说教太多。有烦恼就听他们说。记得把饼干给他们。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Cookies? Lebedev twins made them?
Then I have no choice but to eat them. Give them to me.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
饼干？是列别捷夫双胞胎做的吗？
那我可得尝尝。拿来吧。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You said there were cookies. Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你刚才说有饼干呢？在哪儿？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Smells good. Of course it's not as good as Lucy's...
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
闻起来不错。当然还是不如露西做的...

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Hmm, good! Tell them thanks.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
嗯，不错！替我谢谢他们。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I'm happy, thank you. One bouquet for today is enough.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
我很高兴，谢谢。今天的一束花足够了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You must have other things to do, come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你肯定还有其他事要做，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
...?
You...
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
...？
你...

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
You are the adventurer who created a huge noise in our hideout.
By the way, ... Hmm, no. Never mind.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你就是那个在我们据点闹出大动静的冒险者。
对了...嗯，没什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(... Seems like he wants to say something.)
Would you like to say anything?
scripts.translation: 问问他有什么事

scripts.text: See you.
scripts.translation: 再见

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Oops, sorry. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
哎呀，抱歉。回头见。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Oh, actually... I wanted to ask you for a little favor.
You'll have to visit Einbroch for a while. Would you accept it?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
啊，其实...我想请你帮个小忙。
你得去一趟艾音布罗克。愿意帮忙吗？

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我会帮您的

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Sorry for this inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
抱歉给你添麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Thanks. It's not a tough job.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find a ^0000CDflower girl^000000.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
谢谢，事情不难。
从艾音布罗克天文台往南走，会遇到一位^0000CD卖花女孩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Could you buy a Bunch Of Flowers from that kid and lay it beneath the tree beside her?
There is a small sign below the tree, so you will find it easily.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
向那孩子买一束花，放在她旁边那棵树下。
树下有块小牌子，很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I will count on you. Come back and report, I mean... tell me.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
拜托你了。回来告诉我...我是说，回来向我汇报。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Buy a Bunch Of Flowers from ^0000CDflower girl^000000 and lay it beneath the tree.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find it.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
从^0000CD卖花女孩^000000那里买一束花，放在树下。
从艾音布罗克天文台往南走就能找到。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Buy a Bunch Of Flowers from ^0000CDflower girl^000000 and lay it beneath the tree.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find it.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
从^0000CD卖花女孩^000000那里买一束花，放在树下。
从艾音布罗克天文台往南走就能找到。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Oh, it's you.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
哦，是你啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've spoken with Lucy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我和露西谈过了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Good. How was her health?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
很好。她身体怎么样？

scripts.text: She was fine.
scripts.translation: 她很好

scripts.text: She was talking about you.
scripts.translation: 她在谈论你

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Really? That's good. Didn't she say anything else to you?
Great. Please don't tell about it anyone else except Lebedev twins.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
是吗？那很好。她没跟你说别的？
很好，这件事除了列别捷夫双胞胎，别告诉其他任何人。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
They used to help me for this. But I cannot request them now.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
以前他们会帮我做这件事，但现在我不能再拜托他们了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I see. What did she say?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
我明白了。她说了什么？

scripts.text: You told him what you heard from Lucy.
scripts.translation: 你告诉他你从露西那里听到的话。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
...Perhaps there must have been a huge misunderstanding.
Please don't tell about it anyone else in the Rebellion, except Lebedev twins.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
...也许这其中有很大的误会。
除了列别捷夫双胞胎，别把这件事告诉反叛者的任何人。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
If only she was alive...
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
要是她还活着就好了...

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
No, I shouldn't think like that.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
不，我不该这么想。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Thank you for going.
If you do not mind, will you stop by sometimes and put down some flowers?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
谢谢你跑了一趟。
如果不介意的话，以后有空时能顺便来放些花吗？

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Will you stop by Einbroch again and offer flowers?
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
你会再去艾音布罗克献花吗？

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我会帮您的

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Is that so.
I'm sorry. It's not fun anyway.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
这样啊。
抱歉，不过这事反正也不怎么有趣。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
I hope you can stop by later when you have time.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
希望你有空时能再来一趟。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
There is a tree on the south side from the Einbroch observatory. You will find a ^0000CDflower girl^000000 nearby.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
在艾音布罗克天文台的南边有一棵树，附近能找到一位^0000CD卖花女孩^000000。
非常感谢。

scripts.text: I've been to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 我去过艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Thank you for going. I'd have to stop by myself, but I seldom have time.
Because these are busy times.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
谢谢你跑这一趟。我本来也该亲自去，可实在抽不开身。
最近事情太多了。

scripts.text:
[Detached Force commander Ericsson]
Buy a Bunch Of Flowers from ^0000CDflower girl^000000 and lay it beneath the tree.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find it.
scripts.translation:
[支队指挥官 埃里克森]
从^0000CD卖花女孩^000000那里买一束花，放在树下。
从艾音布罗克天文台往南走就能找到。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Hello. How about a flower?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
你好。要不要买束花？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please bring me a bouquet.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请给我一束花。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Yes, I understand!
Oh, what should I do...
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
好，我知道了！
哎呀，我该怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
I have the flowers, but I ran out of paper to make a bouquet.
The shop I usually buy the paper from is closed...
I cannot go very far alone.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
花是有的，可我没有包花束的纸了。
我平时买纸的店关门了...
我一个人不敢走太远。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Please.
If you bring ^0000CD3 Slick Paper^000000, I will make a bouquet for you without having to pay for the flowers.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
拜托了。
如果你带来^0000CD3张光滑的纸^000000，我就免费帮你包一束花。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Did you bring ^0000CD3 Slick Paper^000000?
If you bring, I will make a bouquet for you without having to pay for the flowers.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
你带了^0000CD3张光滑的纸^000000吗？
带来的话，我就免费帮你包一束花。

scripts.text: Hand over the slick paper.
scripts.translation: 交出光滑的纸

scripts.text: Do not give the paper.
scripts.translation: 不给纸

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Oh, I'm sorry... Didn't you need a bouquet?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
啊，抱歉...你不是需要一束花吗？

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Here, this bouquet is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
给你，这束花很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Hello, welcome back. Which flower do you need?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
你好，欢迎回来。你需要哪种花？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Could you make me a Bunch Of Flowers with carnations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你能用康乃馨给我做一束花吗？

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Oops... As you know, I still don't have enough paper to wrap the flower.
If you bring me ^0000CDthree smooth paper^000000, I will make it for you.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
哎呀...你知道的，我还缺包花的纸。
带来^0000CD3张光滑的纸^000000，我就帮你包一束。

scripts.text: Hand over the slick paper.
scripts.translation: 交出光滑的纸

scripts.text: Do not give the paper.
scripts.translation: 不给纸

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Oops! Sorry. A Bunch Of Flowers... Don't you need it?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
哎呀！抱歉。你不是要一束花吗？

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Sorry. If I don't have enough smooth paper, I cannot make a Bunch Of Flowers...
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
抱歉，没有足够的光滑纸，我就包不出花束...

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Here, this bouquet is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
给你，这束花很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Flower quickly wither, but they are beautiful when they bloom.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
花儿虽然很快就会枯萎，但盛开时真的很美。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Hello, you're here again. What flowers do you need?
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
你好，你又来了。你需要什么花？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can you make a bouquet of carnations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你能做一束康乃馨吗？

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Oh my... I'm sorry, I still don't have enough paper to make a bouquet...
If you bring 3 pieces of ^0000CD smooth paper ^000000, I will make it.
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
哎呀...对不起，我还是没有足够的纸包花束...
带来3张^0000CD光滑的纸^000000，我就帮你包一束。

scripts.text:
[Flower Girl]
Flowers, buy some flowers.
Phew... The air is so hazy that the flowers wither quickly...
scripts.translation:
[卖花女孩]
卖花啦，来买花吧！
唉...空气太浑浊，花很快就枯萎了...

scripts.text: You searched through your back.
scripts.translation: 你翻遍了背包。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where did I put the flower...?
It's not there. Maybe I should buy another one...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把花放哪儿了...？
不在这里。看来得再买一束...

scripts.text:
[Strange Voice]
There is a small sign in front of the tree.
 
 - Here lies a kind {0} -
 
Should I put the bouquet down?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的声音]
树前有一块小牌子。
  
  - 这里安葬着善良的{0} -
  
要把花束放下吗？

scripts.text: Put the bouquet down.
scripts.translation: 放下花束

scripts.text: Don't put the bouquet down.
scripts.translation: 不放下花束

scripts.text: Before laying the flower, you checked whether that tree was the right one.
scripts.translation: 放花前，你先确认了一下这是不是正确的那棵树。

scripts.text: I put down the Cherished Bouquet and took a moment of silence.
scripts.translation: 我放下了吊唁花束，静静默哀片刻。

scripts.text:
[Strange Voice]
Who's there?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的声音]
谁在那里？

scripts.text: Beside the tree, a small grandmother held out her hand.
scripts.translation: 树旁一位矮小的老妇人向我伸出手。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Do you... know who it is? did you know Irene??
Looking at the clothes, I think you're a traveler. My memory is fading.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你...知道她是谁吗？你认识艾琳吗？
看你的穿着，应该是位旅行者。我这记性越来越差了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came here out of a favor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是受人之托来的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
A favor? Adler's and that?
I'm Irene's grandmother who fell asleep here. My name is Lucy.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
受人之托？是阿德勒让你来的吧？
我是艾琳的奶奶，刚才在这里打了个盹。我叫露西。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
At this time of year, Adler is the children who come to me always at this time of year, but this year I will not be able to candles.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
每年这个时候，阿德勒都会带孩子们来看我。可今年，我恐怕没法再点起蜡烛了。

scripts.text: Goodbye.
scripts.translation: 再见

scripts.text: Report on Commander Ericsson and Mrs. Irene.
scripts.translation: 告诉她指挥官埃里克森和艾琳夫人的事

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Bye. Thank you for coming all the way to this countryside.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
再见。谢谢你特意来到这乡下地方。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Irene will thank you. Bye...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
艾琳会感谢你的。再见...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did commander Adler know Irene?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
埃里克森指挥官是怎么认识艾琳的？

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Commander?
...So it was true. Mr. Adler was a soldier with high position after all.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
指挥官？
...这么说是真的。阿德勒先生果然曾是位高级军官。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Although it's a long story to tell a stranger, I will tell you. And you've been sent by Mr. Adler..
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
这事说来话长，不该对陌生人说...不过既然是阿德勒先生派你来的，我就告诉你吧。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
I've been living in Einbech with Irene for a long time.
Irene's mom and dad left the house seeking a better job. It's been more than 10 years since we lost contact.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
我和艾琳在艾音贝赫住了很久。
艾琳的父母为了寻找更好的工作离开了家。我们已经失去联系十多年了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
As you know, there are many accidents in Einbech.
There were only old people left in the village. So it must have been boring for Irene. But she didn't want to move to another village because she believed that her parents would come back one day.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
你也知道，艾音贝赫常常发生事故。
村里只剩老人，对艾琳来说一定很无聊。但她不肯搬去别处，因为相信父母总有一天会回来。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
And... About this time that year, it was when the mine was not closed yet. I heard a rumor that there were bad guys called rebel forces deep inside the mine.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
还有...那年差不多这个时候，矿场还没关闭。我听说矿井深处有一伙坏人，叫反叛者。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
She would go to the mine every day to sell some food. And on that day, I told her not to go there.
But she said it would be okay and went to the mine...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
她每天都会去矿场卖些吃的。那天我劝她别去。
可她说没事，还是去了矿井...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Grandma Lucy started to shed tears and you handed her your handkerchief)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（露西奶奶流下了眼泪，你递给了她手帕）

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Thank you... There was an accident on that day... One of the tunnels was collapsed and some people never came back.
Irene was one of them...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
谢谢你...那天发生了一场事故...一条矿道坍塌，有些人再也没能回来。
艾琳就是其中之一...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must have been devastated...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您一定悲痛欲绝...

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Although they said it was an accident, there was a rumor.
People told me that there were bad guys hiding in the mine and soldiers came to get them.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
虽说那是场意外，却有各种传闻。
有人告诉我，矿井里藏着坏人，士兵是去抓他们的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
But it was not important to me at all.
I just felt devastated to lose my son, daughter-in-law and granddaughter. I was absent-minded and did not find any reason to live on...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
可那些传闻对我来说都不重要。
我只因失去儿子、儿媳和孙女而悲痛欲绝，整日恍恍惚惚，觉得人生再无意义...

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
That's when Mr. Adler visited me.
I was so surprised when he knocked the door of my house...He came in and bowed down to me all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
就在那时，阿德勒先生来看我。
他敲门时我吓了一跳...进屋后，他突然向我深深鞠了一躬。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
I was surprised again and asked him why. Then he told me about Irene.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
我又惊又疑，问他为什么。他这才告诉我艾琳的事。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
He said that Irene's death was his fault and apologized knocking his head on the floor...
I didn't know what was going on and just told him to stop it.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
他说艾琳的死是他的错，还趴在地上磕头道歉...
我完全不明白发生了什么，只让他别再这样。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
He didn't tell me a detailed story. He left the house and came back later. Then he would send flowers and money to me.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
他没有详细解释。离开后又回来过几次，还常常给我送花和钱。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Thanks to his support, I recovered myself. Then I moved to Einbroche and planted this tree to remember Irene.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
多亏了他的帮助，我才重新振作起来。后来我搬到艾音布罗克，种下这棵树纪念艾琳。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Every time he gave me flowers or money, I always refused. But he insisted to give them to me...
I wondered why he was doing this. Nevertheless, he was a high-ranking soldier...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
每次他送花或钱来，我都婉拒，可他还是坚持...
我不明白他为什么这么做，毕竟他可是位高级军官...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
.........
Thank you very much for telling me the hard story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...
谢谢您告诉我这段令人难过的往事。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Welcome. Thanks to you, I heard the story about Mr. Adler. It makes me feel much better now.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
欢迎。多亏了你，我听到了关于阿德勒先生的故事。这让我感觉好多了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma Lucy]
Thank you. If you don't mind, please stop by my house occasionally and talk to this old woman...
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
谢谢你。要是不嫌弃，欢迎偶尔来我家，陪陪我这个老婆子...

scripts.text: You searched through your back.
scripts.translation: 你翻遍了背包。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where did I put the flower...?
It's not there. Maybe I should buy another one...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把花放哪儿了...？
不在那里。也许我该再买一束...

scripts.text: You dedicated the Bunch Of Flowers and paid a silent tribute briefly.
scripts.translation: 你献上一束花，静静默哀片刻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rest in peace, Irene...

[Grandma Lucy]
Traveler. You came again. Thank you.
If you see Mr. Adler, please send him my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[露西奶奶]
旅行者。你又来了。谢谢你。
如果你见到阿德勒先生，请转达我的谢意。

scripts.text: Just then, you met grandma Lucy near the tree and said hello to her.
scripts.translation: 就在这时，你在树旁遇到了露西奶奶，并向她打了个招呼。

scripts.text:
[Huge Tree]
There is a small sign in front of the tree.
- Here lies a kind girl -
scripts.translation:
[巨树]
树前立着一块小牌子。
- 这里长眠着一位善良的女孩 -

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome. This is a weapon store, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎光临，这里是克拉纳·内米埃里武器店。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
We have various weapons including firearms, gunpowder, cannon, mortar and Molotov cocktails. Please visit us often.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我们这里有各种武器，包括枪械、火药、大炮、迫击炮和燃烧瓶。请常来光顾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Oh, you only have firearms!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...咦，你们这里只卖枪械啊！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Firearms are the tres... Sorry? Nemi? We are closed today?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
枪械可是店里的镇店之宝...什么？内米？我们今天休息？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Ah.. Yes. We are closed today. Please visit us later.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
啊...对，我们今天休息。请改天再来。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
About the twins in our unit? You are an adventurer. Why do you ask me such a thing?
I am not interested in you and the noisy tourist either.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
你问我们部队里的那对双胞胎？你一个冒险者，打听他们做什么？
我对你和那个吵闹的游客都没兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
......Phew, a request from commander Volkova... I have no choice but to answer you. But I can only tell you negative things about those kids.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...唉，这是沃尔科娃指挥官的请求...我只能回答你，不过只能说说那两个孩子的坏话。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
There's nothing they can do properly. Plus, they don't even listen to us.
They are the worst kids. I don't know why we have to keep them here.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
他们什么事都做不好，还根本不听我们的话。
真是最差劲的孩子，不知道为什么还要把他们留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Can you see the bandage here? I got this injury by the stray bullet shot by the boy.
They are idiots who cannot even hit an automatic target. They were terrible as if they did not hit it on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
看到我这里的绷带了吗？那个男孩射出的流弹打伤了我。
他们连自动靶都打不中，简直是白痴，差得好像故意脱靶一样。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
That's why I had to move to here, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
所以我才搬到克拉纳·内米埃里来。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Well, this job fits in my talents...
The fact I dislike those kids is a different story.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
嗯，这份工作倒是很适合发挥我的才能...
至于我讨厌那些孩子，那是另一回事。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
After being deployed in the actual battle, they made trouble and run away. I don't know why they call them genius. Someone like me can be called genius.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
他们被派去实战后就惹出麻烦，还临阵脱逃。我真不懂为什么有人叫他们天才。像我这样的人才配叫天才。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
People were just excited about small kids shooting guns.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
大家不过是因为小孩子会开枪才觉得新鲜。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Cookies? Hmm, let me see. Where did you get these?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
饼干？嗯，让我看看。你从哪儿弄来的？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
......Made by those kids?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...是那两个孩子做的？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
No, no. I don't have any prejudice against them any more.
Please give it to me. Let me judge it with my talented taste!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
不不，我已经不再对他们抱有偏见了。
给我尝尝，让我用天才般的味觉评鉴一下！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Why aren't you giving me the cookie?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
你怎么还不把饼干给我？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Please give it to me. I won't be too harsh.
You don't have them?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
快给我吧，我不会太挑剔的。
你没带吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
...Hmm... Yum yum...
Well, not bad.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...嗯...嚼嚼...
还不错。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
It is dry and I feel like it's not fully baked. It's too sweet and the shapes are not consistent. But...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
有点干，像是没烤透。太甜了，形状也不太整齐。不过...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
I can see how much effort they gave to make them. It's delicious.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我看得出他们花了不少心思做这个。味道不错。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome. This is a weapon store, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎光临，这里是克拉纳·内米埃里武器店。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Phew... Oh, sorry.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
呼...啊，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
You... Yeah. You're the one who made a fuss in there, aren't you?
It's good. I would like to ask you for a favor. Will you accept it?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
你...对。你就是刚才在里面闹出动静的那位吧？
正好，我想请你帮个忙。愿意吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
I will give you an opportunity to be in charge of one wing of my talented work.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我可以让你负责我天才作品中的一个环节。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Talented work?

[Mason Bender]
Well, it's a figure of speech. Haha...
Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
嗯，那只是个比喻。哈哈...
你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 帮他

scripts.text: I don't feel good about him. Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 我不喜欢他，还是别理他

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Phew... You have been stimulated by my talented eloquence. That's why you cannot even respond. Of course I understand it...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
呼...你被我的天才口才震住了，连话都说不出来。我理解...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Please calm down and talk to me again. Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
冷静一下，再来跟我说话吧。呵呵...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Not even close!

[Mason Bender]
Great. You've been persuaded by my talented eloquence.
So here's my request.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
很好，你被我天才般的口才说服了。
那么，听听我的请求吧。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
This is the leaflet of our weapon store that I prepared with my talented writing skill.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
这是我用天才文笔写的武器店传单。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Any who reads this will definitely come to this store and buy 81mm mortar.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
读过这份传单的人，一定会来店里买81毫米迫击炮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Who's going to buy such a stuff?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（谁会买这种东西啊？！）

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
But I have a slight problem.
Although I bring these to the village bench or plaza, none of the villagers take the leaflet.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
不过有个小问题。
我把传单放在村里的长椅和广场上，村民却一张也不拿。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Therefore! You bring this yourself! And give the leaflets kindly to each person. Make sure you pass it on someone's hand with a kind smlie on your face.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
所以！你亲自去发吧！
面带微笑，亲切地把传单递到每个人手里。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Nemi has been angry about this malignity stock. If you do that, they will surely be sold well. Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
内米一直为这些滞销的库存发愁。你帮忙发传单，肯定能卖出去。呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now! I will give you the leaflets. See you!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
好了！我把传单给你。再见！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now, I count on you.
In the meantime, I will get ready to receive customers.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
那就拜托你了。
我趁这时候准备接待客人。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Whoops... Have you lost the leaflets?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
哎呀...你把传单弄丢了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Please don't mistreat the leaflets. This time, I will give them to you again.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
请别糟蹋传单。
这次，我再给你一份。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now! There you go!
You will be spreading my talented writing in the entire village!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
好了！给你！
你将把我天才的文案传遍整个村庄！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome back! How did they respond?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎回来！反响如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Just so so...

[Mason Bender]
Oh? Really?!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
哦？真的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
... Oh, I see. My pink brain cells finished the deduction!
They haven't read my leaflets yet!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...啊，我明白了。我粉色的脑细胞推理出结果了！
他们还没看过我的传单！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
They were fascinated by my talented opening so they forgot to read the rest of the leaflet!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
他们被我天才的开头迷住了，以至于忘了读剩下的部分！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Huhu... I can't do anything about it. Let us wait evenly.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
呵呵...我也没办法。耐心等着吧。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
There will be so many people visiting us tomorrow. So I will ask Eri about how to receive many customers.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
明天一定会有很多人来。所以我得问问绘理该怎么接待这么多顾客。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
If you don't mind, could you please come back tomorrow and help me receiving customers? Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
如果你方便的话，明天能回来帮我招待客人吗？呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome! Glad to meet you! Have you come to buy the mortar... Oh?
... It's you, adventurer. Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎光临！很高兴见到你！是来买迫击炮的吗...咦？
...原来是你啊，冒险者。欢迎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait. Were you disappointed! You were!
Seems like your business is in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你是不是失望了？你真的失望了！
看来你的生意不太顺利啊。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
No! The buyers are strategically judging the situation. In other words, they are warming up.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
不！买家只是在审慎评估局势。换句话说，他们正在热身。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Soon they will realize that buying this mortar will bring them great profit and rush to Clana Nemieri! Come on, if you are not buying anything, please leave! Come back later!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
他们很快就会发现，买下迫击炮能赚大钱，到时候就会一窝蜂涌来克拉纳·内米埃里！喂，不买东西就请离开，改天再来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How many of them did you sell!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你卖出了多少门？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
^FF0000Please leave!!!^000000

[Nemi]
How many of them? Not a single mortar.
scripts.translation:
[内米]
多少门？一门迫击炮都没卖出去。

scripts.text:
[Nemi]
Mason is an excellent sniper and people called him genius. After he got injured, he volunteered here provisionally and now he loves this job.
scripts.translation:
[内米]
梅森是个出色的狙击手，大家都叫他天才。受伤后，他自愿来这里暂时帮忙，结果现在还挺喜欢这份工作。

scripts.text:
[Nemi]
Although he does not have any talent in commerce, he is misunderstanding something by chance. Now he is so excited and has too many irons in the fire.
scripts.translation:
[内米]
他其实一点经商天分都没有，却不知怎么误打误撞，以为自己懂生意。现在干劲十足，什么事都想插手。

scripts.text:
[Eri]
I guess we have to stop him as soon as possible.
Otherwise the store might be completely ruined.
scripts.translation:
[绘理]
我看得尽快阻止他。
不然这家店可能真要被他搞垮了。

scripts.text:
[Eri]
I apologize on behalf of Mason that he kicked you out. Please come back tomorrow and give him a valuable advice so that he can rouse himself.
scripts.translation:
[绘理]
梅森把你赶出去，我代他向你道歉。请明天再来，给他提点建议，让他清醒清醒。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome! Clana Nemieri... Oh?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎光临！克拉纳·内米埃里...咦？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
...Oh, what is it? {0}, it was you. I thought it was a customer...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
...怎么了？{0}，原来是你。我还以为是顾客...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you sell your cannons?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的大炮卖出去了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
They are mortars, not cannons. I thought they would be sold today...
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
那是迫击炮，不是大炮。我还以为今天能卖出去...

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
This is strange. According to my calculation, these mortars should have been sold today... And four days later, we are supposed to reach the break-even point. After that, we will begin the turnaround.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
真奇怪，按我的计算，今天应该能卖出这些迫击炮...四天后就能回本，之后就会开始盈利。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
I don't know why. Hmm..
While I analyze the phenomenon, {0} could you please hand out the leaflets to villagers once again?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
真想不通。嗯...
我分析一下情况。{0}，你能再去村里发些传单吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Go to the village and find three people who seem to need the mortar earnestly. And give them these leaflets.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
去村里找三个看起来特别需要迫击炮的人，把传单交给他们。

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我来办

scripts.text: Sorry. I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不接

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Come on... Why aren't you helping me?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
拜托...你为什么不帮我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, nobody needs a mortar here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可是这里根本没人需要迫击炮。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
If you can only sell something to someone who needs it, you are a newbie. I will sell something to some people, and they will need it just because they bought it!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
只有把东西卖给本来就需要的人，才算本事？那你还是个新手！我要把东西卖给别人，让他们买了之后就觉得自己需要！

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
I will sell electric heaters to the people of Moroc. And I will sell refrigerators in Manuc!
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我要去梦罗克卖电暖器，再去曼努克卖冰箱！

scripts.text:
[Eri]
...I hope he uses that passion elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[绘理]
...希望他把这股热情用在别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
My brain cells already knew that you would accept it.
Three sheets of leaflets. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
我的脑细胞早就料到你会答应。
这是三张传单，就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I don't think there will be anyone who seem to need the mortar earnestly)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我看不会有人真的急需迫击炮吧。）

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now, I count on you.
In the meantime, I will get ready to receive customers.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
现在，就拜托你了。
在此期间，我会准备好接待顾客。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Whoops... Have you lost the leaflets?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
哎呀...传单弄丢了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Please don't mistreat the leaflets. This time, I will give them to you again.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
别把传单弄坏了。这次我再给你一份。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Now, I count on you.
In the meantime, I will get ready to receive customers.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
现在，就拜托你了。
在此期间，我会准备好接待顾客。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Welcome back! How did they respond?
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
欢迎回来！反响如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Just so so...

[Mason Bender]
Oh? Really?!
If I were you, I would have read the strong desire and flutter toward mortars in their eyes using my talented intuition.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
哦？真的吗？！
要是我在场，凭我天才般的直觉，早就看出他们眼里对迫击炮的渴望了。

scripts.text:
[Mason Bender]
Then I will get ready to receive customers again!
I will be busy tomorrow. If you want to visit us, make a reservation in advance.
scripts.translation:
[梅森·本德]
那我又要准备接待客人了！
明天会很忙，想来的话记得提前预约。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
After working hard all day long, I enjoy watching the railway and smoking a cigarette. That's the pleasure of my life.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
辛苦工作一整天后，我喜欢看着铁路、抽根烟。这就是我生活中的乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
I call it a pleasure... What's wrong with my life?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
我说这是乐趣...我的生活有什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
Oh, I won't buy it. Besides, you're empty-handed.
I'm so tired after a hard work. Don't annoy me and just leave.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
哦，我不买。而且你两手空空。
工作了一天我很累。别烦我，快走吧。

scripts.text: You handed him the leaflet.
scripts.translation: 你递给他传单。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
What's this? A leaflet? I'm not interested... What the hell do you sell there?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
这是什么？传单？我不感兴趣...你卖什么鬼东西？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
Mortar? Are we having a war? Why would I buy it?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
迫击炮？我们要打仗了吗？我为什么要买那个？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Man]
Oh, no. I won't buy it.
I'm so tired after a hard work. Don't annoy me and just leave.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的男子]
哦，不。我不买。
工作了一天我很累。别烦我，快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
Look at the muddy water that does not reflect anything.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
看看这浑浊的水，什么都映不出来。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
Not a single fish lives here. What's going to happen to this village after the remaining old men are gone?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
这里连一条鱼都没有。等剩下的老人都走了，这个村庄会变成什么样？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
No. I don't need a cannon.
No matter how much you suggest it to me, I don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
不用，我不需要大炮。
你怎么推销都没用，我不需要。

scripts.text: You handed him the leaflet.
scripts.translation: 你递给他传单。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
What is this... What do you ask me to buy? A cannon? Why would I need it?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
这是什么...你要我买什么？大炮？我买它做什么？

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
I will take the leaflets if you give me... But I only need a little amount of gunpowder in the mine.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
传单给我吧...不过，我在矿里只需要一点火药。

scripts.text:
[Tired Looking Old man]
No. I don't need a cannon.
No matter how much you suggest it to me, I don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的老人]
不用，我不需要大炮。
你怎么推销都没用，我不需要。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
At my age... The only pleasure is to be bathed in the sun sitting in a warm place.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
到了我这个年纪...能在暖和的地方晒晒太阳，就是最大的乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
I cannot see and hear well. But listen carefully and don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
我眼睛和耳朵都不太灵了。不过你说吧，我会仔细听的。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
What? Lunch? I've had it already. By the way, you didn't even bring any food.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
什么？午饭？我已经吃过了。顺便说一句，你连食物都没带。

scripts.text: You handed her the leaflet.
scripts.translation: 你递给了她传单。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
What is this? I can't see it properly. Is it a baked chestnut? Looks like a sheet of paper to me.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
这是什么？我看不太清...是烤栗子吗？在我看来倒像张纸。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
Dried filefish fillet? Are you selling it? Oh, I don't have tooth so I can't eat it.
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
干鱼片？你要卖给我吗？我没牙了，吃不了。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy Looking Old woman]
What? Lunch? I've had it already. Hehe...
scripts.translation:
[困倦的老妇人]
什么？午饭？我已经吃过了。呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It's not my fault that our meals are terrible.
If they give me more time and budget, I can cook much better food.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
伙食难吃可不是我的错。
只要多给我点时间和预算，我就能做出更好的饭菜。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Phew, what should I serve the gluttons today? What would they like...?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
唉，今天该给那些大胃王做什么呢？他们会喜欢什么...？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
The reputation of the twins in USU? You're an adventurer. Why do you ask such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
USU那对双胞胎的名声？你是冒险者，为什么要问这种事？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
You have been requested by that unit... Then I should tell you.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
既然是那个部队托你来的...那我就告诉你吧。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Several years ago, commander Ericsson brought them here.
Sounds like he brought them from an orphanage.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
几年前，指挥官埃里克森把她们带到这里。
听起来像是从孤儿院带过来的。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
They took the training without any problem and excelled in shooting. They quickly were able to play a role of a Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她们训练得很顺利，射击尤其出色，很快就成了反叛者的一员。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
They have been trainees for a while and several month ago, they went on the real mission for the first time. That's when they stirred up trouble.
Some people said that the younger sister threw a grenade at the civilian zone. But I don't know the exact story.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她们当了一阵子学员，几个月前第一次执行实战任务。就是那时出了岔子。
有人说妹妹朝平民区扔了手榴弹，但具体情况我也不清楚。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
After that, they were moved to USU, became more educated, etc. There was a fuss.
That's when they began to disobey their seniors.
I think I heard that's what they've been doing... ever since.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
之后她们被调到USU，接受了进一步训练...当时闹出不少风波。
从那以后，她们开始不听前辈的话。
我听说她们一直都是这样...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Before that, they were trainees and had more free time than other squadders. They would visit the mess once in a while, receive some snacks and chat with us.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
之前她们还是学员，比其他队员空闲得多。偶尔会来食堂，吃点心、和我们聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
After that incident, they never came. Just by hearing the stories about them, I don't feel like they are the same kids I used to know.
They used to be better than this... I hope you can take cake of them.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
那件事之后，她们就再也没来过。光听那些传闻，我都觉得她们不像我以前认识的孩子了。
她们过去明明不是这样的...希望你能照顾好她们。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
This is all I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这就是我能告诉你的全部了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I heard a similar story from others...
Maybe the keyword is the incident that happened at the real mission.
I should go back to the twins and ask them about it.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我也从其他人那里听过类似的说法...
也许关键在于她们第一次执行实战任务时发生的事。
我该回去问问双胞胎。）

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Cookies? Made by the twins?
Oh... Those kids. They visited the mess and asked me for several things. Is this the outcome?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
饼干？是双胞胎做的？
哦...那两个孩子之前来食堂找我要过一些东西。这就是她们做出来的？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
I hope they are not trying to poison me...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
希望她们不是想毒死我...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey, I'm just kidding. Don't look at me like that.
They seem to have found their former character. That's good. You did a great job.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嘿，开个玩笑，别这样看我。
她们好像恢复以前的样子了，真好。你做得不错。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
...By the way, where are the cookies?
You don't have anything for me? What a shame! Well~ I like cookies too~
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
...对了，饼干呢？
没给我留吗？真可惜！哎呀~我也喜欢饼干~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
So don't look at me like that!!
Just give me the cookies!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
别那样瞪着我！！
快把饼干给我！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey, you! Adventurer?
What's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嘿，冒险者！
怎么了？

scripts.text: Refreshments for seniors
scripts.translation: 给前辈们准备茶点

scripts.text: Take care of the cat please
scripts.translation: 请帮忙照顾一下猫

scripts.text: You don't have to know.
scripts.translation: 你不用知道

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Yo! Thanks to your support, I'm sure our seniors will enjoy the tea time today!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哟！多亏了你的帮忙，前辈们今天一定能好好享受下午茶！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oops... Again?
No thanks. Our seniors don't eat tea and snacks for every meal! Once a day is enough.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哎呀...又来啦？
不用了，前辈们也不是每顿都吃茶点！一天一次就够了。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
But thank you for your kindness. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
不过还是谢谢你的好意。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Wow! You came again! may I ask you to get the snacks for our seniors?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哇，你又来了！能再帮我给前辈们买些点心吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
How did I know you are an adventurer? It's simple.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
我怎么知道你是冒险者？很简单。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
A stranger rarely visits this place. So someone like you draws everybody's attention.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这里很少有陌生人来，像你这样的人自然会引起大家注意。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
These people must return quickly in emergency, so they cannot go too far from here.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这里的人一遇到紧急情况就得立刻回来，所以不能离得太远。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Therefore, I would like to ask you for a favor... Actually for several. Because it has to be done outside.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
所以想请你帮几个忙...因为都得出去办。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
I am very busy because I have to feed the gluttons~ Well now~ I hope you can do something for me~
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
我得忙着喂那些大胃王~哎呀~希望你能帮我做点事~

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我来帮忙

scripts.text: No. I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 不了，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh~ You're so mean. What a shame.
This is why we should never talk to outsiders. Am I right? Charity~
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哎呀~你真无情，太可惜了。
这就是为什么我们不该和外人打交道，对吧？慈善~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
... Where did my lovely and sweet cat go...?
Oh, I am so gloomy and lonely!! The adventurer rejected my request!!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
...我可爱又乖巧的猫咪去哪儿了...？
啊，我好寂寞、好孤单！！冒险者竟然拒绝了我！！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh, Thank you! The adventurer is so cool!
I would like to ask you to get some snacks.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哦，谢谢你！冒险者真够意思！
能不能帮我去买些点心？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
No, no. Don't look at me like that. They are not for me.
Do you know our seniors who live on the 2nd floor? Have you met them?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
不不，别那样看我。不是给我吃的。
你见过住在二楼的前辈们吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
They enjoy tea time every day.
So I try to get prepare the best tea and snacks... But it's hard to find them in this out-of-the-way place.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她们每天都要喝下午茶。
我总想准备最好的茶和点心...可这里太偏僻，很难买到。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Since I have to cook for our gluttons, I cannot go out too far. So I am sorry that I haven't been able to prepare something delicious.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
我还得给那群大胃王做饭，实在走不开。抱歉一直没能准备好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
You are an adventurer who travels around the whole world! Please bring something delicious for our seniors and me!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
您是走遍世界的冒险者！请给前辈们和我带些好吃的回来吧！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
If the food is too expensive, it might me troublesome for you to get it. Please bring one of the following list.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
太贵的东西可能会让您为难。请从下面的清单里带一样回来就好。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Let's see. ^0000CDGrape Herb Tea^000000, ^0000CDOrchid Black Tea^000000, ^0000CDHoney Herb Tea^000000, ^0000CDChocolate Mousse Cake^000000... or ^0000CDFruits Mix^000000.

[Milo River]
If you bring one of them, our seniors will be happy.
I am not asking you to get all of them. Just one of them will be fine.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
带其中一样回来，前辈们就会很开心。
不用全都买，一样就够了。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It doesn't matter whether you make it on your own or not. I count on you~
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
不管是不是你亲手做的都没关系，就拜托你啦~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
What have you brought? I will read the list.
Tell me what you brought!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
你带了什么回来？我来对一下清单。
告诉我吧！

scripts.text: I don't have any.
scripts.translation: 我什么也没带

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Well, I see. Although you are an adventurer, they are not easy to get. Aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这样啊。虽然你是冒险者，但这些东西也不容易找，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
All I can get around this place are butter with an unpleasant smell and withered herbs. I can't make anything nice with them.
It's just a lack of my ability, haha!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这附近只有味道难闻的黄油和干瘪的草药，根本做不出好吃的东西。
说到底，还是我本事不够，哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Well! Haha, thank you for your kindness!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哎呀！哈哈，谢谢你有这份心！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Give it to me!
... What, you haven't brought any of them?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
快给我！
...什么，你没带回来？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh, it's been a long time since Charity went out. She ate all the forage!
Maybe she will come back after enjoying her stroll. If she doesn't come back, please find her again!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
慈善出去很久了，连猫粮都吃光了！
也许她逛完就会回来。如果还没回来，麻烦再去找找她！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey, adventurer. Do you know the idol of our unit?
Aigu? Hehe. Aigu is everyone's idol.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嘿，冒险者。你知道我们小队的偶像是谁吗？
艾古？呵呵，艾古可是大家的偶像。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It is the beautiful cat who stays right here! Inside the basket beneath this stairway.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
就是那只一直待在这里的漂亮猫咪！就在楼梯下的篮子里。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It's name is Charity! Some guys say it is Arunafeltz Purebred Laherin Shorthair. Actually she just came to us and started living together. So we don't know her breed or age.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她叫慈善！有人说她是阿鲁纳菲兹纯种拉赫林短毛猫。其实她是自己跑来和我们一起生活的，所以我们也不知道她的品种和年龄。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
The important thing is, Charity is so lovely and cute!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
重要的是，慈善非常可爱又讨人喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
By the way... Charity loves strolling and she spends about half of the day wandering outside. Look at this. I gave her forage this morning and she hasn't eaten half of it yet.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
顺便说...慈善很喜欢散步，一天有大半时间都在外头闲逛。看，早上给她的猫粮，她到现在还没吃完一半。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Perhaps somebody is feeding her outside... But I want to feed her good forage. If somebody gives her rotten food... It must not happen.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
也许外面有人在喂她...可我想给她吃最好的猫粮。要是有人拿坏掉的食物喂她...那可不行。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
She shouldn't be fay away. Could you please find Charity in Einbech?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
她应该没走远。能麻烦你去艾音贝赫找找慈善吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
These Anchovy cookies are Charity's favorite snack. Put the cookies on ^0000CDbenches in various places of the village^000000 and call Charity. If she comes out, please bring her to me.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这些鳀鱼饼干是慈善最爱吃的零食。把饼干放在^0000CD村里各处的长椅上^000000，再叫她的名字。她出现后，请把她带回来。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
If she doesn't come out... You can go somewhere else to find her. Maybe she cannot hear you at once. In that case, put Anchovy cookies on the bench and call Charity again.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
如果她没出现...就去别处找找。也许她一时没听到。那就把鳀鱼饼干放在另一张长椅上，再叫她一次。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
I have to prepare the meal for gluttons... Could you go bring Charity?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
我得给那群大胃王做饭...能麻烦你把慈善带回来吗？

scripts.text: Say yes.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Charity... You're getting late. I hope nothing happened to you.
I'm sure people will stop her from rushing to the train of entering the mine. Right?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
慈善...你回来得有点晚了。希望你没遇到什么事。
大家会拦住她，不让她冲上开进矿井的列车，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey! Please say yes. Am I right? People like you will protect her, won't they?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嘿！请说“是”。我说得对吗？像你们这样的人会保护她的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Thank you! I will give you enough Anchovy cookies.
They are for cats. Give them to Charity and bring back the rest of them. Make sure you don't eat them.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
谢谢！我给你足够的鳀鱼饼干。
这是给猫吃的，拿去喂慈善，剩下的带回来。可千万别自己吃了。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oops? You've come back in empty hands. Where are your Anchovy cookies? Have you run out of them already?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哎呀？你空手回来了。你的鳀鱼饼干呢？已经吃完了吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
...Don't tell me you ate them all.
I never thought that you'd actually eat them. Did you eat them?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
...你该不会全吃了吧？
我没想到你真会吃。你吃了吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh, I'm kidding. Did Charity steal them from you? She's so fast and she can do that.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哦，我开玩笑的。是慈善从你那里偷走的吗？她动作很快，完全做得到。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Anyway, I'll give you the Anchovy cookies again. Please keep them safe. This time, you return with Charity and Anchovy cookies!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
总之，我再给你一些鳀鱼饼干。请保管好。这次，你要带着慈善和鳀鱼饼干一起回来！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Have you found Charity? If she doesn't show up, call her several times on the same spot.
Who knows? She might be afraid of you because you are a stranger. Charity is a smart cat. Show her that you are harmless.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
找到慈善了吗？如果她没出现，就在原地多叫几次。
她也许是怕陌生人。慈善很聪明，你得让她知道你没有恶意。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hmm... It's been a while since Charity went out...
But not such a long time for us to worry about her.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嗯...慈善出去已经有一会儿了...
但还没到让我们担心的程度。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
To tell the truth!! I want to see Charity!! I want to pet her!! I miss her so much!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
说实话！！我想见慈善！！我想摸摸她！！我好想她！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
...So, let me give you Anchovy cookies again. Please find Charity.
Put them on ^0000CDVillage Bench^000000 in Einbech and call Charity. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
...我再给你一些鳀鱼饼干，麻烦你找到慈善。
把饼干放在艾音贝赫的^0000CD村庄长椅^000000上，再叫她的名字。你愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 帮助他

scripts.text: Don't help him.
scripts.translation: 不帮他

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Charity... Charity...
Arrgh... Charity... I hope they write on my tombstone that I died while missing Charity so much...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
慈善...慈善...
唉...我希望墓碑上写着：我因太想念慈善而离世...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Please, adventurer... Will you write it on it? Please say yes...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
拜托了，冒险者...你愿意帮我写上吗？求你答应...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Thanks! Go and get her please.
Oh... I'm suffering from withdrawal symptoms... Charity... I should pet her as soon as possible to recover...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
谢谢！快去把她带回来吧。
啊...我好像犯了思猫成瘾...慈善...得尽快摸摸她才能缓过来...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Use the Anchovy cookies to find Charity and bring the rest of them!
Make sure you don't eat them. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
用鳀鱼饼干找到慈善，把剩下的带回来！
记住，千万别自己吃。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oops? You've come back in empty hands. Where are your Anchovy cookies? Have you run out of them already?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哎呀？你空手回来了。你的鳀鱼饼干呢？已经吃完了吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
...Don't tell me you ate them all.
I never thought that you'd actually eat them. Did you eat them?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
...别告诉我你全吃了。
我没想到你真的会吃。你吃了吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh, I'm kidding. Did Charity steal them from you? Phew, she is too fast...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哦，我开玩笑的。是慈善把饼干偷走了吗？唉，她动作真快...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Anyway, I'll give you the Anchovy cookies again. Please keep them safe. This time, you return with Charity and Anchovy cookies!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
总之，我再给你一些鳀鱼饼干。请保管好。这次，你要带着慈善和鳀鱼饼干一起回来！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Have you found Charity? If she doesn't show up, call her several times on the same spot.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
你找到慈善了吗？如果她还没出现，就在原地多叫几声她的名字。

scripts.text:
[Charity]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[慈善]
喵~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh . . . ! !
Charity! I'm so glad you are all right! Look at her soft hairs! Charity!!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哦...！！
慈善！太好了，你没事！看看她柔软的毛！慈善！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one who brought her and he doesn't seem to care about me...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明明是我把她带回来的，他却完全不在意我...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Miss Charity! You must have been exhausted after being brought by this dusty adventurer.. Shall I prepare the bathwater? Or your meal first? Or... Can I pet you first?!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
慈善小姐！被这个灰头土脸的冒险者带回来，一定累坏了吧...要我给你准备洗澡水吗？还是先准备饭菜？或者...让我先摸摸你？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are they doing this on purpose?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们是故意的吗？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh . . . ! !
Miss Charity! I'm glad you are all right! You are beautiful as usual, Charity!!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
哦...！！
慈善小姐！太好了，你没事！你还是这么漂亮，慈善！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one who brought her and he doesn't seem to care about me...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明明是我把她带回来的，他却完全不在意我...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Miss Charity! You must have been exhausted after being brought by this dusty adventurer.. Shall I prepare the bathwater? Or... Can I pet you first?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
慈善小姐！被这个灰头土脸的冒险者带回来，一定累坏了吧...要我给你准备洗澡水吗？或者...让我先摸摸你？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess that's the way they live.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来他们平时就是这么相处的。

scripts.text:
[Charity]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[慈善]
喵~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey, she's quite mean.
...... What a cat.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
嘿，她脾气还挺大。
...真是只猫。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
You didn't have a meal? As far as I know, every creature including humans and cats become aggressive when they are hungry~
Do you want a warm meal? Well, I cannot guarantee the taste.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
你还没吃饭吗？据我所知，人和猫饿着肚子都会变得暴躁~
想吃点热饭吗？不过我可不保证味道好。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
You brought it as you promised! A {0} of {1}. Will you give it to me now?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
你果然按约带来了{0}份{1}。现在可以给我了吗？

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 给他

scripts.text: Do not give it to him.
scripts.translation: 不给他

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Well, I see. Although you are an adventurer, they are not easy to get. Aren't they?
All I can get around this place {0}. I can't make anything nice with them.
It's just a lack of my ability, haha!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
这样啊。你是冒险者，可这些东西也不太好找，对吧？
这附近我只能弄到{0}，用它们做不出什么好吃的。
说到底还是我手艺不精，哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It looks delicious! Thank you for your kindness!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
看起来很好吃！谢谢你的好意！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Thank you so much for making our seniors happy!
I have to prepare for the tea time tomorrow as well... If you don't mind, could you bring it again tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·里弗]
非常感谢你让前辈们开心！
我还得为明天的下午茶做准备...如果不介意的话，明天能再带一些来吗？

scripts.text: No more Anchovy cookie. Let's go back to Milo and get some more.
scripts.translation: 鳀鱼饼干已经用完了。回去找米洛再拿一些吧。

scripts.text: It's an empty bench. Take out several Anchovy cookies and...
scripts.translation: 这是一张空长椅。拿出几块鳀鱼饼干，然后...

scripts.text: Put them on the bench.
scripts.translation: 放在长椅上

scripts.text: Eat them.
scripts.translation: 吃掉它们

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yuck! This is so fishy. What kind of food is this...!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呸！好腥啊！这到底是什么吃的...！！

scripts.text: But nothing happened.
scripts.translation: 但是什么也没发生。

scripts.text:
After waiting for a while, you reclaimed the Anchovy cookies.
Go to another bench or wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
等了一会儿，你收回了鳀鱼饼干。
去另一张长椅试试，或者再等等。

scripts.text:
[Charity]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[慈善]
喵~

scripts.text:
Charity is here!
You lured her with the Anchovy cookie and held her.
scripts.translation:
慈善来了！
你用鳀鱼饼干把她引了出来，并抱住了她。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
I'm charge of repairing here. The supply is handled there.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我负责这里的维修，物资供应要去那边问。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Firearms are actually consumables. If someone shoots them, someone has to maintain them.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
枪械其实是消耗品。子弹打出去后，总得有人负责补充和维护。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Cookies? Where did you get them? Aha... Made by Lebedev kids?
Well. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
饼干？你从哪里弄来的？啊...是列别杰夫家的孩子做的吗？
嗯，谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hmm? Where is the cookie?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯？饼干呢？

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Smells nice... I will ask them the recipe later.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
闻起来真香...我晚点去问问他们配方。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Again? If you broke your weapon and are pretending that you lost it, don't even think about it.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
又来了？如果你把武器弄坏了，却假装弄丢了，那就免谈。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
...... Oops? Oh, sorry. Who are you?
I had three guys today who lied to me that they lost their weapons after breaking them. So I thought you would probably say the same thing.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
...哎呀？哦，抱歉，你是谁？
今天有三个人把武器弄坏后，骗我说弄丢了。所以我还以为你也会这么说。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Aha, you are an advanturer.
Come to think of it, you must be that adventurer who had a sparring with commander Elena of USU. You're so brave.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
啊，你是冒险者。
仔细一想，你就是和USU指挥官埃琳娜切磋过的那位冒险者吧。真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
I'm Rachel Smith. I'm a Blacksmith and I assist repairing weapons and maintenance.
Would you like to show me your weapon? By looking at many weapon, I can study them.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我是瑞秋·史密斯，是一名铁匠，负责协助维修和保养武器。
能让我看看你的武器吗？我想多观察一些武器，好好研究一番。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hmm... This is a nice weapon. You ran it in properly.
It's interesting. Although they are same weapons, they have different tendencies according to what the owner focuses on.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯...这把武器不错，保养得很好。
真有意思。即使是同一种武器，也会因主人看重的方面不同而展现出不同特性。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
... But it doesn't happen to the weapons that I repaired. I don't know why.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
...不过，我维修过的武器却不会这样。我也不知道为什么。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Oh, sorry. I'm worried about something recently. Those weapons I have repaired lately have a high defect rate.
The people are struggling in the field because of that.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
啊，抱歉。我最近一直为一件事烦心。我最近维修的武器故障率很高。
大家因此在战场上吃了不少苦头。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Fortunately, nothing bad has happened so far. But I'm so nervous.
Every night I have a nightmare in which the weapon explodes in the hands of our squadders...
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
幸好目前还没有出过大事，但我一直很紧张。
我每晚都会做噩梦，梦见武器在队员手里爆炸...

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Although I'm not an expert yet, I would like to solve the problems without worrying the Master or squadders.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
虽然我还算不上专家，但我想自己解决问题，不让师父和队员操心。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hey adventurer. Could you please do me a favor?
Could you show the weapon that I repaired to Blacksmith guild and ask them for some advice?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嘿，冒险者，能帮我一个忙吗？
能把我维修过的武器拿去铁匠公会，请他们给些建议吗？

scripts.text: Say yes.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Oh... I see.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
哦...我知道了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Thank you for your help. I can count on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
谢谢你帮忙，我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
If the weapon repaired by me hurts our people, and not the enemy, it will be a tragedy. I would like to prevent that from happening.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
如果我修好的武器伤到的是自己人，而不是敌人，那就太悲惨了。我想避免这种事发生。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Bring this revolver to Einbroch Blacksmith guild and show it to them. Since I am a member of that guild, they will recognize it when they see the revolver repaired by me. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
请把这把左轮手枪带到艾音布罗克铁匠公会给他们看看。我是公会成员，他们一看就能认出这是我修的枪。拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hmm... Where is my revolver?
This is irresponsible. I will give you another gun. Don't do this again.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯...我的左轮手枪呢？
这也太不负责任了。我再给你一把枪，下次别这样了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Bring my gun to Einbroch Blacksmith guild and show it to them. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
请把我的枪带到艾音布罗克铁匠公会给他们看看。拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Welcome back. What did they say?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
欢迎回来。他们怎么说？

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
So... it's the material. Hmm...
As a matter of fact, I estimated it a little.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
原来如此...是材料的问题。嗯...
说实话，我之前确实稍微削减了用料。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
But I had no other choice. Due to the lack of budget, I could not get better materials.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
但我也别无选择。预算不足，没法买到更好的材料。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Moreover, our Master brilliantly repairs weapons with these materials. But I keep breaking them..
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
而且师父用这些材料也能把武器修得很好，可我却总是把它们弄坏...

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
So I was trying to improve it by myself. But I changed my mind after listening to you.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
所以我本来想自己改进方法。但听了你的话，我改变主意了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
My mistake is not only mine. It can also put every squadder in danger. Everyone's safety is more important than my personal pride.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
这不只是我一个人的过失，还可能让每位队员身陷险境。大家的安全比我的自尊重要得多。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Therefore.. Adventurer, I would like to ask you for a favor. Could you please bring me the materials that I require?
Whenever you think of it... Once a day would be perfect. If you bring them occasionally, it's also good.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
所以...冒险者，我想拜托你一件事。能帮我带些需要的材料来吗？
你想起来时带来就好...每天一次最合适。偶尔带一些来也可以。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
I cannot give you money for that. But I will compensate you with something else. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我没法付钱给你，但会用别的东西答谢。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Grant her favor.
scripts.translation: 答应帮她

scripts.text: Reject her favor.
scripts.translation: 拒绝帮她

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Thank you, adventurer.
Hmm... The most important item is.. Let me see. Today.. I need some Iron.
Five Iron. Could you please bring them to me?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
谢谢你，冒险者。
嗯...最重要的材料是...我看看。今天...我需要一些铁。
请带五块铁给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Yes. I will.
I have no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
好吧，我会帮忙。
我也没有别的选择。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
I think I can sort it out with the Ore that you have brought.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我想用你带来的矿石就能处理好了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
If you can help me again... Could you come back tomorrow? I might need other Ore.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
如果你还愿意帮我...明天能再来一趟吗？我可能还需要别的矿石。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Welcome, adventurer. Thanks to your help last time, I was able to work without difficulty.
Is it okay if I ask you for a favor again?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
欢迎，冒险者。多亏你上次帮忙，我工作起来顺利多了。
我能再请你帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: Of course it's okay.
scripts.translation: 当然可以

scripts.text: I am busy today.
scripts.translation: 我今天很忙

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hmm.. I see. But thank you for your help last time.
Thank you coming again.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯...我知道了。不过还是谢谢你上次帮忙。
也谢谢你今天特地过来。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Apart from the materials...
Can you come here to meet me once in a while?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
除了材料之外...
你也能偶尔来看看我吗？

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
To enhance the gun barrel, I need Oridecon.
Please bring me two Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
强化枪管需要神之金属。
请带两块神之金属给我。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Today I don't have enough Elunium. Could you please bring me two Elunium?
I will count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我今天的铝不够。能请你带两块铝来吗？
就拜托你了，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Iron is the most basic material for every weapon. Without it, I cannot do anything only with other enhancing materials.
So please bring me five Iron
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
铁是所有武器最基本的材料。没有铁，光靠其他强化材料什么也做不了。
所以请带五块铁来。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
If the gun barrel is not hard enough, the inner barrel will be melt after several shots. After all, it will be worn out soon.
To prevent it, we need high quality Oridecon. Please bring two.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
如果枪管不够坚固，连发几枪后内管就会熔化，很快就会磨损。
为了避免这种情况，需要高品质的神之金属。请带两块来。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
The blacksmiths in large cities exchange Elunium Ore with Elunium... Please bring me two Elunium.
If I had a better skill, it would have been enough with Ore. I'm ashamed...
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
大城市的铁匠会把铝矿石加工成铝...请带两块铝给我。
要是我的技术再好些，只用矿石就够了。真惭愧...

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
We always don't have enough Iron. Bring five Iron please.
Thank you so much, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
铁总是不够用。请带五块铁来。
非常感谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
You have brought {0} {1} that I asked you for? Thank you very much!
Are you sure you are giving them to me?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
你把我拜托你带的{0}{1}带来了吗？太感谢了！
你确定要把它们交给我吗？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Sorry. I need it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我还要用

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Yeah. I am just requesting you.
If you have more important thing to do, don't worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯，我只是问问。
你要是有更重要的事要忙，不用顾虑我。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Thank you, adventurer...
Although I cannot give you money, let me give you this.
If possible, I would like to ask you for a favor tomorrow too.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
谢谢你，冒险者...
虽然不能给你钱，还是请收下这个。
如果方便的话，明天也想再请你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Seems like you are looking for someone. What is it?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
看起来你在找人。有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
An advice for repairing weapons? Well, but you are not a Blacksmith, are you?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
想问修理武器的建议？不过，你不是铁匠吧？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Oh, you have come here after being requested by the member of our guild. Let me see it.
