scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
哦，你是受我们公会成员所托来的。让我看看武器。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Come on. I have to look at the weapon to give you an advice.
I am a Blacksmith, not a psychic.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
快拿来。得先看看武器，我才能给你建议。
我可是铁匠，又不是通灵师。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Hmm. This is definitely the skill of our guild member. She has developed the method we taught her.
Her skill is good. Hmm, but...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
嗯，这确实是我们公会成员的手艺。她把我们教的方法融会贯通了。
手艺不错。不过...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
This is... Hmm, I see...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
这个...嗯，我明白了...

scripts.text: Jack is scrutinizing Rachel's revolver.
scripts.translation: 杰克正在仔细检查瑞秋的左轮手枪。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
This is not a matter of her skill. It's the materials.
Since there are so many impurities mixed in the metal, it mush have been hard for her to handle this. But she barely did it.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
这不是她手艺的问题，而是材料的问题。
金属里混进了太多杂质，她处理起来一定很不容易。不过她还是勉强修好了。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Go back and tell her she must use the metal with higher purity.
This is not the problem of someone who handles it. I won't be surprised if it exploded while she was repairing it.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
回去告诉她必须使用纯度更高的金属。
这不是操作手法的问题。她修理时要是把枪弄炸了，我也不会意外。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Go back and tell her. It might be exploded in the meantime...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
快回去告诉她吧。说不定等你回去时，武器已经炸了...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
An experienced Blacksmith can recognize the status of the weapon just by feeling the vibration on the arm when he/she smashes that weapon with a hammer.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
经验丰富的铁匠用锤子敲击武器时，只需感受手臂传来的震动，就能判断武器的状态。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
In addition to that, The real master must check it with eyes and ears as well.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 杰克]
除此之外，真正的大师还必须用眼睛观察、用耳朵聆听。

scripts.text:
[Danae]
This is delicious. No mission yet?
scripts.translation:
[达娜厄]
真好吃。还没有任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Yeah. They told me to stand by.
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
是啊，他们让我待命。

scripts.text:
[Danae]
Oh, I'm waiting for my off-duty day. I will go to Yuno to eat something delicious.
scripts.translation:
[达娜厄]
哦，我在等休假日呢。到时我要去尤诺吃点好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Oh, it was so hard. Wasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
哦，任务很辛苦吧？

scripts.text:
[Fang]
Not that hard. Did I tell you the story when I went to Hermes Fletue?
scripts.translation:
[方]
没那么辛苦。我跟你讲过我去赫尔墨斯·弗勒特的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Yes, you did. More than thousand times.
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
讲过了，超过一千遍了。

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I told you not to drink the tea while you are holding the gun. What if you spill it on it?
scripts.translation:
[方]
我说过，拿着枪时别喝茶。要是洒到枪上怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Yeah, I will finish drinking first.
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
好吧，我先把茶喝完。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Why do you keep wiping it?
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
你怎么一直擦它？

scripts.text:
[Danae]
I always have to take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[达娜厄]
我得经常保养它。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
You're so diligent.
scripts.translation:
[汤米]
你真勤快。

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I'm so tired. I will sleep after drinking a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[方]
我累坏了。喝完这杯茶我就去睡觉。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
You said No.1 priority is reporting and No.2 is the gun, after the mission. Didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
你不是说任务结束后，第一要务是汇报，第二要务是保养枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I will do it after sleeping.
scripts.translation:
[方]
我睡醒了再做。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Oh? You once told me I must die after those No.1 and No.2 jobs!
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
咦？你以前还说，完成第一和第二要务后就可以去死了！

scripts.text:
[Fang]
That's only for newbies. Not for me.
scripts.translation:
[方]
那是对新人的要求，对我可不适用。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Ah, I'm so hungry. Nothing happened during my patrol today.
scripts.translation:
[本]
啊，我饿死了。今天巡逻时什么事都没发生。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
What was for the dinner?
scripts.translation:
[本]
晚饭吃什么？

scripts.text:
[Markman]
I love reading books during my night duty. Where is the episode 3?
scripts.translation:
[马克曼]
我喜欢值夜班时看书。第三集放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Markman]
Rookie! Where is the episode 3? Rookie! Rookie!!
scripts.translation:
[马克曼]
新人！第三集放哪儿了？新人！新人！！

scripts.text:
[Tott]
Night fishing is the best fishing of all. The sound of water, small light and the feeling of being alone at night.
scripts.translation:
[托特]
夜钓是最棒的。听着水声，看着微光，独自在夜里垂钓，感觉真好。

scripts.text:
[Tott]
So I come out here quite often. The water is so dirty here that there is no fish here. I just enjoy the feeling.
scripts.translation:
[托特]
所以我常来这里。这里的水太脏，一条鱼也没有。我只是喜欢这种感觉。

scripts.text:
[Maymay]
Oh, I have to finish this.... zzzz
scripts.translation:
[梅梅]
哦，我得把这个做完...呼...（打鼾）

scripts.text:
[Corona]
This light, so beautiful. It's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[科罗娜]
这光真美，太完美了！

scripts.text:
[Corona]
Look at this. Isn't this light beautiful? It's glanced on the lamp.
scripts.translation:
[科罗娜]
快看，这光是不是很美？灯上还映出了它的光芒。

scripts.text:
[Corona]
Ha.. This is perfect. I will wipe it more so that there will be more brilliant light.
scripts.translation:
[科罗娜]
哈...太完美了。我要再擦擦，让光芒更加耀眼。

scripts.text: Seems like you have too many belongings. Let's try it again after you remove some.
scripts.translation: 你的物品栏里东西太多了。请先清理一些，再来试试。

scripts.text: Your belongings are too heavy. Let's try it again after you reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 你的负重太高了。请先减轻负重，再来试试。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
A customer? I wasn't going to do business today. I'm too tired.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
有客人？我今天本来不打算做生意，累死了。

scripts.text: I heard similar words somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我好像在哪里听过类似的话

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
It's just your imagination. There is no one like me in the world.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
那只是你的错觉。世上没有第二个我这样的人。

scripts.text: ^0000ffBut he still looks familiar.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff不过，他看起来还是很眼熟。^000000

scripts.text: It's a waste of time
scripts.translation: 浪费时间

scripts.text: Tell me what you sell
scripts.translation: 告诉我你卖什么

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Huh, go away.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
哼，走开。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Schwartz Honor Token, an item issued by the nation and whose transaction between individuals is prohibited. I take those items from people and upgrade their gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
施瓦茨荣誉徽章是国家发行的物品，禁止个人之间交易。我会从别人那里收取徽章，帮他们升级装备。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
After betraying a rival in the same field, I got the secret method of upgrading. Since then, I have been working in the shadows like this ... Oh, forget it. This is not a pleasant story.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
我背叛了同行的竞争对手，才得到这套秘密升级方法。从那以后，我就一直在暗中做这种生意...算了，这不是什么愉快的往事。

scripts.text: (He DOES look familiar ...)
scripts.translation: (他确实看起来很眼熟...)

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Anyway, if you have bunch of tokens and do not just throw them away, visit me. We can make a good trade.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
总之，如果你有一堆徽章又不想扔掉，就来找我吧。我们可以做笔好交易。

scripts.text: What kind of trade?
scripts.translation: 什么交易？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I provide a special upgrade for Agenda Robes, Consultation Robes and Mercenary Rings type A and B. In return, I take Schwartz Honor Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
我可以特殊升级议程外袍、商事外袍，以及A型和B型佣兵之戒。作为交换，我收取施瓦茨荣誉徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Well, I don't have to continue nagging like this. Just bring me the tokens when there is gear that you would like to upgrade. Then we can talk about the trade in detail.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
好了，我就不继续啰嗦了。等你有装备想升级时，带徽章来找我，到时再详谈交易内容。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Have you come for the trade? Tell me what you need.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
你是来交易的吗？说说你需要什么。

scripts.text: Tell me the terms of the trade
scripts.translation: 告诉我交易条件

scripts.text: Upgrade my robe
scripts.translation: 升级我的外袍

scripts.text: Upgrade my ring
scripts.translation: 升级我的戒指

scripts.text: Initialize the upgraded capacity level of my robe
scripts.translation: 重置我的外袍升级效果

scripts.text: Initialize the upgraded capacity level of my ring
scripts.translation: 重置我的戒指升级效果

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen. I won't say it twice.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
听好了，我只说一遍。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I take 20 Schwartz Honor Token to upgrade the slot of an Agenda Robe or Consultation Robe. The maximum slots for the upgrade are two. And I will take 10 Schwartz Honor Token for initialization. Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
升级议程外袍或商事外袍的一个插槽，需要20枚施瓦茨荣誉徽章。最多可升级两个插槽。重置需要10枚徽章。听明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Then it's Mercenary Ring type A and B. I take five tokens for upgrading a slot. The maximum slots for the upgrade are two. And I will take 10 tokens for initialization.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
至于A型和B型佣兵之戒，每升级一个插槽需要5枚徽章，最多可升级两个插槽。重置则需要10枚徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
The initialization cannot be conducted at any time. I will only do it after you are granted two effects and cannot upgrade the gear any more. And ... then ...
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
不能随时重置。只有在装备已经获得两项效果、无法继续升级时，我才会帮你重置。而且...到时候...

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
There is a slight problem. Mercenary Ring type A and B might be destroyed during the initialization. The probability is about 20 percent. Since they are small items, there are serious side effects when eliminating the upgraded effect.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
有个小问题：重置A型或B型佣兵之戒时，戒指可能会损坏，概率大约是20%。戒指是小型物品，移除升级效果时会产生严重的副作用。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I look forward to having a good business relationship with you, fellow.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
期待和你合作愉快，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
For the Consultation Robe and Agenda Robe, you need 20 Schwartz Honor Tokens for each slot. Are you sure you want to upgrade it?
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
升级商事外袍或议程外袍的每个插槽都需要20枚施瓦茨荣誉徽章。你确定要升级吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不要

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 开始升级

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
我很忙，以后没事别来打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You are taking off your gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
你正在脱下装备。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hey, grow up. If you want to upgrade your gear, you must put it on properly first.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
认真点。想升级装备，就先把它穿戴好。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
No more upgrade is possible on this gear. Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
这件装备已经不能再升级了。还有别的东西要升级吗？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
听着，伙计。你没有{0}就不能和我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
嗯，处理好了。检查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You need five Schwartz Honor Tokens to upgrade a slot of Mercenary Ring type A and B equipped on your left slot. Are you sure you want to upgrade it?
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
升级佩戴在左侧饰品栏的A型或B型佣兵之戒的一个插槽，需要5枚施瓦茨荣誉徽章。要升级吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 开始升级

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
我很忙，以后没事别来打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I forgot to tell you something. I only upgrade accessories equipped on the left slot. Equip it on your left slot first and then let me upgrade it.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
我忘了告诉你，我只升级佩戴在左侧饰品栏的饰品。请先把它装备在左侧，再来找我升级。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hey, grow up. If you want to upgrade your Mercenary Ring, you must put it on properly first.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
认真点。想升级佣兵之戒，就先把它戴好。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
No more upgrade is possible on this gear. Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
这件装备已经不能再升级了。还有别的东西要升级吗？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
听着，伙计。你没有{0}就不能和我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
嗯，处理好了。检查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
To initialize the Consultation Robe or Agenda Robe, you need 10 Schwartz Honor Tokens. The gear itself will not be destroyed. The card you already inserted and its smelting level will be safe as well.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
重置商事外袍或议程外袍需要10枚施瓦茨荣誉徽章。装备本身不会损坏，已经插入的卡片和精炼等级也会保留。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 开始重置

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
我很忙，以后没事别来打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You are taking off your gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
你正在脱下装备。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
哎呀，这件装备还没有完全升级，现在无法重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
哎呀，这件装备还没有完全升级，现在无法重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
听着，伙计。你没有{0}就不能和我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
嗯，处理好了。检查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You need 10 Schwartz Honor Tokens to upgrade Mercenary Ring type A and B equipped on your left slot.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
升级佩戴在左侧饰品栏的A型或B型佣兵之戒，需要10枚施瓦茨荣誉徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
As I explained before, the initialization of rings is quite hard. ^ff0000The success rate is 80 percent.^000000 If it fails, the item is gone. Are you sure you want to do this?
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
正如我之前说的，重置戒指有风险。^ff0000成功率为80%。^000000失败的话，戒指就会消失。你确定要重置吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 开始重置

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
我很忙，以后没事别来打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I am telling you in advance. Every time you initialize the ring, there is a 20 percent probability of destruction. Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
先提醒你：每次重置戒指都有20%的概率损毁。确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Yes. Good idea.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
好主意。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I forgot to tell you something. I only initialize accessories equipped on the left slot. Equip it on your left slot first and then let me initialize it.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
我忘了告诉你，我只重置佩戴在左侧饰品栏的饰品。请先把它装备在左侧，再来找我重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
哎呀，这件装备还没有完全升级，现在无法重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
哎呀，这件装备还没有完全升级，现在无法重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
听着，伙计。你没有{0}就不能和我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Oh, you are unlucky today. Your gear has been badly damaged.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
哎呀，你今天运气不好，装备严重损坏了。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加尔]
嗯，处理好了。检查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Butterfly Merchant]
... ... ... ... ...
Do you need {0}?

[Imperial Operator]
Hello.
We have ^4d4dffImperial^000000 equipment that can be exchanged for {0}.
I will guide you to exchange items according to your job.
scripts.translation:
[帝国操作员]
你好。
我们这里有可以用{0}兑换的^4d4dff帝国^000000装备。
我会根据你的职业为你介绍兑换物品。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You have too much in your inventory.
Please make it lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的背包里东西太多了。
请先清理一些，再来试试。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You have too much in your inventory.
Please make it lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的背包太重了。
减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Hello. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你好，有什么需要我帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Hmm... You don't have any Schwartz Honor Tokens.
Please come back after taking care of other tasks.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
嗯...你没有施瓦茨荣誉徽章。
请先处理其他事情，之后再来。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Oh, you brought the Schwartz Honor Tokens.
I always thank you for your help.
We have to show you our gratitude in return.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
哦，你带来了施瓦茨荣誉徽章。
一直以来承蒙你帮忙，非常感谢。
我们也应该好好答谢你。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
For our cooperators who brought certain amount of tokens, we will grant gifts. Please choose items you require.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
凡是带来一定数量徽章的协力者，我们都会赠送礼物。请选择你需要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Which one would you like to select?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你想选哪一件？

scripts.text: Agenda Robe
scripts.translation: 议程外袍

scripts.text: Consultation Robe
scripts.translation: 商事外袍

scripts.text: Costume Combat Vestige
scripts.translation: （时装）战斗遗痕

scripts.text: Hat of Republic
scripts.translation: 共和国之帽

scripts.text: Mercenary Ring A type
scripts.translation: 佣兵之戒A型

scripts.text: Mercenary Ring B type
scripts.translation: 佣兵之戒B型

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
{0}? I got it.
You need {1} Schwartz Honor Tokens.
Are you sure you want this?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
{0}？知道了。
需要{1}枚施瓦茨荣誉徽章。
确定要兑换吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Please come back after you decided.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
决定好之后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You don't have enough tokens...
Please collect some more.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的徽章不够...
请再收集一些。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Here is your {0}.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
这是你的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Rotten]
Ah, I hate cleaning. Why don't they develop a machine that does the cleaning automatically?
scripts.translation:
[烂人]
唉，我讨厌打扫。为什么不发明一台能自动打扫的机器呢？

scripts.text:
[Master]
You have too many items in your inventory. Why don't you come back after making it lighter? It looks too heavy.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你的背包里东西太多了。先清理一些，减轻负重再回来。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Authorized Personnel Only. Stay away.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
闲人免进。离远点。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Adventurer, please take a good rest today. You must take of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
冒险者，今天好好休息。照顾好自己。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I will see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
明天见。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome back, adventurer. Did you have a good rest mentally and physically?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
欢迎回来，冒险者。身心都休息好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Last night, many weapons were not returned. I really have to teach these guys some lesson...
scripts.translation:
[师父]
昨晚有很多武器没还回来。我真得好好教训这些家伙...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Anyway, I will count on you. ^0000cdGo down from Einbech and find Suspicious Heap of Earth^000000 and investigate it. Then ^0000cdbring about three broken guns^000000 please.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
总之，拜托你了。^0000cd从艾音贝赫往下走，找到可疑的土堆^000000并调查。然后请^0000cd带回大约三把破损的枪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Ha........... There are so many guys who did not return their weapons.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
唉...这么多人没还武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome, adventurer. You came back earlier than we expected. Didn't the Grudges attack you?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
欢迎回来，冒险者。你比预想中回来得早。没被怨恨袭击吗？

scripts.text:
[Master]
So you've brought what I told you? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你把我要的东西带来了吗？我看看...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm.. Not enough. I asked you to bring ^0000cdthree Broken Gun^000000.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
嗯...数量不够。我让你带^0000cd三把破损的枪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Master]
^0000cdGo down from Einbech^000000 and investigate ^0000cdSuspicious Heap of earth^000000 in several places. Then you can find them.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
^0000cd从艾音贝赫往下走^000000，调查几处^0000cd可疑的土堆^000000，就能找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since there are Grudges, I know it's not easy. But we will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
那里有怨恨，我知道这趟不容易。不过就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You've brought enough broken guns. But we cannot use them.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
破损的枪数量够了，但这些不能用。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I guess you have to search at least five Heap of Earth and defeat about five Grudge.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
看来你至少得搜查五个土堆，再打倒大约五个怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I know you worked hard for us to bring them. Sorry to ask you once again.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
我知道你费了很大劲才把它们带回来。抱歉还得再麻烦你一次。

scripts.text:
[Master]
My god... It's amazing. You've reclaimed all these weapons in that short time. They've been hiding so many weapons everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
天哪...真了不起！这么快就找回了所有武器。他们竟然把武器藏得到处都是。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Adventurer, you must be tired today. Take a rest and come back after the ^0000cddawn^000000 tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
冒险者，你今天一定累坏了。好好休息，明天^0000cd天亮^000000后再来。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello? can I take a look around?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好？我可以四处看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh, you are the famous adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
哦，你就是那位有名的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What am I famous for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有什么名气？

scripts.text:
[Master]
They say we had an outsider after a long time. And the outsider persuaded us to cooperate with the government.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
听说很久没外人来过了。那位外人还说服我们和政府合作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I haven't done so much.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没做什么大事。

scripts.text:
[Master]
But that's what I heard.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
可我听到的就是这样。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, what is this place? Since there are so many guns, I guess this is an armory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对了，这是什么地方？这里有这么多枪，应该是军火库吧？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Sort of. We lend weapons for Rebellions here.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
差不多吧。我们在这里把武器借给叛乱军。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They have their own weapons. And you lend them more?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们自己有武器，你们还要借给他们更多？

scripts.text:
[Master]
You are right. But according to the task and circumstance, sometimes we need additional weapons
scripts.translation:
[师父]
没错。不过根据任务和情况，有时确实需要额外的武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And for newbies, we don't know which gun is suitable for each of them. So they have to try many different guns.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
新人不清楚哪种枪适合自己，所以得多试几种。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So they can borrow them here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以他们可以在这里借枪。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Yes. They must write down the period, names and the purpose on the ledger. When returning them, they only have to sign.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
是的。他们必须在登记簿上写明借用期限、姓名和用途。归还时签个名就行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's inconvenient. I thought you would just lend them without any procedure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真麻烦。我还以为直接借给他们就行，不用这么多手续。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Originally, they used to borrow and returned guns without having to write anything. But almost nobody returned them. We have limited resources so we cannot just keep producing and purchasing our weapons.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
以前借还枪都不用登记，可几乎没人归还。资源有限，我们不能一直生产和购买新武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
That's how we developed a system like this. It's due to the guys living here.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
这里的人害我们不得不建立这套制度。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the ledger...

[Master]
Don't scrutinize it. Just in case you forgot, you are an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
别仔细看。别忘了，你是外人。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Please keep in mind that we have been the most mysterious and exclusive organization in Schwaltzvalt lately.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
记住，施瓦尔茨瓦尔德最近一直是最神秘、最排外的组织。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's amazing. What are these red lines?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真厉害。这些红线是什么？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Those who did not return weapons.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
这些是没归还武器的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So many of them.. Even if you manage it thoroughly?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这么多人...管理得再仔细也会这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since these are not their private firearms, they handle them carelessly. They don't realize that they have to handle things with care.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
这些不是他们自己的枪，所以他们用起来很不爱惜，根本不懂得小心使用。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Once they are broken, they must bring them here to repair. But they just throw them away. They don't bring them back here even though we give them penalty, claiming that they lost them.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
枪坏了本该拿来修，可他们直接扔掉。就算我们罚他们，他们也谎称弄丢了，不肯拿回来。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh! Great! Adventurer, if you have time, could you help us?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
哦！太好了！冒险者，你有空帮帮我们吗？

scripts.text: I always like working.
scripts.translation: 我就喜欢干活

scripts.text: Sorry. I can't
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我没空

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All of a sudden? Maybe not now...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这么突然？我现在可能没空...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Well, it's not urgent. Please find them when you have time.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
不急，有空的时候帮忙找找就行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I will.

[{0}]
All of a sudden? Well, I always like working.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这么突然？不过我就喜欢干活。

scripts.text:
[Master]
It's good attitude. Please take a look the guys with red lines. And reclaim those weapons that they threw away.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
态度不错。看看那些画了红线的人，把他们扔掉的武器找回来。

scripts.text:
[Master]
While they are on mission, most of them reclaim their weapons once they are broken. By the time they arrive at Einbech, they think of me who scolds them and just throw the weapons away.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
他们出任务时，武器一坏通常就会找回来。可他们到了艾音贝赫，一想到我会训人，就把枪扔了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Sometimes I reclaim them when I have time. Sometimes I send newbies to bring the. But as you see, we have been quite busy lately.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
我有空时会去找，有时也派新人去拿。不过你也看到了，最近大家都很忙。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And once you touch the wreckage...
scripts.translation:
[师父]
而且一碰那些残骸...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happens?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
会发生什么？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh... Grudges of guns come out and attack you. You have to see them yourself. Seeing is believing.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
哦...枪的怨恨会跑出来攻击你。你得亲眼看看才知道。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Go around ^0000cdseveral places in the field below Einbech ^000000 and reclaim ^0000cdBroken Guns^000000 inside Suspicious Heap of Earth.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
去艾音贝赫下方的野外^0000cd几个地点^000000转转，从可疑土堆里找回^0000cd破损的枪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Let me see from the newest one... Bring ^0000cdabout three of them^000000 please. If you bring too many of them, it will be hard to repair.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
让我看看最新的那批...请带^0000cd大约三把^000000回来。带太多的话，修理起来会很麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome back. Have you brought what I ask you for?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
欢迎回来。把我要的东西带来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm.. Not enough. I asked you to bring three Broken Gun.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
嗯...数量不够。我让你带三把破损的枪。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Go down from Einbech and investigate Suspicious Heap of Earth in several places. Then you can find them.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
从艾音贝赫往下走，调查几处可疑的土堆，就能找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since there are Grudges, I know it's not easy. But we will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
那里有怨灵，我知道这趟不容易。不过就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You've brought enough broken guns. But we cannot use them.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你带回来的破枪数量够了，但这些不能用。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I guess you have to search at least five Heap of Earth and defeat about five Grudge.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
看来你至少得搜查五个土堆，再打倒大约五个怨灵。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I know you worked hard for us to bring them. Sorry to ask you once again.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
我知道你费了很大劲才把它们带回来。抱歉还得再麻烦你一次。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You have brought enough amount. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
数量够了。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Master]
By the way, he should be here now.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
对了，他现在应该到了。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
达里尔，你来了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And your weapon?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你的武器呢？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I don't have it.
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
我没带。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Why not?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I lost it.
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
我弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Heck, good job.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
哼，干得真好啊。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Well, not such a good job.
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
呃，这可不是什么好事。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You did a great job. So you'll lose your weapon again, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你干得真不错啊。然后又把武器弄丢了，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No.
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
没有。

scripts.text:
[Master]
What did I tell you? You can lost yourself, but never lose your weapon!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
我跟你说过什么？你可以把自己弄丢，但绝不能把武器弄丢！

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
对不起。

scripts.text:
[Master]
It doesn't look like an attitude of someone who's sorry. You lost something you borrowed. Now give me yours.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你这副样子可不像在道歉。你把借来的东西弄丢了，现在把自己的武器交出来。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No! Never! Don't touch me! Yikes!
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
不！绝不！别碰我！哇！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Can I leave now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个...我现在可以走了吗？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No, you can't! I don't know who you are. But please save me!
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
不行！我不知道你是谁，但求你救救我！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Right! We have to compensate you. First, let's see who threw this away.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
没错，我们得补偿你。先看看是谁把这东西丢掉的。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Let's see... Who threw this away..? The serial numbers are...
scripts.translation:
[师父]
我看看...是谁把它丢掉的...序列号是...

scripts.text:
[Master]
... Daryl?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
...达里尔？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Yeah, huh?
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
嗯？怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Master]
The weapon you borrowed last time.. You said you lost it, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你上次借走的那把武器...不是说弄丢了吗？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
My god. Why is it there...
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
天哪，它怎么会在那里...

scripts.text:
[Master]
You begged me for the weapon!! Just because it's not yours, you broke it like this and threw it away? Why didn't you do this to your own weapon?
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你当时可是苦苦求我借给你的！！就因为不是自己的，你就把它弄坏后扔掉了？怎么不拿自己的武器这么干？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
My Lady!! I have to treasure it!!!
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
我的女士！！我得好好珍惜它！！！

scripts.text:
[Master]
This is not the first time and I have the smoking gun here. You have nothing to say now!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
这已经不是第一次了，而且证据就在眼前。这下你没话说了吧！

scripts.text:
[Master]
We will keep your Lady for a while. You reflect on yourself in the training room for some time!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
我们先把你的女士扣在这里。你去训练室好好反省一阵子！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Trainees!!!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
学员们！！！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Come and drag him out!
scripts.translation:
[师父]
过来把他拖出去！

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
What???
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
什么？？？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No! Not the target please! I don't want to die yet!!! I'm sorry! It's my fault! I'll never do it again!
scripts.translation:
[达里尔]
不！不要把我当靶子！我还不想死啊！！！对不起！都是我的错！我再也不敢了！

scripts.text:
[Master]
You must be so tired by now. Take some rest. Can we count on you tomorrow? If you are interested, come back to us after the dawn.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
你一定累坏了，先休息吧。明天还能拜托你吗？有兴趣的话，天亮后再回来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You've reclaimed enough of them. Let's go back to the Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你已经找回足够多的东西了。我们回去找师父吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you carry so many stuffs? Unless you want to give them away, make your bag lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你怎么带了这么多东西？除非是要送人的，不然先清理一下背包再回来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you carry so many stuffs? Unless you want to give them away, make your bag lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你怎么带了这么多东西？除非是要送人的，不然先清理一下背包再回来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you value your life, don't stimulate the people here. Many of them are short-tempered.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
想活命就别惹这里的人，他们很多脾气都不好。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As you promised me, just drink a cup of tea and go back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
答应过我的话，就喝杯茶然后回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you meet all of them? They must be on the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
都见过了吗？他们应该在二楼。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can you see the doors on the 2nd floor? Just visit four of them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
看到二楼那些门了吗？随便拜访四间就行。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As long as you behave yourself... nothing bad will happen. Maybe...?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
只要你规规矩矩的...就不会出什么事。大概吧...？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you meet everyone on the 2nd floor? Great job. It must have been frightening.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
二楼的人都见过了吗？干得好。一定吓坏了吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although they are quite frightening... they are all good people.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他们看起来确实挺吓人...不过都是好人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Don't you have to report to Lazy now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你现在该去向懒散汇报了吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rookie, how have you been?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
新人，最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, how was your business? Lazy told me that I could fully trust you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者，事情办得怎么样？懒散说他完全信任你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
All of us are also eager and preparing many things. We should not disappoint that person~
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们大家也都很期待，正在准备很多东西。可不能让那个人失望啊~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will do my best. Rookie, what have you been doing recently? How was your talk with Lazy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会尽力的。新人，你最近在忙什么？和懒散聊得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'm still here. This fellow cannot leave immediately. Neither can I.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我还在这里呢。这家伙不能马上离开，我也走不了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What I've been doing recently?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我最近在忙什么？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer? I told you to take a good rest. Didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者？我不是叫你好好休息吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
At this time of the day, everyone is taking a rest. Please go back and rest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
现在大家都在休息。请回去休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I'm afraid you will collapse from overwork. The health is the most important. Please take some rest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我担心你会累垮。身体健康最重要，请好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你其实不用特地跑这一趟的...我是说，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你说我必须来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼又登场啦！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, speak of the devil.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
说曹操，曹操到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Yikes! It's cold!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哎呀！好冰！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
My job is to prevent such a fool from doing silly things.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我的工作就是防止这种笨蛋做傻事。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, come on! Who keeps putting the bucket here? Every time I take it away, somebody puts it here again! Who is it? Is it a pervert who enjoys watching other people's feet getting wet?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
喂！你怎么能这样对我？是谁老把水桶放在这儿？我每次拿走，就又有人放回来！到底是谁？难道是个喜欢看别人脚被淋湿的变态？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's me.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是我。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Hey! How can you do this to me?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
喂！你怎么能这样对我？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As long as you ^0000cdwalk on the pipe^000000 instead of the stairs, it's your fault. The pipe is innocent. How can you do that to the pipe!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
谁叫你^0000cd不走楼梯，偏要踩着管道走^000000。水管是无辜的，你怎么能这样对它！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Look. There are four walls and four corners. So there must be four stairs. There are only two stairs and it's so inconvenient on the sides where there are no stairs!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
你看，这里四面墙、四个角，理应有四段楼梯。结果只有两段，没有楼梯的那两边走起来太不方便了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do not complain it to me. Talk to the one who designed this place.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
别跟我抱怨，去找设计这里的人说。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Where is that person!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那个人在哪里！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He's dead. Not here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
死了，不在这里。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
...... You are doing this to me on purpose, aren't you? Why do you hate mu so much?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
...你是故意整我的吧？你为什么这么讨厌我？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you think I put this bucket here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你觉得我为什么把水桶放在这儿？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Because you like to see my feet get wet.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
因为你喜欢看我的脚被淋湿。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey!!! Are you saying I'm a pervert? You keep walking on the pipe every day with that huge boday. As a result, this skinny pipe is damaged! There! And there! Can you see the water leakage?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！！！你说我是变态？你每天都踩着那根管道走，光是你那庞大的身躯就快把细管压坏了！看这里，还有那里！看到漏水了吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦，好像真是这样。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I put the bucket there to receive the leaking water! Once the pipe is entirely broken, there will be a flood in this place! Don't you have the brain to think of it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我放水桶是为了接漏出来的水！管道要是彻底破了，这里就会淹水！你就没想过这一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well, I didn't think about it. Why don't you repair the pipe?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯，我没想到。那你为什么不修好管道？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's why I've been waiting here!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以我才一直在这里等啊！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh~ I see. Then I'll count on you! Make it solid! If you have enough time, please make something I can hold on.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦~我懂了。那就拜托你了！把它修结实点！有空的话，再做个让我能抓住的东西。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No. I will just supervise it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，我只负责监督。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then who's going to repair it? There's nobody here.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那谁来修？这里又没有别人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you sure there's nobody here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你确定这里没人吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, I can't make our guest work.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不行，不能让客人干活。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do you know who it is?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你知道该谁去吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh... me?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦...我吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Exactly! As a reward, I will give you an opportunity to bring the parts to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
没错！作为奖励，我给你一个机会，让你去拿修管道的零件。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well, I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
可是我很忙...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I know you are off-duty today.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我知道你今天休假。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so hungry and have to eat... I should take care of my kitty... And...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我饿了，得去吃饭...还得照顾我的小猫...还有...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You are the one who damaged it. So you must repair it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
管道是你弄坏的，所以必须由你修。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please, please! To repair this, we need some metal things. To get them, I have to enter the mine!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
拜托了！修管道需要一些金属零件。要拿到它们，我就得进矿坑！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's correct! Go get them now.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
说得对！现在就去拿。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm afraid of the mine. Please don't send me to the mine. Please... Brother, please...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我怕矿坑，别让我去那里。拜托...大哥，求你了...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, you are right. Then what shall we do...? We need to repair it as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，你说得也有道理。那我们怎么办...？必须尽快修好才行。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
What if someone else brings the parts and I repair it?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
要不让别人把零件带来，我来修？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please do this for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者，求你帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! How can you say that to the guest!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！你怎么能让客人做这种事！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Hey, why! Adventurers normally carry about 30,000 metal things in their pockets! That's what I found from most adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
为什么不行！冒险者通常随身带着三万个金属零件！我观察过很多冒险者，都是这样！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Is that... true?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真...真的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I never bring that many.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
才没有，我从来不带那么多。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey, look at that!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂，你听见了吗！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But you can get them so easily! Since we have only handled stuffs like guns, it's hard for us to get them. I've seen many adventures who get those items quite easily.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
可冒险者要弄到这些东西很容易啊！我们只接触枪械之类的东西，很难弄到零件。我见过好多冒险者轻轻松松就拿到了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Is that... true?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真...真的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it isn't...

[Denny]
Everyone says no to this question. But they still get them like a piece of cake! I saw them!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
大家都这么回答，可他们拿起来还是轻轻松松的！我亲眼看见了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, I don't know whether it is true or not. But would you mind bringing them for us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者，我也不知道他说的是真是假。不过，你愿意帮我们带一些回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This pipe will be destroyed completely. Then there will be flood here. Since this place is a hideout, it will be revealed once it is flooded. Then... We will...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这根管道很快就会彻底破裂，到时这里会淹水。这里既然是据点，一旦被水淹就会暴露。然后...我们就...

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so sad.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我好难过。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We really have to repair it urgently. But this guy cannot go to the mine due to a certain reason. Also, I cannot go to the mine for other job. We will certainly compensate for your support.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们确实急着修好管道。但这家伙因为某些原因不敢去矿坑，而我还有别的任务，走不开。我们一定会答谢你。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Compensate? You never told me about it! Let me do it!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
答谢？你怎么从来没跟我说过！那让我去吧！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So you're going to the mine?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以你愿意去矿坑了？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
No...

[{0}]
Now that you mention it... I will go. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你这么说...我去。需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We need ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们需要^0000cd5块钢铁和15块旧钢板^000000。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
And please ^0000cddefeat Scrap Heaters^000000. About 10 of them! This is my personal request!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
还请^0000cd打倒废铁暖炉^000000。大约10只！这是我个人拜托你的！

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It will be difficult for me. I'm sorry that you have to find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可能办不到，抱歉，你们得另找别人。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, why!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
为什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so sad!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我好难过！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, he's so rude. We have no choice. I will look for someone else to do it. You don't have to worry about this.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，他真没礼貌。没办法，我再找别人帮忙。你不用担心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Look! What did I say? Every adventurer is strong!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看吧！我说什么来着？冒险者都很强！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey, would you reject it in front of someone? Adventurer? You don't have to do this.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂，怎么能当着人家的面拒绝呢？冒险者，你不用勉强。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Welcome. See you soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
欢迎。回头见。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Yes! We will be waiting!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
好！我们等你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
小心！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Great job, adventurer. I must have been hard for you to take that job all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
干得好，冒险者。突然接下这份委托，肯定很辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼又登场啦！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer! Have you brought them all? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者！东西都带齐了吗？让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well... As I told you, please bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000. We need them to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯...就像我说的，请带^0000cd5块钢铁和15块旧钢板^000000。我们要用它们修水管。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, you know how to take shortcuts. I like it.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者，你挺会走捷径嘛。我喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I really need them. So please bring them to me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
不过我真的需要它们。能带给我吗？拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼要回家啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of superstar is that? After all, we are counting on you. He is more persistent than he looks. So I am saying this for you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这算哪门子超级巨星？总之就拜托你了。他看着不怎么样，其实很固执。我这是为你好。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
You have brought the Steel and Old Steel Plates...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
钢铁和旧钢板都带来了...

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Apparently, you did not defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I cannot smell the iron.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看来你还没打倒^0000cd10只废铁暖炉^000000。我还闻不到铁味。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Although it is my private request, I wish you could do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
虽然这是我个人的请求，但还是希望你能帮我。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼要回家啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of superstar is that? After all, we are counting on you. He is more persistent than he looks. So I am saying this for you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这算哪门子超级巨星？总之就拜托你了。他看着不怎么样，其实很固执。我这是为你好。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Wow~~~ Great! You never disappoint me!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哇~~~太棒了！你果然没让我失望！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Let me spread your legendary story around the entire continent! Everyone needs to know that!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我要把你的传奇故事传遍整个大陆！让所有人都知道！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then I will go and prepare for repairing! I will count on you again!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那我去准备修理了！下次还拜托你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He went back only after saying what he wants. How spoiled! But I didn't educate him like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这家伙只顾着说自己的事，说完就回去了。真被宠坏了！不过我可没这么惯着他。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow. You must be exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
今天好好休息吧。明天还得拜托你，你一定累坏了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
虽然你其实不用特地过来，但还是谢谢你跑这一趟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你说我必须来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Yikes, it's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have to listen to complaints of all the people. That's a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我得听所有人的抱怨，真伤脑筋。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What's so cold? It's the same as yesterday
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冷什么？跟昨天一样啊。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey, my feeling is so accurate. It's colder today. Look. You put on more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
我的感觉很准，今天更冷了。你看，你穿得更厚了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh! When did I get dressed like this!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
咦！我什么时候穿成这样的！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Let's see... I thought so. The fireplace is weaker now. No firewood?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
让我看看...果然，壁炉火力变弱了。没柴火了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Once this last firewood is burnt out, I will die... Last... firewood...
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
最后一根柴火烧完，我就要死了...最后一根柴火...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who told you that you'd die? You're so healthy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
谁说你会死？你明明很健康！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Come on, Just echo my words while I'm sentimental!!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
拜托，我正多愁善感呢，你就顺着我的话说嘛！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, don't die. If you die, who's going to take care of those 12 kids. Please don't die.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
别死啊！你死了，谁照顾那12个孩子？千万别死。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! Who are my kids! And why do I have to feed them? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
喂！那些孩子是谁的？我为什么要养他们？怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Your spouse... died during a mission.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你的配偶...在任务中去世了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My god! So who's my spouse?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
天哪！那我的配偶是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... The Teddy bear?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...泰迪熊？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! No! Let's say this adventurer is my spouse.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀，不是！就说这位冒险者是我的伴侣吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! That's rude!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！这也太失礼了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Adventurer~ Aren't isn't it cold now?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
冒险者~你不觉得现在很冷吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. Not really...

[Cyan]
Oh, this jacket looks good. That's why you don't feel cold. We always receive cheap clothes so we can easily fell the cold.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，你这件外套真不错，难怪不觉得冷。我们总是领到便宜衣服，很容易感到寒冷。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy now. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者现在很忙。你在说什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Listen to me and look around here. This place is a cold building made of iron and stone.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
听我说，再看看周围。这里是座用铁和石头建成的冰冷建筑。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And since we are in a place located nearly underground, it's always cold and damp. You know the feeling? The cold and damp air kills us.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
而且这里靠近地下，总是又冷又潮湿。你知道那种感觉吗？这种湿冷的空气简直能要人命。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
That's why we always make a fire in the fireplace to warm the air, boil the tea and bake some sweet potatoes...
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
所以我们总在壁炉里生火，暖屋子、烧水泡茶，还烤红薯...

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
In any case, that fireplace is a blessing that grants us so many things. But the fire is about to go out due to the lack of firewood.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
总之，壁炉给我们带来许多便利。可柴火不够，火快熄了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Since it's too cold, I can't go out. So would you please bring me some firewood, my dear?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
外面太冷了，我出不去。亲爱的，能帮我带些柴火吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! You're being rude to the adventurer! Just distinguish the reality and fantasy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！别对冒险者这么无礼！分清现实和幻想！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Well, I distinguish them too well. Rather than living in this cold stony room, I would like to jump into the river!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
我分得可清楚了。与其住在这冰冷的石屋里，我还不如跳进河里！

scripts.text: Do you need the fuel?
scripts.translation: 你需要燃料吗？

scripts.text: I have to leave now.
scripts.translation: 我现在得走了

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can I leave now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在可以走了吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, are you leaving me? I'm suffering from the cold weather!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
亲爱的，你要丢下我吗？我都快被冻坏了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, don't worry about Cyon. I will take care of this fellow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者，别担心赛安。我会照看好她。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, come back if you miss me!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
亲爱的，想我了就回来哦！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I will.

[{0}]
I see! I got it! So you won't commit a suicide if I bring the fuel?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了！所以只要我带来燃料，你就不会寻死了，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh dear, you are so kind and lovely.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀，你真是又善良又可爱。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You've dont it again. I've gotta hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又来这套了。真拿你没办法。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
I need some Burnt Trees, about 10 of them. Since they are well-dried, they will be burnt well. And there's better coal to keep the fire long. Bring some coal please, three of them.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
我需要大约10根焦木。它们晒得很干，烧起来正合适。还要些煤，让火烧得更久。请带3块煤来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Coal? Why? It leaves too much ash.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
煤？为什么？那会留下很多灰。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
To me, the efficiency is the most important! The warmest is the best!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
对我来说，效率最重要！越暖和越好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Please stop fighting. I will bring them. 10 Burnt Tree and three coal. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
知道了，别吵了。我会带来的：10根焦木和3块煤，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! And defeat 10 Waste Stoves!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀！还要打倒10只废铁暖炉！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You need to defeat them to get coal!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
因为要打倒它们才能拿到煤！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on. The adventurer knows it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜托，冒险者早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Be careful, my dear~
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
小心哦，亲爱的~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew... We will count on you anyway. Regardless of what that fellow told you, everyone will get a cold once the fire goes out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉...总之就拜托你了。不管她怎么说，火一灭，大家都会着凉。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, seems like you gave so much effort!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者，看来你费了不少劲！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Welcome back, dear!!! Have you got them all for me? Right?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
亲爱的，欢迎回来！！！东西都带齐了吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's not there. And it's not enough... Perhaps you forgot what we told you to bring?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，还没齐...数量也不够...你是不是忘了我们让你带什么？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
10 Burnt Tree and three coal. I feel so cold. See you, dear.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
10根焦木和3块煤。我好冷啊。再见，亲爱的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And don't forget to defeat about 10 Waste Stoves! I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
还有，别忘了打倒大约10只废铁暖炉！我要回床上睡觉了，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's so spoiled. Adventurer, We will count on you again. If you don't bring them, Cyan will pester you all day long.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是被宠坏了。冒险者，还得再拜托你一次。不把东西带回来，赛安会缠着你一整天。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, you have the firewood... What about Waste Stoves? You didn't defeat them?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，你带来柴火了...那废铁暖炉呢？没打倒它们吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You must get them, dear. Waste Stoves release the fine firewood only after they are shaken about 1,000 times.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
乖，得去打倒它们。废铁暖炉被摇上大约一千次后，才会掉落上好的柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
打倒^0000cd10只废铁暖炉^000000。我要回床上睡觉了，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's so spoiled. Adventurer, We will count on you again. If you don't bring them, Cyan will pester you all day long.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是被宠坏了。冒险者，还得再拜托你一次。不把东西带回来，赛安会缠着你一整天。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Wow! You've brought all of them! My dear, you are so reliable!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哇~~~都带齐了！亲爱的，你真可靠！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Okay. Put the wood and coal in... Fire!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
好，把木头和煤放进去...点火！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's warm now. As warm as your love~
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，暖和起来了。就像你的爱一样温暖~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Could you please stop saying 'dear'? You are repeating my joke too much.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
能不能别总叫“亲爱的”？你把我的玩笑重复太多次了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! You started!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
嘿，是你先开始的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It was a joke. Joke! Joke! Joke!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我那是在开玩笑。玩笑！玩笑！玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Anyway, I like the adventurer! I won't let the adventurer go! Never!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
不管怎样，我喜欢这位冒险者！我不会让你走的！绝不！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
So my dear, will you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
亲爱的，明天还会回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Not again!!!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
又来了！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
These are only enough for today. Of course we must make a fire every single day!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
这些燃料只够今天用。当然，我们每天都得生火！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Stop fighting. I will come back tomorrow if I remember.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我知道了。别吵了。如果我记得的话，明天会再来的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, you are so kind! But I may not be here tomorrow for a mission. Please don't be disappointed!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
亲爱的，你真好！不过我明天可能要出任务，不一定在这里。别失望哦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't think the adventurer will ever be disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我想冒险者才不会失望。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Now I will go in and sleep. See you!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
那我进去睡觉了。再见！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, I am exhausted as well. Please take a good rest now and come back after the ^0000cddawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，我也累坏了。好好休息，明天^0000cd天亮^000000之后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。虽然你其实不用特地过来，但还是谢谢你跑这一趟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你叫我必须来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Twinkle twinkle little star~ My shooting star, you are still beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
一闪一闪亮晶晶~我的流星，你依然如此美丽。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's to make those kids quiet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这是为了让那些孩子安静下来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you fumbling it again! It might run down!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又在乱摸了吗！小心把它弄坏！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
It was you who told me to possess it all the time!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
是你叫我一直带着它的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I didn't mean to wash it every hour! You're so stubborn!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我可没叫你每小时都洗一次！你真固执！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
By the way, that's not important. I think there is something terribly wrong with my shooting star.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
对了，那不重要。我觉得我的流星出了大问题。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What? Flaw? Talk to the master there...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
什么？有瑕疵？去问那边的师父...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
No. That's not the flaw I am talking about. Although its name is Shooting Star, it doesn't twinkle at all.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
不是那种瑕疵。它虽然叫流星，却一点也不闪。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of flaw is that? It doesn't matter how it looks! The performance more important!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这算什么瑕疵？外观不重要，性能才重要！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, Lucky... Lucky, Lucky! Although you live in a place like this, your sense has to be youthful. That's the way you stay young. It's as important as being physically healthy.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哎呀，拉基...拉基，拉基！就算住在这种地方，也要保持年轻的心态。这样才能永葆青春，这和身体健康一样重要。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why is it so important?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
为什么那么重要？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Okay. Here's an item with a good performance and dull outward. And here's another one with a good performance and good outward. Which one would you choose?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
好吧，这里有一件性能好但外观普通的东西，还有一件性能和外观都很出色的东西。你会选哪一个？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I like something dull.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我喜欢朴素的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Look at your taste... You really don't know the trend, do you?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
看看你的品味...你完全不懂潮流，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Regardless of the trend, it's my constant taste.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不管潮流怎么变，我一直都喜欢朴素的东西。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Yes, I see. I respect your taste. Then please respect my taste too.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
嗯，我明白了。我尊重你的喜好，也请你尊重我的喜好。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Right.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...好吧。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, what can I do? This part has to be thin... Right! I want to add some glitters to ammunitions.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
唉，怎么办呢？这部分必须做得很薄...对了！我想在弹药上加些闪光粉。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you need them for ammunitions?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
弹药上为什么要加闪光粉？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Since it's Shooting Star, it must twinkle! The Shooting Start that generates its last light by burning itself! The glitters will be spread... Just by imagining it, it's so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
既然叫流星，就应该闪闪发亮！像燃烧自己、绽放最后光芒的流星！闪光粉会四处飞散...光想想就觉得太美了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you do that, you will get tracked.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你那样做会暴露行踪的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
It's okay. I can publicize myself through the entire Continent. Let me grinder something hard and put it...
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
没关系，正好能让我扬名整个大陆。让我先把坚硬的东西磨碎，再加进去...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well. Do as you wish. If you like converting so much, why don't you become an assistant of the master there?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好吧，随你。既然这么喜欢改造，怎么不去给那边的师父当助手？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I prefer being on active duty. By the way... How do I get them?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我更喜欢待在一线工作。对了...要怎么弄到那些材料？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What are you talking about? You have to go out and get them yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你在说什么？当然得自己出去找。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
No. I have these many stuffs to look after. Besides, I don't have enough time. Oh, adventurer! Wait please! Talk to me for a minute!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
不行，我有这么多东西要照看，根本没时间。哦，冒险者！等等！请听我说几句！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Yes! Yes! I really need your help now! I'm glad you are here so that I can ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
对！我现在真的很需要你的帮助！正好你在这里，我可以拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I ask you what it is...?

[Magenta]
Do you have any hard and glittering stone?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你有坚硬又闪亮的石头吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have any.

[Magenta]
So it was a false rumor that adventurers bring about 30,000 gems in their bags.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
原来“冒险者包里都带着三万颗宝石”只是个谣言啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know where you heard that rumor from.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道你是从哪里听来这种传闻的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
My friend told me. Hmm.. What can I do? Can I ask you for a favor, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
是我朋友告诉我的。嗯...怎么办才好？冒险者，能帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, you shouldn't be asking such a thing. The adventurer is our guest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，不该这样拜托客人的。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text: I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation: 我现在很忙...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在有点忙...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventure is busy! You shouldn't be asking such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者正忙着呢！你不该这么麻烦人家！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I see... Please come back if you remember it later on. I will be waiting for you. Bye... then.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我知道了...以后想起来的话，请再来找我。我会等你的。那...再见。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
See you later. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
回头见。路上小心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's all right. What would you like to request?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。你想拜托我什么？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
So it's true that adventurers are kind!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
果然冒险者都很善良！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I need some glittering stuffs to decorate my Shooting Star. Let me see... I need pieces of crystal and black crystal that twinkle transparently.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我想找些闪闪发光的东西装饰我的流星。让我看看...需要透明闪亮的水晶和黑色水晶碎片。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I wish I can go by myself and pick up good crystals one by one. But since I have to look after these stuffs, I cannot. I need so much time to clean and assemble them... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
要是能亲自去挑选水晶就好了。可我得照看这些东西，根本走不开。清理和组装就要花很多时间...唉...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Of course I will compensate you for your support. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
当然会答谢你的帮忙。请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Please bring ^0000cd 10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. You can get them by defeating ^0000cdObsidians and Minerals^000000. Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
请带^0000cd10块水晶和10块黑色水晶^000000。击败^0000cd黑曜石和矿石魔^000000就能得到。小心！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew. He's so loud. I will count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，他真吵。冒险者，就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. I know you are suffering from the weird guy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎回来，冒险者。我知道那个怪人让你很头疼。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You've come! Have you brought everything I asked for? Let me see!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你来了！我拜托的东西都带来了吗？让我看看！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Ah!!!! Not enough quantity!!! Adventurer, I thank you for helping us. But this is not enough!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
啊！！！数量不够！！！冒险者，谢谢你帮忙，但这些还不够！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. Please don't forget it this time!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我们需要^0000cd10块水晶和10块黑色水晶^000000。这次可别忘了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You can get them from ^0000cdObsidians and Mineral^000000. So defeat them. I have to go now. See you!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
击败^0000cd黑曜石和矿石魔^000000就能得到。快去打倒它们吧。我先走了，再见！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, so complicated. We will count on you. That fellow is so persistent.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，真复杂。就拜托你了，那家伙可真执着。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Well, well.... You've brought the pieces of crystal... But you didn't defeat enough Obsidians and Minerals.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哎呀...你带来了水晶碎片...不过黑曜石和矿石魔还没打够。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need a special vibration generated when Obsidians and Minerals die. That vibration enables the crystal to get broken into smaller pieces...
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我们需要黑曜石和矿石魔死时产生的特殊震动。那种震动能让水晶碎成更小的碎片...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry to request you again, adventurer. Please defeat ^0000cd10 Obsidians and 10 Minerals^000000. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
冒险者，抱歉又要麻烦你。请击败^0000cd10只黑曜石和10只矿石魔^000000。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, so complicated. We will count on you. That fellow is so persistent.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，真复杂。就拜托你了，那家伙可真执着。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, you brought them all!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哦，你全都带来了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
So it is true that adventurers are so talented. I was a bit worried when I was requesting.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
看来冒险者确实很能干。刚才拜托你的时候，我还有点担心呢。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Where did you pick up that story?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你从哪儿听来的这种说法？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Pick up that story? Are you saying the adventurer is not talented? After seeing with your eyes?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
听来的？你是说冒险者没本事吗？你明明亲眼看到了呀？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, I mean...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，我是说...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry. Lucky has so many things to do... I apologize on behalf of him.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
抱歉，拉基有很多事情要忙...我替他向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. It's okay.

[Magenta]
By the way, it's so beautiful, What a brilliant light... I would like to start working now.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
对了，这光真美，真耀眼...我现在就想开始做了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, come to think of it... Adventurer! Can you bring them tomorrow? They are so beautiful and I would like to try everything.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哦，对了...冒险者！明天能再带一些来吗？它们太漂亮了，我想把各种做法都试一遍。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will come back if I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我记得的话，会再来的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I'm so glad!!! But I might be outside for a mission. In that case, don't panic and come back next time.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
太好了！！！不过我明天可能会出任务。如果不在这里，别着急，下次再来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will.

[Magenta]
Thank you so much! I should start working. Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
太感谢你了！我得开始工作了。小心点！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That fellow is really loud, isn't he? I apologize on behalf of him. Please take a good rest and come back ^0000cdafter the dawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那家伙真吵啊？我替他向你道歉。好好休息，^0000cd黎明之后^000000再回来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你其实不用特地过来...我是说，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你叫我必须来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼又登场啦！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can't you please skip that performance?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
能不能省掉这段表演？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, did you rest well? I rested well after completing the repair. I know you are not curious about it, but I'm telling you before you ask me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者，休息得好吗？我修好之后休息得很好。虽然你可能不感兴趣，但我还是先说了，免得你问我。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But there's still some water leakage in the pipe. Once I repair one of them, there's another water leakage in another pipe.. I wish we could replace them with brand new pipes.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
不过管道还有些地方在漏水。我刚修好一处，另一处又开始漏...真希望能换成全新的管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
That's why need Steel and Old Steel Plate.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
所以我们需要钢和旧钢板。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please defeat the ^0000cdScrap Heater^000000 and bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
请击败^0000cd废铁暖炉^000000，并带回^0000cd5块钢和15块旧钢板^000000！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
加油！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, I'm so busy. Sorry to request you again. Go, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，我忙得不可开交。抱歉又要麻烦你了。去吧，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. Our silly kid gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎回来，冒险者。谢谢你帮忙。我们那个傻小子没少给你添麻烦吧。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
The adventurer is here?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者来了？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼又登场啦！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer! Have you brought them all? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者！东西都带来了吗？让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well... As I told you, please bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000. We need them to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯...正如我说的，请带^0000cd5块钢和15块旧钢板^000000来修管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, you know how to take shortcuts. I like it.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒险者，你真会走捷径。我喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I really need them. So please bring them to me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
不过我真的需要这些。请带给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼要回家啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What a spoiled kid. I apologize on behalf of him. We will count on you for the rest items.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是个被宠坏的小子。我替他向你道歉，剩下的东西就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
You have brought the Steel and Old Steel Plates...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
你带来了钢和旧钢板...

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Apparently, you did not defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I cannot smell the iron.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看来你没有打倒^0000cd10个废炉^000000。我没闻到铁的味道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Although it is my private request, I wish you could do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
虽然这是我个人的请求，但还是希望你能帮我做到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超级巨星丹尼要回家啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What a spoiled kid. I apologize on behalf of him. We will count on you for the rest items.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是个被宠坏的小子。我替他向你道歉，剩下的东西就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Wow~~~ Great! You never disappoint me!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哇~~~太棒了！你从没让我失望过！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Let me spread your legendary story around the entire continent! Everyone needs to know that!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我要把你的传奇故事传遍整个大陆！大家都该知道！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then I will go and prepare for repairing! I will count on you again!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那我去准备修理了！之后还得拜托你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He went back only after saying what he wants. How spoiled! But I didn't educate him like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他只顾着说自己想说的话，说完就回去了。真被宠坏了！我可没把他教成这样。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow. You must be exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
今天好好休息吧。明天还要拜托你呢，你一定累坏了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你其实不用特地过来...我是说，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你叫我必须来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Yikes, it's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have to listen to complaints of all the people. That's a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我得听所有人的抱怨，真够头疼的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What's so cold? It's the same as yesterday
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哪里冷了？跟昨天一样啊。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey, my feeling is so accurate. It's colder today. Look. You put on more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
嘿，我的感觉可准了，今天更冷。你看，你都多穿了几件。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh! When did I get dressed like this!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哦！我什么时候穿成这样的！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Let's see... I thought so. The fireplace is weaker now. No firewood?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
让我看看...果然如此。壁炉的火弱下来了。没柴火了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，好像是。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Once this last firewood is burnt out, I will die... Last... firewood...
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
最后一根柴烧完，我就要死了...最后一根柴...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who told you that you'd die? You're so healthy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
谁说你要死了？你身体不是好好的吗！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Come on, Just echo my words while I'm sentimental!!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
拜托！我煽情的时候，你就不能配合我一下吗！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, don't die. If you die, who's going to take care of those 12 kids. Please don't die.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哦，别死啊。你死了，谁来照顾那12个孩子？求你别死。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! Who are my kids! And why do I have to feed them? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
嘿！谁是我的孩子？为什么要我养他们？到底怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Your spouse... died during a mission.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你的伴侣...在任务中牺牲了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My god! So who's my spouse?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
天哪！那我的伴侣是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... The Teddy bear?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...泰迪熊？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! No! Let's say this adventurer is my spouse.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀，不是！就说这位冒险者是我的伴侣吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! That's rude!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！这太没礼貌了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Adventurer~ Aren't isn't it cold now?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
冒险者~你不觉得现在很冷吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. Not really...

[Cyan]
Oh, this jacket looks good. That's why you don't feel cold. We always receive cheap clothes so we can easily fell the cold.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，你这件外套真不错，难怪不觉得冷。我们总是领到便宜衣服，一下子就能感受到寒气。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy now. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者现在很忙。你在说什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Listen to me and look around here. This place is a cold building made of iron and stone.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
听我说，再看看周围。这里是座用铁和石头建成的冰冷建筑。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And since we are in a place located nearly underground, it's always cold and damp. You know the feeling? The cold and damp air kills us.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
而且这里靠近地下，总是又冷又潮湿。你知道那是什么感觉吗？这种湿冷的空气简直能要人命。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
That's why we always make a fire in the fireplace to warm the air, boil the tea and bake some sweet potatoes...
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
所以我们总得在壁炉里生火，暖暖屋子、烧水泡茶，再烤些红薯...

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
In any case, that fireplace is a blessing that grants us so many things. But the fire is about to go out due to the lack of firewood.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
总之，壁炉给我们带来了许多温暖，真是个宝贝。可是柴火不够，火眼看就要熄了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Since it's too cold, I can't go out. So would you please bring me some firewood, my dear?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
外面太冷了，我出不去。亲爱的，能帮我带些柴火来吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! You're being rude to the adventurer! Just distinguish the reality and fantasy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！别对冒险者这么无礼！分清现实和幻想！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Well, I distinguish them too well. Rather than living in this cold stony room, I would like to jump into the river!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哼，我分得可清楚了。与其住在这冰冷的石屋里，我还不如跳进河里！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see! I got it! So you won't commit a suicide if I bring the fuel?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了！所以只要我带来燃料，你就不会寻死了，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh dear, you are so kind and lovely.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀，你真是又善良又可爱。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You've dont it again. I've gotta hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又来这套了。真拿你没办法。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
I need some Burnt Tree. About 10 of them. Since they are well-dried, they will be burnt well. And there's better than coal to keep the fire long. Bring some coal please. Three of them.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
我需要大约10根焦木。它们晒得很干，烧起来正合适。还需要煤，让火烧得更久。请带3块煤来。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Coal? Why? It leaves too much ash.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
煤？为什么？那会留下很多灰。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
To me, the efficiency is the most important! The warmest is the best!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
对我来说，效率最重要！越暖和越好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Please stop fighting. I will bring them. ^0000cd10 Burnt Tree and three coal^000000. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了，别吵了。我会带^0000cd10根焦木和3块煤^000000来，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! And defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哎呀！还要击败^0000cd10个废炉^000000！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You need to defeat them to get coal!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
你得击败它们才能拿到煤！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on. The adventurer knows it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜托了，冒险者肯定知道的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Be careful, my dear~
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
小心点，亲爱的~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew... We will count on you anyway. Regardless of what that fellow told you, everyone will get a cold once the fire goes out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉...总之就拜托你了。不管那家伙怎么说，火一灭，大家都会着凉。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. Our silly kid gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎回来，冒险者。感谢你帮忙。我们那个调皮的小子没少给你添麻烦吧。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
What? Adventurer? My dear?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
什么？冒险者？亲爱的？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear~~~ You're late! I've been waiting for you for a long time! Have you brought the right one again? I mean, the firewood.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
亲爱的~~~你迟到了！我等你好久了！这次又带对东西了吗？我是说，柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's not there. And it's not enough... Perhaps you forgot what we told you to bring?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，没带齐...数量也不够...你是不是忘了我们让你带什么？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
10 Burnt Tree and three coal. I feel so cold. See you, dear.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
10根焦木和3块煤。我好冷啊。再见，亲爱的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And don't forget to defeat about 10 Waste Stoves! I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
还有别忘了打倒大约10个废炉！我要回床上睡觉了，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉，我们有些孩子被宠坏了...就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, you have the firewood... What about Waste Stoves? You didn't defeat them?
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，你带来柴火了...那废炉呢？没打倒它们吗？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You must get them, dear. Waste Stoves release the fine firewood only after they are shaken about 1,000 times.
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
亲爱的，必须把它们打倒。废炉被摇晃大约一千次后，才会掉落上好的柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
打倒^0000cd10个废炉^000000。我要回床上睡觉了，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉，我们有些孩子被宠坏了...就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Burnt Tree and coal, you have everything! That's why I like you, dear!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
焦木和煤都带齐了！亲爱的，这就是我喜欢你的原因！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Okay. Put the wood and coal in... Fire!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
好了，把木头和煤放进去...点火！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's warm now. As warm as your love~
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
哦，暖和起来了，就像你的爱一样温暖~

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Thank you so much! I will count you again later on! MY DEAR!
scripts.translation:
[赛安]
太感谢你了！亲爱的，以后还要再拜托你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There he leaves again without saying goodbye to you. Sorry about him. Some of our kids are spoiled. But not every Rebellion is like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他又没跟你道别就走了。抱歉，他就是这样。我们有些孩子被宠坏了，但不是每个反叛者都这样。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
今天好好休息吧。明天还要再麻烦你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你其实不用特地过来...我是说，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你叫我必须来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Wait!!! Adventurer! Please talk to me!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
等等！！！冒险者，请跟我说句话！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I would be so sad if you leave without seeing me. I thought of a perfect design last night.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你要是不见我就走，我会很难过的。昨晚我想到了一个完美的设计。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
And I made various stuffs and now I ran out of crystals... Would you mind if I ask you to get them?
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我做了好多东西，现在水晶用完了...你能帮我找一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Defeat ^0000cdObsidian and Mineral^000000. Then bring me ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000 please.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
请击败^0000cd黑曜石和矿石魔^000000，再带来^0000cd10块水晶和10块黑色水晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Eee you later! I have to go and arrange the stuffs I made. I will count on you!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
回头见！我得去整理做好的东西了。就拜托你啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, Sorry to request you again. It must be tough for you now.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，抱歉又要麻烦你。你现在一定很辛苦吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. That flake gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
欢迎回来，冒险者。谢谢你帮忙。那个古怪的家伙没少给你添麻烦吧。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
