You've come! Have you brought everything I asked for? Let me see!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你来了！我拜托的东西都带来了吗？让我看看！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Ah!!!! Not enough quantity!!! Adventurer, I thank you for helping us. But this is not enough!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
啊！！！数量不够！！！冒险者，谢谢你帮忙，但这些还不够！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. Please don't forget it this time!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我们需要^0000cd10块水晶和10块黑色水晶^000000。这次可别忘了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You can get them from ^0000cdObsidians and Mineral^000000. So defeat them. I have to go now. See you!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
击败^0000cd黑曜石和矿石魔^000000就能得到。快去打倒它们吧。我先走了，再见！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉，我们有些孩子被宠坏了...就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Well, well.... You've brought the pieces of crystal... But you didn't defeat enough Obsidians and Minerals.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
哎呀...你带来了水晶碎片...不过黑曜石和矿石魔还没打够。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need a special vibration generated when Obsidians and Minerals die. That vibration enables the crystal to get broken into smaller pieces...
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
我们需要黑曜石和矿石魔死时产生的特殊震动。那种震动能让水晶碎成更小的碎片...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry to request you again, adventurer. Please defeat ^0000cd10 Obsidians and 10 Minerals^000000. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
冒险者，抱歉又要麻烦你。请击败^0000cd10只黑曜石和10只矿石魔^000000。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉，我们有些孩子被宠坏了...就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You brought them all again!!! I'm beginning to respect you!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
你又全都带来了！！！我开始佩服你了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Thank you so much! Can I ask you for a favor again next time? This is great!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛根塔]
太感谢你了！下次还能再请你帮忙吗？太好了！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There he leaves again without saying goodbye to you. Sorry about him. Some of our kids are spoiled. But not every Rebellion is like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他又没跟你道别就走了。抱歉，他就是这样。我们有些孩子被宠坏了，但不是每个反叛者都这样。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
今天好好休息吧。明天还要再麻烦你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me take him out!
Seems like there are still some researchers hiding like this.
Please do us another little favor!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
让我把他带出来！
看来还有研究员躲在这种地方。
再帮我们一个小忙吧！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me take him out!
Seems like there are still some researchers hiding like this.
^4d4dffYou can stop searching and take a rest!^000000
We will search for the rest of them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
让我把他带出来！
看来还有研究员躲在这种地方。
^4d4dff你可以停止搜索，先休息一下！^000000
剩下的人我们来找。

scripts.text: The boy with silver hairs looked at me. He frowned and turned his head.
scripts.translation: 那个银发男孩看了我一眼，皱起眉头，把头扭开了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
...

scripts.text:
Although you talk to him, he would not listen at all.
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
你跟他说话，他也完全不理会。
看来和那个女孩说话会容易些。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
.........
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
...

[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
...

[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
...

scripts.text:
He held his lips tight and looking at me.
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他紧抿着嘴唇看着我。
看来和那个女孩说话会容易些。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......Don't talk to Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
...别和雅娜说话。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Don't talk to me either.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
也别跟我说话。

scripts.text:
He held his lips tight with a stubborn face..
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他紧紧抿着嘴唇，一脸倔强...
看来和那个女孩说话会容易些。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Jana... You're cute even when you're breathing...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
雅娜...连呼吸的样子都好可爱...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
...?!!!
Why did you overhear me?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
...？！！
你怎么偷听到了？

scripts.text:
He is furious. But he's the one who said that loud...
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他气得不行，可明明是他自己说得那么大声...
看来还是和那个女孩说话比较容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Adventurer, could you please ask Jana?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
冒险者，能帮我问问雅娜吗？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I mean.... how much she likes her older brother...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我是说...她有多喜欢她哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ilya, I heard that.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
伊利亚，我听见了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Gosh! No, no... I was just...!!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
天哪！不，不是...我只是...！！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I made cookies together with Jana. Yesterday, we read a book together. Tomorrow we will explore the dead mine...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我和雅娜一起做了饼干。昨天我们一起读书，明天还要一起去探索废弃矿坑...

scripts.text: Ilya Lebedev is be excited and boasting about what happened.
scripts.translation: 伊利亚·列别捷夫兴奋地炫耀着刚才发生的事。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I want to be called by my first name, Ilya...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我想让她叫我的名字，伊利亚...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I mean... by Jana. Not by you.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
我是说...让雅娜这么叫，不是你。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Sometimes I wish she calls me 'brother'...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
有时候我希望她叫我“哥哥”...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Jana calls you Older {0}. And why does she call me Ilya...?!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
雅娜叫你“{0}前辈”，为什么只叫我伊利亚...？！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Shooting? I like it. But it's not the only reason I practice it.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
射击？我喜欢。但这不是我练习射击的唯一原因。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Because I have to support Jana. I will shoot anyone who puts a hand on Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
因为我得保护雅娜。谁敢对雅娜动手，我就开枪打谁。

scripts.text: Ilya Lebedev looks quite excited.
scripts.translation: 伊利亚·列别捷夫看起来很兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't want to be treated as a child.
Do not stroke my head.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
别把我当小孩子。
不许摸我的头。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ilya is the only one who can call me Jana.
Call me Lebedeva.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
只有伊利亚能叫我雅娜。
请叫我列别杰娃。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......Who are you?
You don't look like Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...你是谁？
你看起来不像反叛者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are right. I'm an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说得对，我是冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
How did an adventurer come in here?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
冒险者怎么会跑到这里来？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Are you the adventurer who defeated our commander?
So you're the one from the Secret Wings, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你就是打败我们指挥官的冒险者？
你是秘密之翼的人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Huhu, the old guys here hate the Secret Wings, but we don't care.
Since we want to fight hard in a mission, we welcome your proposal.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
呵呵，这里的老家伙们讨厌秘密之翼，不过我们不在乎。
我们也想在任务中大显身手，很乐意听听你的提议。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Whatever Jana likes, I like it too.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
雅娜喜欢什么，我也喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Have you brought any story filled with gunpowder?
...Well, we cannot be involved in the mission anyway.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你带来什么硝烟弥漫的故事了吗？
...不过我们反正也不能参加任务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are still young.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们还太年轻了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...We'll become adults in the near future.
We are not that much younger compared to other people here. Does putting on several years make any difference?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...我们很快就会长大。
比起这里的其他人，我们也没小多少。年纪差几岁真的有区别吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
They all know that we have better abilities than adults.
If it wasn't for one thing... No, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
大家都知道我们的能力比成年人强。
要不是因为一件事...算了，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
It's so annoying...
Ilya, tell the adventurer to go away.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
真烦...
伊利亚，叫冒险者离开。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please leave.
We don't want to talk to you any more.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
请离开。
我们不想再和你说话了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(So they started to hate me pretty early... What should I do?
Maybe I have to listen to ^0000CDRebellions around them^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他们这么早就开始讨厌我了...怎么办？
也许我该听听他们周围^0000CD反叛者^000000的说法。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ah, Ilya. That person keeps irritating me.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
伊利亚，那个人一直惹我生气。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please leave.
I won't forgive you if you distress Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
请离开。
要是你再让雅娜难过，我不会放过你。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You're here again?
We don't want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你又来了？
我们不想说话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Ask them about the incident that happened in the past...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（问问他们过去发生的那件事...）

scripts.text: Ask them directly.
scripts.translation: 直接问

scripts.text: Beat around the bush.
scripts.translation: 旁敲侧击

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you throw a grenade to the civilian zone during your actual mission?
Why did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们执行任务时，真的向平民区投掷了手榴弹吗？
为什么这么做？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
What...!!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
什么...！！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Where did you hear this story!
Hey, why are you saying that?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
你从哪儿听来的！
喂，你为什么这么说？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Get lost! Stay away from Jana!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别捷夫]
滚开！离雅娜远点！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(......Looks like a huge mistake. Let's go back to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（...看来我犯了个大错。还是回去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000吧。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's something I would like to ask you.
I asked others and they say you were...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有件事想问你们。
我问过其他人，他们说你们...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...Why do you pry into our private affairs?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...为什么要打听我们的私事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't pry into anything. I mean, they told me you look very tired these days...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没有打听什么。我是说，别人告诉我你们最近看起来很疲惫...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We are tired because someone is irritating us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们会累，是因为有人一直惹我们生气。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(......This is getting difficult. Let's go back to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（...这越来越难办了。还是回去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000吧。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We don't want to talk to you. Just leave.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们不想和你说话，快走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(...I guess they really hate me now.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（...看来他们真的讨厌我了。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You're here again?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你又来了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
( I did take the cookie... Where is it?
Let's go back to Ericsson and talk to him.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我确实拿了饼干...饼干在哪儿？还是回去找埃里克森谈谈吧。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, guys?

[Jana Levedeva]
...Do you have so much free time? Why do you keep stalking us?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...你很闲吗？为什么一直跟着我们？

scripts.text: There's something I would like to tell you.
scripts.translation: 告诉你们一件事

scripts.text: Want some cookie?
scripts.translation: 给你们饼干？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't want to hear it.
Unless you pay us 1 million Zeny for listening to your story, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我不想听。除非你付我们100万zeny听你讲，否则快走。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't know what you are up to. But we...
...Wait, where did you get this cookie?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我不知道你打什么主意。不过我们...等等，你从哪儿弄来的饼干？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Someone you know well told me to give this to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一个你们熟悉的人让我把这个交给你们。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......Commander Adler?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别杰夫]
...阿德勒指挥官？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And he also said this.
Trust me. And tell the adventurer if you have any problem.
This is my request. Could you please tell me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他还让我转告你们：相信我，有什么问题就告诉冒险者。这是我的请求。你们能告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......What...
That.. is a lie. How can I trust an adventurer...?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...什么...那是谎话。我怎么能相信冒险者...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As I told you earlier, please think about commander Adler.
He's so worried about you. So am I, and so is commander Volkova.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就像我刚才说的，请想想阿德勒指挥官。他很担心你们，我和沃尔科娃指挥官也一样。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We...
No. We won't tell you.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们...不，不会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please tell me one thing.
I heard you didn't ruin yourself like this before.
Why do you keep hurting yourself?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请告诉我一件事。我听说你们以前不是这样的，为什么总是伤害自己？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Why do you say that? What do you know about us?
You know nothing!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
你为什么这么说？你了解我们吗？你什么都不知道！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...I was so..
scared...... so...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...我当时好...害怕...所以...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Scared...?

[Jana Levedeva]
And then... I got out of shape...
So I was scared... I did so... on purpose... sniffle.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
后来...我就失去了状态...所以我很害怕...我是故意那样做的...（抽泣）

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别杰夫]
...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I'm sure you know what happened during our first mission... not long ago.
After that. Jana had such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别杰夫]
我想你知道不久前我们的第一次任务出了什么事...从那以后，雅娜一直很难受。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Because Jana and I had been so confident that we would do well.
Then it happened... and we... were so miserable.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别杰夫]
雅娜和我原本很有信心，觉得能做好。结果出了那件事，我们都...很难过。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Sniffle. We didn't throw the grenade on purpose and we didn't enjoy it either. It's out fault. But, but...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
（抽泣）我们不是故意扔手榴弹的，也不觉得那很好玩。是我们的错，可是...可是...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We were punished and moved to USU... Then we felt that everyone else regards us as horrible kids.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们受罚后被调去了USU...感觉大家都把我们当成坏孩子。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
We wanted to talk to commander Ericsson. But we couldn't, because we were assigned to another unit.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别杰夫]
我们想找埃里克森指挥官谈谈，可我们被分派到别的部队，没法见他。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We had no idea what to do. We just wanted to run away. Because everyone was blaming us and disappointed at us...
But we liked our unit and commander Ericsson...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们不知道该怎么办，只想逃走。大家都在责怪我们，对我们失望...可我们喜欢原来的部队和埃里克森指挥官...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We thought that we had already ruined everything.
As everyone was already disappointed at us, we thought we could do whetever...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们以为一切都被我们搞砸了。既然大家都对我们失望，我们就觉得可以为所欲为...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
As we acted at our pleasure, things got worse and worse... So we were sacred...
Then we began to believe that we were the worst and hopeless kids...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我们想做什么就做什么，事情变得越来越糟...我们很害怕...觉得自己是最糟糕、最没救的孩子...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
It's just our excuse that nobody stopped us...
I'm sorry to have troubled you...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚·列别杰夫]
没人阻止我们，只是我们的借口...给你添麻烦了，对不起...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I'm... sorry too...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
我...也对不起...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's what happened... Now I know you suffered a lot.
Can I tell this to your commander?
Of course I won't tell anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此...我明白你们受了很多苦。我可以把这些事告诉你们的指挥官吗？当然，我不会告诉其他人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(You heard their story. Let's go to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000 and tell her.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我听到了他们的故事。去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000告诉她吧。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......
We'll be scolded...
But we have no choice. It's our fault. Please report to our commander.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
...会挨骂的...但也没办法，是我们的错。请向指挥官报告吧。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Call from USU commander?
She will tell us that story...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列别杰娃]
USU指挥官找我们？她要告诉我们那件事...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
什么事？

scripts.text: Give him the ring.
scripts.translation: 把戒指交给他

scripts.text: Do you come here often?
scripts.translation: 你常来这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
Teaching juniors after retirement, I think of my son every now and then.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
退休后教导年轻人，我时不时会想起儿子。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... And my wife who passed away, too.
I also think of my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
...还有我去世的妻子。
我也会想起女儿。

scripts.text: You gave him the ring.
scripts.translation: 你把戒指交给了他。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... This ... ring is ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
...这...枚戒指是...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
Poor fellow.
In the end, this is the way you come back.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
可怜的孩子。
到头来，你竟是这样回来的。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
I was expecting this.
When I found his Pecopeco, I knew something was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
我早就料到了。
发现他的大嘴鸟时，我就知道出事了。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
But as I didn't see it with my eyes,
I had a slight hope in my mind.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
但我没有亲眼看到，
心里还留着一丝希望。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
....
... Should I welcome you, to see you again like this?

[本尼迪克特·温莎]

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... Thanks.
...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·温莎]
...谢谢。
...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... That rocket belongs to Cheiron.
When they told me they would take them to Geffen's Magic_tower ...

[本尼迪克特·温莎]

[Benedict Windsor]

... Why should my children end up like this?

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
You ...
......

你...
...

scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
我认得这个。
这是索林刚来到修道院时，紧紧握在小手里的那串念珠。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I can faintly feel the spirit of that girl, Sorin.
She's grown up a lot.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
我隐约感受到了那个女孩索林的灵魂。
她已经长大了许多。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
She was a tomboy. But since she met Seyren, she often pretended to be modest.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
她以前是个假小子。不过自从遇见塞伦后，就经常装得很文静。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Jooshin loved the girl a lot, and she was taken so early.
....
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
乔信很疼爱那个女孩，可她这么早就离开了。
...

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... Thank you very much for giving this to me.
May the blessing of Jooshin be with you forever.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
...非常感谢你把这个交给我。
愿乔信的祝福永远与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I used to visit the Capitolina convent with Sorin quite often.
With her high-spirited personality, she got along quite well with the monks.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
以前我常和索林一起去卡皮托利纳修道院。
她性格开朗，和那里的武僧们相处得很好。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
She also came here to relax when she needed some rest ...
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
她需要休息时也会来这里放松...

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... even though the path is quite rough.
If you are going back now, do you want me to send you to Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
...虽然路确实很难走。
你现在要回去吗？要我送你去普隆德拉吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，麻烦你

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
If you need it later, do not hesitate to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
之后需要的话，尽管告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... Bye.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
...再见。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
You can smelt your gears over there.
I don't take requests for personal production or smelting.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
你可以去那边熔炼装备。
我不接私人制作或熔炼的委托。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Who's there? A shopper?
I don't accept personal production requests.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
谁在那儿？是来买东西的吗？
我不接私人定制委托。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Wait, can I see that Thimble Of Archer?
This decoration is ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
等等，能让我看看那个“弓箭手的手套”吗？
这个装饰是...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Hey! What happened to Alt?
He made this decoration for the Thimble Of Archer when he visited here for the last time.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
嘿！阿尔特怎么了？
他上次来这里时，亲手给“弓箭手的手套”做了这个装饰。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
A jewel decoration on a Thimble Of Archer! I know it sounds crazy. But it took him several days ? he didn't even sleep!
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
在“弓箭手的手套”上镶宝石？听起来确实疯狂。他为此忙了好几天，甚至连觉都没睡！

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Since he was having a hard time making it, I was willing to help him. But he still made this Thimble Of Archer alone ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
看他做得那么辛苦，我本想帮忙。但他还是坚持独自完成了这只手套...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Why do you have this?
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
你为什么带着这个？

scripts.text: It's a relic.
scripts.translation: 这是一件遗物

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... What?
No ... Wait ... Wait a minute
I heard some rumors. I did ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
...什么？
不...等等...等一下。
我确实听到过一些传闻...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
But I still believed that no news is good news ...
In this way, all of a sudden ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
但我一直以为没有消息就是好消息...
没想到突然就...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... What ... What a fool.
Why did he make a gift that he cannot even deliver?
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
...真是...傻瓜。
他为什么要做一份根本送不出去的礼物？

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... Haa ...
Eventually, this is how it ends ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
...唉...
结果还是变成这样...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Thank you ... for coming all the way here.
I have to delay my work for a while.
....
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
谢谢你...特地跑这一趟。
我得暂时停下手里的工作。
...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Alt has an older brother.
... I will give this to him.
Since he is in a critical moment now, I will look for a chance to give it to him.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
阿尔特还有个哥哥。
...我会把这个交给他。
他现在正处在关键时期，我会找机会交给他。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... Damn.
I cannot resume my work.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
...该死。
我没法继续工作了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
... If you want to become an Assassin, go east of the desert.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
...想成为刺客的话，就去沙漠以东。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
It's quite unusual.
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
真少见。
你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
This dagger is ...
Right. Eremes ...
has finally returned.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
这把短剑是...
没错，艾雷姆斯...
终于回来了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
It's been a long time since I dispatched him ... He returned too late.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
我派他出去已经很久了...可他回来得太晚了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
Is this mission failure or success?
... He is the type of guy who hates to have a mission fail.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
这次任务到底是成功还是失败？
...他最讨厌任务失败了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
I like guys who are serious about completing their missions. But in this case ... I wish he had just abandoned his mission and taken a vacation.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
我喜欢认真完成任务的人。但这次...我倒希望他干脆放弃任务，出去度个假。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
I will take him ... well.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
我会照顾好他...嗯。
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
In this field, it is quite common to not have your companion come back after a mission.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
干我们这行的，同伴执行任务后没能回来是常有的事。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
Some lucky guys come back like this.
And he was quite lucky.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
有些幸运儿能这样回来。
他已经算很幸运了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
There's no need to be sad.
But it's just regrettable.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔·马罗维茨]
没必要难过。
只是有些遗憾。
就这样。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
In the past, the Hunter guild was in the Payon Forest.
And I grew up in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
以前猎人公会设在斐扬森林。
我也是在斐扬长大的。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
That's why I visit Payon once in a while.
....
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
所以我偶尔会回斐扬看看。
...

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
For some reason, I felt like coming here today.
Maybe it was for this.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
不知为何，今天我特别想来这里。
也许就是为了这件事。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
My silly sister.
... As a matter of fact, she cannot sew well.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
我那傻妹妹...
其实她根本不擅长缝纫。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
She can barely sew on a button.
.......
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
她连一颗扣子都缝不好。
...

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
One day, she asked me.
Would it be better for me to act more like a girl?
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
有一天，她问我：
“我是不是应该更像个女孩子？”

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
Maybe I can just sew on a single button?
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
“也许我至少能学会缝颗扣子？”

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
So I gave her this sewing box.
I don't know who she was thinking about when she took this.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
所以我把这个针线盒给了她。
不知道她拿着它时，心里想的是谁。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
.........
The spare button is missing.
... Would she have sewn it on well?
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
...
备用扣子不见了。
...她缝上去了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
I expected this, but I never imagined this thing would come back.
... Since it was her choice ... I must accept this ... But ...
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
我早有预感，但没想到它会以这种方式回来。
...既然是她自己的选择...我必须接受...可是...

scripts.text:
Sherine is holding back her tears.
Leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
谢琳强忍着泪水。
请让她一个人待一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
... Thank ... you ...

[Sherine]
... Please leave me alone.
... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[谢琳]
...请让我一个人待着。
...对不起。
